title: Product Owner, Workday, Talent & Performance
description:
**Position Overview**
The
**Experienced Product Owner**
is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the Talent & Performance Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Talent & Performance end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to configure, test, validate and deploy.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Create design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Own day-to-day delivery.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Nice to have experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role):**
Talent & Learning: Performance reviews, goal management, succession planning, learning campaigns, content management, and skills framework.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
* Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
* Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

**About Revantage**
Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
  
  
Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. This complexity demands technology professionals who thrive in ambiguity, operate with an enterprise mindset, and can design solutions that scale across legal entities, geographies, and business models.

In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant, employee, or other covered person based on any legally recognized basis, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, race, color, caste, immigration status, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex, gender, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation or related medical conditions), age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected leave status, domestic violence victim status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local law. title: Senior Product Manager - Exposure Management
description:
At
**Arctic Wolf**
, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you will help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.
  
  
If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
  
  
Our mission is simple:
**End Cyber Risk.**
We are looking for a
**Senior Product Manager – Exposure Management**
to help achieve this mission.
  
  
The Senior Product Manager – Exposure Management will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Arctic Wolf’s Aurora Exposure Management platform. This role requires deep familiarity with Exposure Management technologies, specifically vulnerability detection and content generation methods. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with engineering and user experience teams to decompose business needs into detailed technical requirements and ensure consistent value delivery.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Align product requirements with strategic objectives for Aurora Exposure Management, ensuring clarity and traceability from concept to delivery.
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, and Program Managers to translate strategic initiatives into executable engineering plans.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across engineering, security operations, threat research, customer success, and leadership teams to prioritize initiatives and evaluate trade-offs.
* Author and maintain detailed functional and technical specifications in product briefs and detailed product requirement documents.
* Decompose high-level product goals into actionable development tasks and user stories, ensuring completeness and clarity.
* Conduct competitive and technical research to inform roadmap decisions and differentiate Arctic Wolf’s Aurora Exposure Management offering.
* Support backlog grooming and sprint planning with a focus on technical feasibility and business value.
* Support enablement of all impacted stakeholders for new product releases.

**You Will Be Successful In This Role If**

* You have significant experience in Product Management within cybersecurity or security operations environments.
* You have a strong understanding of vulnerability management, scan technologies, vulnerability content, asset discovery, and remediation technologies.
* You have a good understanding of breach and attack simulation, adversarial security, or penetration testing.
* You have experience managing complex product roadmaps that span multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
* You are skilled at prioritization, trade-off analysis, backlog management, and agile product delivery.
* You have a strong understanding of software development processes, agile methodologies, and product lifecycle management.
* You are comfortable analyzing telemetry, usage metrics, adoption trends, and operational costs to guide product decisions.
* You can clearly communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, and business value to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* You have strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across engineering, product, and business teams.
* You have a proven ability to identify risks, resolve ambiguities, and drive alignment across complex initiatives.

**Must Have**

* 6+ years of prior product management experience, ideally in exposure management, vulnerability management, or endpoint and network security.
* Engineering or technical background, such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Software Engineering.
* Familiarity with cloud-native, multi-tenant platforms and large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience with Aha, Jira, agile planning tools, and product analytics platforms.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with breach and attack simulation, adversarial security, or penetration testing.
* An MBA degree.

Do not meet all the requirements? That is okay. We still encourage you to apply. We have many opportunities and are always looking for strong talent.
  
  
**On-Camera Policy**
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
  
  
At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace United States, Best Places to Work United States, Great Place to Work Canada, Great Place to Work United Kingdom, and Kununu Top Company Germany. Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains a trusted name in the industry.
  
  
**Our Values**
Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and value the unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. By protecting sensitive data and working to end cyber risk, we contribute to an industry that serves the greater good.
  
  
We celebrate diverse perspectives through our Pack Unity program and encourage employees to participate in or create new alliances.
  
  
We also believe in corporate responsibility and have joined the Pledge One Percent movement to give back to our communities.
  
  
**All Employees Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including**

* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays, and volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance equal to three times compensation, and personal accident insurance
* Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under applicable law. We are committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, and inclusive environment.
  
  
**Security Requirements**

* Conduct duties in accordance with Arctic Wolf information security policies, standards, and controls.
* Background checks are required for this position.
* This role may require access to information protected under United States export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations. If applicable, an offer of employment will be conditioned upon authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these regulations.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About Us**
peopleHum is an AI-native human capital platform built on microservices, event-driven pipelines, and deep LLM integrations. We are looking for a driven engineering graduate to join as a Probationary Associate in Full Stack Agentic AI Development. You will work with senior engineers to build LLM-powered systems and user-facing applications, gaining hands-on experience across the tech and domain stack. This role is designed to fast-track growth for candidates with strong technical aptitude and a passion for AI engineering. The role and opportunity is based out of Mumbai and Mumbai resident candidates will be given first preference. The opportunity carries an above market pay package on confirmation with the opportunity to participate in a stock plan.
  
  
Find out more - https://www.peoplehum.com
  
  
**Role Overview**
At peopleHum, we’re building AI-driven product experiences that are shaping the future of work. We’re looking for an Associate Product Manager who is passionate about quality, execution, and customer impact. You’ll work closely with the Head of Product, own features end-to-end from PRD to production, and actively contribute to our growing AI and Agentic initiatives.
  
  
**Roles Responsibilities**

* Report to and collaborate with the Head of Product to develop strategies that expand peopleHum into new markets, positioning it as a leading HCM platform for the hybrid work model.
* Drive roadmap execution to rapidly expand the product suite and create sustainable product differentiation moving fast without cutting quality corners.
* Spend a disproportionate amount of time with customers and prospects informing product vision, co- innovating on solutions, and bringing the outside-in perspective to every roadmap decision.
* Define your features completely write PRDs, specs, and user stories with full ownership of your modules. Engineers should be able to build from your documents without constant back-and-forth.
* Manage daily workflow with a team of engineers and designers, unblocking sprint ceremonies and enabling clear decision-making.
* Own UAT before every production release write test cases, catch regressions and edge cases, and sign off on quality. You are the last line of defence before customers see the product. MUST HAVE
* Analyse the effectiveness of shipped features track usage, identify failure points, and define iterative improvements to reduce drop-offs and increase adoption.
* Own every task assigned to you follow through without reminders, communicate blockers early, and close the loop with stakeholders.
* Represent your team in communication with product, engineering, design, and marketing leadership be a clear, structured voice for your squad.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* MBA is a plus, particularly if paired with strong technical depth.

Must have skills
  
  

* Strong prioritization instincts you can triage a messy backlog, say no clearly, and explain tradeoffs to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a talent for precise articulation of customer problems vague specs are not acceptable.
* Technical fluency ability to gain an in-depth understanding of software systems, work comfortably with engineers on architecture discussions, and make meaningful technical contributions.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools daily Cursor, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Notion AI, or similar and a genuine curiosity for how these tools work.
* Working understanding of LLM-based products prompt design, RAG architectures, AI agents, and the failure modes unique to AI systems (hallucinations, latency, eval metrics).
* A quality obsessed mindset you've personally run UATs, written test cases, and taken accountability for what ships to production.
* Passion for building delightful products with an eye for design you have intuition for good user flows, UX detail, and can articulate what 'well-crafted' means.
* Demonstrated accountability and ownership: you close tasks, not just open them. You flag risks early and follow up proactively.

Good to have skills
  
  

* Understanding of the HCM (human capital management) space and enterprise SaaS — highly desirable but not a blocker if everything else fits.
* Experience with tools like JIRA, Linear, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Figma, and Notion.
* Exposure to API-first or developer-facing B2B products.
* Basic SQL or data querying ability to self-serve on product analytics.
* Prior experience shipping features that included an AI or ML component.

title: AI Product Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Oxeva.ai is focused on building an AI workforce for enterprise organizations by combining human expertise with advanced AI agents to drive measurable business outcomes. The company designs and deploys agent-powered solutions that integrate seamlessly into existing operations. Team members collaborate closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver scalable, outcome-driven AI products. Working at Oxeva.ai offers the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise AI while solving complex, real-world problems. The environment is fast-paced, innovation-focused, and supportive of continuous learning.

**Role Description**
The AI Product Manager will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI products, from discovery and requirements gathering through launch and iteration. This full-time, on-site role in Bengaluru involves collaborating with engineering, data science, design, and operations teams to define product vision, roadmap, and success metrics. Day-to-day responsibilities include translating business needs into clear product specifications, prioritizing features, overseeing experiments and pilots, and ensuring products are outcome-driven and aligned with enterprise customer goals. The AI Product Manager will interface regularly with clients and internal stakeholders to collect feedback, refine solutions, and manage releases. The role also includes monitoring performance, identifying new opportunities for AI-powered capabilities, and ensuring ethical, responsible use of AI within products.

**Qualifications**

* Product management skills, including defining product vision, creating roadmaps, and managing end-to-end product lifecycles.
* Experience in Program Management skills.
* Experience working with AI/ML or data-driven products, collaborating with data science and engineering teams, and interpreting technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong user and customer research capabilities, including requirements gathering, stakeholder interviews, and translating insights into clear product specifications.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define KPIs, analyze product performance, and make data-informed decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strength in storytelling, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Background in enterprise or B2B products, preferably in technology or AI-driven solutions, with experience working closely with client-facing teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline; advanced degrees are a plus.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment, with a proactive approach, ownership mindset, and commitment to responsible, human-centered AI.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Level Up Your Career!**
At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.
  
  
At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.
  
  
**Join the team!**
Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior or Lead Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.
  
  
You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.
  
  
We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.
  
  
This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand the games inside out. Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
* Start with a hypothesis. Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
* Run experiments that decide. Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
* Shape the roadmap. Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
* Connect growth and product. Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
* Grow the product craft. Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
* Spot tomorrow’s hits. Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

**What You’ll Own**
Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.
  
  
You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.
  
  
**How We’ll Celebrate Your Success**

* Growth in LTV and profit from product changes
* Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games
* Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped
* Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions

**Essential**
**What We’re Looking For:**

* Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.
* Strong analytical skills: at home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.
* A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.
* Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads
* A clear, warm communicator who makes the case in players and pounds.

**Desirable**

* SQL experience.
* Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.
* Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience

**Why Kwalee?**

* Generous Holiday: Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* Health Cover: Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* Free Food & Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* Transport: Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* Office Location: Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* Professional Development: Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* Merch & Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.
  
  
Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.
  
  
We recognise the importance of self-development, career progression, and well-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Role Summary**
As a Product Manager for Payments & Fraud at McAfee, you will play a key role in building secure, seamless, and scalable payment and risk mitigation solutions. You will work closely with engineering, design, data science, and global stakeholders to shape the roadmap, define requirements, and deliver high-impact features that drive business growth, improve payment reliability, and enhance customer trust.
  
  
You will support global payments optimization and fraud prevention initiatives, ensuring McAfee’s billing and transaction experiences are customer-friendly, complaint and optimized for performance.
  
  
This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India development center. You will be required to be on-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.
  
  
**Position Details**
**About The Role**

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for global payments, subscription billing and auto-renewal experiences.
* Drive payment orchestration initiatives, PSP integrations, and expansion of global and local payment methods to improve conversion and payment success rates.
* Define product requirements and lead delivery across payments, billing, fraud prevention, disputes and card lifecycle management.
* Partner with engineering, finance, operations, risk, and external payment providers to deliver scalable, compliant and customer-centric solutions.
* Leverage data, experimentation, and industry insights to optimize authorization rates, reduce involuntary churn, and drive revenue growth.

**About You**

description:

**Job Description:**
**The Future Begins Here:**
At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
  
  
Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicentre of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
  
  
**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity:**
Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team.
  
  
***OBJECTIVES/PURPOSE:***
The Digital Product, Senior Manager leads a product initiative within the Takeda portfolio, focusing on customer needs, strategic product roadmap, and go-to-market strategy. This role ensures the product aligns with business objectives and delivers value across the organization.
  
  
This role owns the end-to-end product leadership, operations, and evolution of iEnvision—business-critical, globally used medical digital platforms supporting publications, grants & donations, and research workflows. Guided by Takedas values-based decision-making (Patient → Trust → Reputation → Business), the role is accountable for strategy, roadmap, governance, vendor performance, integrations, and adoption - balancing day-to-day operational excellence with modernization and measurable value realization.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of Medical Affairs, Data Digital &Technology, Compliance, and external partners, the role requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, and executive-level stakeholder management to ensure reliability, audit readiness, and a scalable user experience.
  
  
***ACCOUNTABILITIES:***
**1. Product Strategy & Roadmap:**

* Define and maintain near-term and multi-year roadmaps aligned to Medical strategy and enterprise priorities, translating needs into clear outcomes and an executable plan.
* Lead structured intake, triage, and prioritization to drive transparent decisions across competing demands and capacity constraints.
* Shape next-generation capability planning (e.g., API-based architectures, automation, and AI-enabled use cases) while protecting compliance and platform integrity.
* Maintain a multi-year evolution roadmap balancing operational excellence, modernization, measurable value realization, and user experience.

**2. Platform / Product Ownership & Agile Delivery:**

* Act as the accountable Product Owner for iEnvision, overseeing day-to-day product operations across high-usage modules supporting grants & donations, research, and scientific publications.
* Own and prioritize the global backlog and coordinate delivery across upgrades, enhancements, maintenance, and integrations (e.g., SAP, EDB/Databricks, MDM, FTP/API pipelines).
* Coordinate RUN and lifecycle management activities (incident/problem/change, release and environment readiness) across internal teams and external vendors to ensure stable operations and predictable delivery.
* Own release planning, UAT coordination, hypercare, and post-release stabilization to ensure dependable delivery and minimal downtime.
* Establish and execute test strategy across functional, integration, regression and UAT cycles; coordinate test data, defect triage, and sign-offs with business owners and technology partners.

**3. Compliance, Governance & Risk Management:**

* Design and run governance forums to assess demand, size and prioritize work, manage risks, and align stakeholders on the “vital few.”
* Maintain audit readiness and support validation and audit activities by maintaining SDLC documentation, change records, and evidence packages.
* Partner with Legal and Ethics & Compliance to embed governance requirements into system workflows and strengthen role/permission hygiene and evidence trails.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, traceability, and control mechanisms are maintained, and champion secure-by-design practices across platform changes.
* Demonstrate strong cyber, privacy and technology risk awareness by partnering with security and risk teams, supporting control implementation, and proactively mitigating operational and regulatory risk.

**4. Operational Excellence & Platform Health:**

* Oversee day-to-day platform health, stability, and performance; serve as system SME with hands-on understanding of integrations, data flows, file transfers, and error management.
* Manage end-to-end vendor relationships, including executive-level engagement, delivery accountability, and service performance.
* Champion platform reliability, scalability, compliance, and secure handling of funding-related data; partner with engineering and operations teams to resolve complex, cross-system issues and proactively mitigate risk.
* Monitor system usage, operational KPIs, performance trends, process efficiency, and user satisfaction to continuously improve platform health.

**5. Business Value & Adoption:**

* Define, baseline, and track operational and adoption KPIs (e.g., cycle time, on-time reviews/throughput, adoption by role, performance trends) and use insights to steer roadmap priorities.
* Plan and coordinate end-user and admin training for releases (training needs assessment, materials, communications, completion tracking), ensuring readiness across regions and stakeholder groups.
* Own change management strategy for platform upgrades and new capabilities; create scalable enablement assets (guides, videos, walkthroughs) and drive continuous improvement in workflow automation and reporting.
* Strengthen platform compliance and audit readiness by championing reliable operating processes, role/permission hygiene, and evidence trails; socialize product updates to enhance stakeholder adoption.

**6. Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Lead recurring working sessions and executive updates with global Medical, Digital, and Compliance stakeholders; serve as the primary product liaison and facilitate decision-making.
* Provide clear communication on roadmap, release updates, and operational performance; translate complex platform topics into concise, decision-ready narratives that build confidence and alignment.
* Facilitate cross-functional alignment across DD&T, Medical Operations, Compliance, and external partners/vendors to ensure stable operations and predictable delivery.
* Present product status and investment recommendations to senior leadership; oversee tooling and licensing spend, and support procurement, contract renewals, and business case development.

***EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:***
**:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and/or Digital Medical related fields or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of SaaS product management experience in complex enterprise platforms and/or regulated business workflows; proven ability to lead large, cross-functional initiatives from concept to production.
* Executive-ready communication and facilitation skills; ability to influence without authority across global organizations.
* Strong governance, prioritization, and risk-management mindset; comfortable operating in a regulated environment with audit and validation expectations.
* Technical fluency comfort working with integrations, APIs, data pipelines, and system interfaces (Datavision ecosystem experience preferred).
* Experience with information security, privacy, and technology risk controls linked to digital applications; champions secure-by-design changes.
* Data-driven approach to performance, adoption, and value measurement; continuous-improvement orientation with strong learning agility (life sciences experience strongly preferred).
* Experience driving structured change in large organizations and working in an agile environment; proactive adoption of modern tools and AI-enabled ways of working.

**Benefits:**
It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are
  
  

* Competitive Salary + Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
* Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children

title: Technical Product Owner – Veeva QMS
description:
**Purpose of this position / Position summary**

Your Talent, our Vision – together we see beyond. You’re starting at ZEISS Vision Care. As a leading manufacturer of ophthalmic lenses, we help people around the world achieve clearer vision – sustainably and with focus on the future.

Our products are as diverse as the career paths we offer, from tailored lenses to award-winning measurement systems. Become part of our team and shape a future in which clear vision and professional success go hand in hand.

The Technical Product Owner for Veeva QMS will play a key role in the global implementation and adoption of Veeva Quality Management System capabilities within VISION. The position bridges business quality processes and IT solution delivery, ensuring that requirements from Qual-ity, Manufacturing, Regulatory, and related business functions are translated into scalable, compliant, and harmonized system capabilities. The role requires a strong understanding of regulated environments such as healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical device, and GxP-relevant industries, including quality system expectations under standards and frameworks such as ISO 13485, and applicable GxP requirements.

**Primary duties and responsibilities :**

* Act as Technical Product Owner for the implementation, rollout, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Veeva QMS capabilities within VISION;
* Translate business requirements from Quality Management, Manufacturing, Laboratory, Regulatory, and GxP-relevant stakeholders into clear functional and technical product backlog items
* Define, prioritize, and manage the product backlog, including user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and release priorities in alignment with business value, compliance, and inspection-readiness needs;
* Support process and solution design for core QMS processes such as deviations, CAPA, change control, audits, complaints, document control, training, quality events, and management oversight activities
* Ensure effective integration and data alignment between Veeva QMS and relevant enterprise systems, especially SAP QM, LIMS, MES, ERP, and related manufacturing or quality platforms;
* Collaborate with implementation partners, internal IT teams, business process owners, validation teams, and regional/local quality representatives to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions for healthcare, pharma, medical technology, and medical device environments

* Contribute to preparation, support, and follow-up of certification audits, regulatory authority inspections, TÜV audits, and internal/external quality system assessments from a system and process perspective
* Contribute to training concepts, knowledge transfer, documentation, change management, and management reporting on relevant QMS indicators to drive adoption of the Veeva QMS solution across VISION.

* Coordinates the development and development testing process
* Ensuring that defined acceptance criteria have been tested and fulfilled.

* Hands over releases with completed user stories to the BPO for approval.
* Prioritizes and defines technical requirements and tasks in alignment with the BPO.
* Manages and communicates technical requirements towards the BPO.
* Ensure transparent reporting on progress against planned work and agreed delivery dates.

1.
**Education / Professional Certification**

* University degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Quality Management, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or an equivalent qualification.

2.
**Experience**

**3. Skills:**

* Strong functional and technical understanding of Quality Management processes and systems, preferably including Veeva QMS, SAP QM, LIMS, and related enterprise platforms;

* Experience with end-to-end implementation activities including requirements engineering, solution design, backlog management, configuration support, testing, validation, deployment, and hyper care;
* Good understanding of regulated environments, computerized system validation, GxP expectations, data integrity principles, quality compliance requirements, and relevant certification standards such as ISO 13485 and MDSAP;
* Ability to read, understand, and interpret regulatory and quality requirements and trans-late them into practical business processes, system requirements, and implementation priorities;
* Ability to connect business process needs with technical solution capabilities and to communicate effectively with both business and IT stakeholders;
* Experience in integrating QMS processes with SAP QM, MES, LIMS, document management, training, and reporting solutions is an advantage;
* Structured, analytical, and result-oriented working style with the ability to manage complexity, dependencies, and multiple stakeholder expectations in an international environment;
* Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written; German or other languages are an advantage.

title: Senior Product Associate
description:
**Job Description**
Our team is at the heart of building and improving the servicing technology that supports every aspect of the Chase offering, including new market expansion. We are looking for solution-oriented, commercially minded, customer-focused product talent, used to working in an agile environment, who want to be part of building an exceptional user experience within a diverse and inclusive team.
  
  
As a Senior Product Associate at JPMorganChase within the International Consumer Bank, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and supports the end-to-end product life cycle. You act as the voice of the customer, turning customer and operational problems into requirements that deliver measurable value. Partnering closely with engineering, design, operations and control colleagues, you help guide features from discovery through launch, gather feedback, and ensure a top-tier client experience — with a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency and stability.
  
  
You will help lead the development, testing, implementation and maintenance of our Voice & Chat platform (Amazon Connect) to enable delivery of an industry-leading customer service experience across the UK and Germany, scaling to other European markets.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the roadmap and objectives for our customer service operations technology platform, owning defined voice and chat journeys end-to-end
* Take responsibility for the successful delivery of your product areas, ensuring they meet the acceptance criteria of your stakeholders
* Translate customer and agent problems into PRDs, epics and INVEST user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria
* Partner with the Tech Lead and Solution Architects to ensure alignment and feasibility of product, technical vision and requirements across Amazon Connect, AWS services and Salesforce
* Create testing and implementation plans, and support release readiness and post-launch validation
* Ensure the product meets all legal, regulatory, risk and control requirements across UK and EU regimes
* Define baselines and track outcomes against platform metrics such as FCR, AHT, CSAT and NPS
* Represent Product in availability, incident and resilience reviews, converting findings into prioritised backlog items
* Be hands-on, detail-oriented and outcome-focused, as well as a strong team player
* Demonstrate experience delivering and scaling customer service operations technology products
* Have experience in a complex software environment with Agile/Scrum development

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Show strong experience with planning, prioritizing and maintaining product backlogs
* Demonstrate strong experience assessing value, developing cases, and prioritizing stories, epics and themes so that work focuses on maximum value and aligns with product strategy
* Possess strong working knowledge of Agile principles, processes and best practices
* Exhibit experience with hypothesis-driven development, product experimentation and product analytics
* Communicate strongly and feel comfortable explaining design, architecture and roadmap to a wide range of audiences from both technology and business backgrounds
* Demonstrate sound judgement on regulatory, risk and control requirements within financial services
* Good understanding of process mapping and customer journey mapping
* Experience with CaaS products and Operations or Customer Service
* Knowledge of Amazon Connect and its out-of-the-box functionality and tools
* Exposure to Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms
* Experience delivering across multiple European markets

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Awareness of conversational AI or AI features around this domain

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
  
  
The Digital team is dedicated to creating innovative, industry-leading products and experiences that help customers access, share and control their financial data so they can make smart decisions with their money. Teams enable innovation while adhering to the firm's data sharing principles of security, customer control and convenience, and privacy.

title: DevRel Engineer II
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.
  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
  
  
**About The Role**
HackerRank’s coding challenge library is the foundation of how companies identify top technical talent. As a DevRel Engineer, you’ll drive the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of products that expand our skills coverage, raise content quality, and increase adoption among customers.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, design, and content. You’ll define product requirements, translate complex business and customer needs into scalable solutions, and partner with a global network of subject matter experts. You’ll also work closely with customers to shape workflows and ensure our assessments remain relevant, fair, and impactful for developers and hiring teams worldwide.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Build and manage a global network of experts to create coding challenges.
* Own the product roadmap for HackerRank’s coding challenge platform and content ecosystem.
* Build and evolve tools that scale content delivery, improve quality, and support emerging technologies.
* Partner with customers to deeply understand their workflows and deliver tailored solutions that drive adoption and impact.
* Use data, automation, and AI to streamline content creation and review processes.
* Ensure every product and feature shipped upholds high standards of fairness, validity, and developer experience.

**Who You Are**

* A strategic yet hands-on product thinker, known for operational excellence and the ability to drive execution from concept to delivery.
* Strong technical foundation across any of the following domains: frontend, backend, cloud, AI/ML, and DevOps (e.g., React, Angular, Node, Spring Boot, AWS, Jenkins, GenAI).
* Bring 3+ years of software development experience in fast-paced environments and modern stacks.
* Adept at working closely with engineers, speaking their language, and translating complex technical problems into clear product direction.
* Comfortable using product and collaboration tools such as GitHub, JIRA, Slack, and analytics platforms.

**Even better if you have**

* Experience contributing to open-source.
* Exposure to open-source communities and other developer ecosystems.
* Familiarity with AI-driven workflows for scaling products.

**You will thrive in this role if**

* You’re a builder at heart, excited to create scalable systems from the ground up.
* Ambiguity doesn’t slow you down, you bring clarity, structure, and crisp execution.
* You care deeply about developer experience, customer impact, and raising the bar in technical hiring.
* Collaboration energizes you, whether it’s with engineers, customers, or global experts.

**Want to learn more about HackerRank?**
Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.
  
  
HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Linkedin | X | Blog | Instagram | Life@HackerRank

* Our Recruiters use @hackerrank.com email addresses.

title: Product Localisation Lead - India
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste!
  
  
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
  
  
**Where And How You Can Work**
Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
  
  
**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**

* Own Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages.
* Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives.
* Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion.
* Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages.
* Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions.
* Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and Product
* Manage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region.
* Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs.

**Qualifications**
What we're looking for
  
  

* 5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth SaaS or product-led company.
* Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption.
* Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces.
* Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams.
* Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments.
* A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing.
* Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design.

**Additional Information**
**About the Group/Team**
Canva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution.
  
  
In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India.
  
  
**About The Role/Specialty**
As the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences.
  
  
This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale.

title: Principal Manager, Tech (Treasury Tech)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
**Overview**
We are looking for an exceptional Principal Manager to join the Treasury Tech team in the firm’s office in Bengaluru. Treasury Tech was established in 2021 to integrate DESCO and Arcesium-owned datasets, enabling sophisticated reporting and advanced analytics for Treasury functions. The team partners closely with Front Office systems to deliver critical margin simulation and broker optimization workflows. Core focus areas include measuring broker profitability and building tools to optimize cash and collateral usage while supporting broker negotiations through standardized data views and comparative analytics. A key capability is providing a unified interface for margin simulation, both pre-trade and intraday integrated with Front Office systems to facilitate portfolio and prime broker optimization across complex, multi-counterparty environments. Treasury Tech also delivers insights into total counterparty spend, identifying drivers of commissions and financing costs, while automating manual reporting processes to improve operational efficiency across CRM and Treasury teams. Additionally, the team enhances broker risk reporting to enable proactive monitoring and pre emptive action, helping avoid agreement terminations and excessive collateral requirements by delivering advanced simulation, optimization, and analytics capabilities.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will execute individual projects and deliverables while collaborating closely with DESCO Treasury and other business groups to deeply understand their workflows, challenges, and requirements. You will leverage technology to ideate, design, and deliver high-quality solutions that address complex business needs. Your responsibilities will include performing research and development to evaluate appropriate technologies, resolving application and data issues in production within defined timelines, and driving complete project lifecycles from requirements gathering and analysis through project delivery and deployment to clients. You will provide direction and guidance to junior team members, actively participate in code and design reviews, and champion engineering best practices to ensure robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
**Basic qualifications:**

* A bachelor's/master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 8 to 12 years of Software Engineering experience
* Proficiency in Python with robust coding and debugging abilities
* Thorough understanding of software development principles, quantitative abilities, data structures, architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies
* Experience or knowledge of frontend technologies such as React/Redux/Angular/Javascript/NodeJS
* Exposure in managing small to medium-sized teams and in project management
* Attention to detail, effectiveness in interdisciplinary teams, and the ability to work autonomously with focus and discipline
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical skills, and passion for technology
* Excellent communication, creative and strategic thinking skills, and technical expertise to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Prior experience in the financial domain of working with investment banks, HFTs or fintech-based startups

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/ProjMan2026
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Engineering Manager

title: Readiness Architect
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
******About Salesforce******
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
****About Salesforce****
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
Salesforce is transforming the way prospects, customers and Trailblazers interact with the company on the web. We are unifying the digital experience of online visitors across corporate brand websites and our Trailblazer ecosystem on a shared digital platform. The result will be dynamic and personalized based on a visitors role, industry, and location. It will also be a showcase of Salesforce products.
  
  
Role Scope
  
  
As a member of the Cloud Success Readiness team, you will be deeply invested in every aspect of the Agentforce and/or Data Cloud customer experience. You will work closely with Readiness Architects, Technology & Product (T&P) and our Customer Success Group (CSG) teams to ensure that we are delivering customer success to every customer at scale.
  
  
Cloud Success Readiness improves customer Adoption and Product Quality by proactively addressing the most relevant customer needs, and by readying our stakeholders to deliver product innovation to our customers. As a Readiness Architect, you will be responsible for understanding the Agentforce and Data Cloud product portfolio, maintaining deep knowledge of product capabilities, and how they map to key customer use cases. You will leverage your product knowledge and technical expertise to surface product insights and recommendations, and document Agentforce and Data Cloud Product Feedback for the T&P organization. You’ll work closely with Cloud Success teams, including Success Architects, Success Guides, Support Engineers, and Account Success stakeholders to scale your product expertise and knowledge of the product lifecycle to better enable their work with customers.
  
  
We manage our work via Strategic Initiatives across the product lifecycle including new products and features, end-of-life retirements, and strategic programs such as migration or adoption efforts. We act as early adopters to bring architectural guidance, product expertise, innovation, and knowledge capital to our stakeholders in Customer Success and Technology & Products.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be comfortable collaborating within a larger team of subject matter experts and developing key stakeholder relationships across the organization to influence decision making.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Maintain deep understanding of Agentforce and Data Cloud products and roadmap and engage with T&P and CSG stakeholders in the development of Agentforce and Data Cloud product feedback, roadmaps, strategic readiness plans, and customer adoption plays.
* Develop expertise for all new product and feature introductions, large-scale migration efforts or product retirements. Document best practices and learnings from product interaction (e.g. pilots, pre-launch discovery) to deliver to Cloud Success teams —including Success Architects, Success Guides, Support Engineers, and Account Success stakeholders— and deliver readiness for scale.
* Collaborate closely with your Readiness Architect team, leveraging your product, domain and business knowledge to create a holistic POV and strategic approach that supports the overall Agentforce and Data Cloud strategy and customer success, working with stakeholders across the organization.
* Maintain deep technical, functional and domain knowledge across all in-market and new products. Practice continuous learning through first-hand product experimentation and participation in Product-driven betas, pilots and collaboration with SMEs in the Success Ecosystem.
* Identify, document, and track all recommended product enhancements reflecting inputs from customer, partner and internal stakeholders. Develop product requirements and deliver to Product Leadership for roadmap consideration.

description:

We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
*At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.*
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of digital products within CTI-MD. This role is ideal for a product professional who combines strong product management fundamentals with hands-on technical expertise and can effectively bridge business, engineering, data, and operations teams.
  
  
The successful candidate will own products from discovery through delivery and adoption, partnering closely with scientists, business stakeholders, engineers, architects, data teams, and quality teams to solve complex business challenges within the pharmaceutical and life sciences domain.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. While the primary responsibility is product leadership, the individual should be comfortable reading code, writing prototypes, analysing data, developing proof-of-concepts, and contributing technically when necessary.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Product Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a small to medium product, or for a major component of a larger CTI-MD product.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, opportunities, and unmet needs.
* Translate business objectives into clear product strategies, measurable outcomes, and prioritized roadmaps.
* Define and track product success metrics and business value realized, demonstrating measurable improvement in key departmental KPIs.
* Identify market and industry opportunities that inform product direction and business unit goals.

**Product Discovery**

* Lead discovery activities including user research, workflow analysis, process mapping, and solution evaluation.
* Develop deep understanding of business processes and operational workflows.
* Validate assumptions through experimentation, data analysis, prototypes, and user feedback.

**Technical Product Leadership**

* Work closely with engineering teams to shape technical solutions and architecture decisions.
* Translate business requirements into detailed product and technical requirements.
* Evaluate technology options, architectural trade-offs, integrations, scalability, and technical risks.
* Drive data-driven, and platform-thinking approaches.

**Delivery & Execution**

* Partner with engineering teams through design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Manage product backlogs and prioritization decisions.
* Balance customer needs, business priorities, compliance requirements, and technical constraints.
* Ensure products are delivered with quality, security, and operational excellence.

**AI & Digital Innovation**

* Identify opportunities for AI, automation, analytics, and digital technologies within CTI-MD products.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering and AI-enabled product development practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and their potential application to business challenges.

**Team First Mentality**

* Bring a no-ego, team-first mindset to all interactions, prioritizing shared success over individual recognition.
* Represent the product team with humility and integrity when engaging with stakeholders and partners.

**Knowledge Sharing & Coaching**

* Share specialized product management practices and domain-specific insights to help team members grow.
* Coach peers and engineering partners on discovery, prioritization, and outcome-based product practices.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong relationships across business, scientific, regulatory, quality, and technology functions.
* Present product strategy, roadmap updates, and outcome metrics to leadership.
* Influence stakeholders across departments without formal authority, in global and cross-functional settings.
* Make informed product decisions that balance business needs, technical constraints, and user value.

**Your Minimum Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline.

**Experience**

* 6+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Product Ownership, or related roles.
* Experience leading software products through the full product lifecycle.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams in Agile environments.
* Demonstrated success delivering business outcomes through digital products.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong technical depth, with the ability to engage credibly in architecture and design discussions and to contribute hands-on when required.
* Working knowledge of software engineering and system design fundamentals, including APIs, integrations, and scalability trade-offs.
* Experience with cloud and data platforms.
* Practical understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts and how they apply to enterprise products.
* Familiarity with modern SDLC and DevOps practices, and with security, privacy, and compliance considerations in regulated environments.
* Read and reason about production code well enough to partner effectively with engineers on technical issues.
* Build prototypes, proofs-of-concept, scripts, or automations to test ideas and de-risk decisions.

**What You Should Bring**

* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, Clinical Development, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, or R&D domains.
* Understanding of GxP, validation, data integrity, and regulated environments.
* Experience working with scientific, clinical, manufacturing, or laboratory systems.
* Experience with AI-enabled products, data products, or enterprise platforms.
* MBA or advanced technical degree is a plus.

We are a deeply technical, execution-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards. Our engineers, product leaders, and go-to-market teams work closely together — in person and across functions — to build systems that scale in the real world. If you’re excited to work on hard problems, move with urgency, raise the bar every day, and help build agentic systems that transform how the world works, Eightfold is the place to do it.

The rules of building software have changed. What used to take a large team many months can now be built by a small, focused team in a fraction of the time. AI has collapsed the cost and time of software creation by an order of magnitude — and this shift is not coming, it is here.
  
  
Eightfold has an opportunity to help every customer reimagine their talent tech stack. We have deep domain expertise, world-class data infrastructure, and new internal capabilities that turn product vision into working software in days, not quarters.

We’re extending the platform into new areas and giving them far more control over how they build on top of it. Workflows become customizable. APIs become headless. Customers can shape the product around their organization, wire it into their own systems and agents, and treat the platform as a foundation rather than a fixed box.

This role demands technical curiosity, and a passion for creating enterprise SaaS products that push the boundaries of what AI can do in HR tech.
  
  
If you’re excited about using AI to shape the future of work and help organizations unlock the full potential of their workforce, this opportunity is for you.
