title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager - myRico

HSR, Bangalore, India

**Mission**

The best teams spend too much time keeping work moving. Context is scattered across conversations, documents and tools. Decisions get lost. Dependencies go unnoticed. Someone has to remember what matters, connect the dots and follow through.

We’re building myRico to help carry that work.

Our ambition is an AI teammate that understands your company—its goals, people, decisions and ways of working—and uses that understanding to help the team get things done. A teammate that earns trust through useful work, sound judgment and dependable follow-through.

Our starting point is helping software teams move projects from intent to delivery. Success means less effort spent coordinating and correcting work, and a shorter path to an outcome the team can stand behind.

**The role**

We’re hiring our founding Product Manager to help turn that ambition into a product that teams rely on every day.

You’ll work closely with the founders, engineers and early customers to figure out where Rico creates the most value, what we should build next and whether it actually works. You’ll own the loop from understanding a problem to shipping a solution, watching people use it and making it better.

Some of the hardest questions are also the most interesting. When should Rico act on its own? When should it ask? What should it remember? How does it earn permission to take on more responsibility? How do we know it has saved someone time once we account for the effort of directing, reviewing and correcting it?

In practice, you might spend a morning watching a customer run a project, prototype a better workflow that afternoon, and work with engineering to put it in their hands that week. You’ll read conversations, investigate failures, challenge assumptions and make the small product decisions that determine whether an AI teammate feels useful or exhausting.

You’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. That means choosing a few problems worth solving deeply, making clear tradeoffs and staying accountable for what happens after launch.

This role is based in Bangalore and would require 5 days in office.

**What we’re looking for**

* **Customer obsession.**
  You get close enough to users to understand how their work actually happens, including the workarounds they’ve stopped noticing.
* **Product judgment.**
  You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear decision about what to build, what to leave out and what evidence would change your mind.
* **A builder’s instinct.**
  You use prototypes, experiments and AI tools to make ideas tangible and learn quickly.
* **Technical fluency.**
  You can reason with engineers about AI behavior, memory, integrations, permissions and the tradeoffs between quality, latency and cost.
* **Care for the details.**
  You notice when an interaction creates confusion, a notification interrupts at the wrong time or a confident answer hasn’t earned that confidence.
* **Ownership.**
  You follow a problem through discovery, delivery and adoption. You stay with it when the first solution falls short.
* **Clear communication.**
  You write precisely, explain your reasoning and disagree thoughtfully.

**Experience**

You’ve helped take a product or meaningful feature from an unclear problem to real usage. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs you accepted and what you learned when users surprised you.

Your background might be product management, engineering, design or founding a company. We care about evidence of good judgment and useful things you’ve shipped.

This role will be a poor fit if

* You need a fully defined roadmap before you can make progress.
* You prefer handing off requirements to staying involved through implementation and adoption.
* You’re uncomfortable spending substantial time with customers or examining where the product fails.
* You find it difficult to change direction when the evidence challenges your original idea.

Bonus

* You’ve built an AI product and dealt with its behavior in real use.
* You’ve worked on collaboration tools, developer products or complex business workflows.
* You’ve been a founder or an early employee at a startup.
* You can build working prototypes yourself.

title: IT Product Owner - Intelligent Service Management
description:
**About This Opportunity**
**Purpose:**
The IT Product Owner (IPO) is End to End responsible for the strategy and delivery of the product based on the product roadmap, ensuring the Product delivers the expected business value, throughout the Product lifecycle.
  
  
The IT Product Owner (IPO) manages the Product through the product lifecycle in alignment with the Product Line and Product Area Strategy.
  
  
**What Will You Do**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Operational:**

* Understand customer/end-user needs and translate requirements and strategies to meaningful demands and use cases for product development.
* Define and optimize product strategy and roadmap
* Ensuring non-functional requirements, security, and regulatory compliance of the product according to the rules, guidelines, governance, and applicable processes.
* Set and achieve the Product OKRs and ensure that the Product delivers the expected business value.
* Manage stakeholders and dependencies across organizations.
* Accountable for financial planning, forecasting, budget requests and actuals.
* Alignment with delivery Leads for competence requests and providing forecast.
* Ensures that both a long term (strategy) and short term (backlog) perspective is included in the product development.
* Guide the product team in sprint planning, prioritization and sequencing of user stories.
* Ensure that the Product adheres to the required approvals for Product design and development according to the rules, guidelines, governance, and processes applicable.
* E2E-accountability for product delivery, including operational responsibility, through the product lifecycle.
* Contribute to commercial discussions together with Sourcing and Suppliers (internal and external)
* Contribute to governance meetings with suppliers and stakeholders.
* Managing interactions with service providers and ensure they deliver on agreed performance levels (contractual or non-contractual)
* Secure that all services are priced, orderable, measurable, and supported.
* Responsible for coaching the product team and to ensure that the product team(s) has the right competence mix to enable successful execution.

**Role Specific:**

* This role is for the Product Owner of Intelligent Service Management Platform within Product Line IT4IT.
* The product owner will define and drive the evolution of Service Management towards an intelligent, autonomous, and experience-centric operating model, moving beyond traditional ITSM practices through the adoption of AI, predictive insights, proactive operations, hyper automation, and next-generation service experiences.
* The product owner is expected to have a deep understanding of the platform used IT Service Management (Incident, Change, Problem, Request and Knowledge Management)
* The product owner will be responsible for driving AI-enabled and intelligent automation within ITSM — identifying where predictive analytics, chatbots/virtual agents, and generative or agentic AI capabilities can meaningfully reduce manual effort, improve resolution speed, and elevate the employee/customer experience, while ensuring adoption is measured, governed, and responsible.
* Champion responsible AI use — data quality (clean configuration and knowledge data as AI input), bias/accuracy monitoring, and change management for AI-assisted workflows.
* The product owner will be responsible for keeping abreast with industry trends in this area and be able to create a strategy and vision, to create the most effective Service Management Platform within IT.
* Work with stakeholders both internally (EIT and other IT organizations, Security, Sourcing) as well as externally (Vendors, industry pioneers) to find the best outcomes for Ericsson
* Overall E2E cost responsible for the product, as well as billing, chargeback, wherever needed

**Things You Will Bring**
**Requirements:**

* Demonstrated ability to challenge traditional ITSM approaches and define future-state service management operating models that leverage AI, automation, predictive capabilities, and digital employee experience principles.
* Proven track record of driving platform modernization and transformation initiatives, balancing innovation with operational stability and business value realization.
* Proven experience as a Product Owner or similar role in IT product management, preferably in Service Management, or asset management sectors.
* Experience identifying and implementing AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, virtual agents, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation use cases within enterprise service management environments.
* Understanding of responsible AI principles, including data quality, governance, adoption measurement, risk management, and performance monitoring.
* Strong understanding of employee and customer experience management principles, including service adoption, user journey mapping, service health metrics, and experience-centric design.
* Ability to translate business challenges into scalable digital workflows and self-service capabilities that improve productivity and service satisfaction.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage platform telemetry, operational metrics, and business insights to drive product decisions and continuous improvement.
* Experience defining and tracking product KPIs, value realization metrics, and business outcomes.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across IT, Security, Enterprise Architecture, Sourcing, and business leadership teams.
* Ability to build and execute a long-term product strategy while balancing short-term operational priorities and enterprise objectives.
* Strong background in managing the product lifecycle from inception to delivery.
* Excellent understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and project management practices.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.**

At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. title: Technical Product Owner
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY:**
As the Technical Product Owner you will need to be technically strong and product-minded as you will be leading the development and evolution of our Content Sourcing Systems!
  
  
You will be responsible for defining platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient collection of all non-realtime data for LSEG Data and Analytics.
  
  
You’ll be joining our Data Platforms Sourcing Engineering team as a Senior Technical Product Owner. This team’s products are the tools used by Content Operations and Data Scientists to find, retrieve, check, validate and transform all the data behind LSEG’s provision of financial market data to over 40,000 customers.
  
  
You will work with customers across LSEG to define new tools and capabilities that consolidate, modernise and grow D&A’s data collection.
  
  
By building trust with partners, managing expectations transparently, and ensuring alignment across teams, you will build solutions that provide measurable business value. Success will be measured not only by delivery, but also by adoption, customer satisfaction, and time-to-value.
  
  
**Key responsibilities will include:**

* Defining, prioritizing, and delivering desirable, feasible, viable, and secure Sourcing products.
* Creating the product vision/roadmap, managing the program backlog, identifying customer needs, and aligning ART efforts with business strategy.
* Articulating the roadmap, value decisions and trade-offs, and priorities to customers across the organisation, including senior leaders and non-technical staff.
* Drive PI planning to ensure teams are aligned on outcomes, dependencies and integration

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**
**Platform Ownership:**
Own and evolve the product vision, roadmap, and strategy for Sourcing Engineering and its core capabilities, acting as the interface between the business stakeholders and development teams.
  
  
**Product Backlog & Outcome:**
Own and communicate a product backlog of epics and features, leading trade-off decisions to balance customer needs, architectural integrity, and business value.
  
  
**Capability Development:**
Define and deliver new platform features to support self-service teams to meet their goals of agility and flexibility in the creation and delivery of data products.
  
  
**Strategic Road mapping:**
Collaborate with engineering, operations and data strategy leadership to shape the long-term platform strategy based on customer insights, emerging technologies, and enterprise needs.
  
  
**Modern Product Practices:**
Together with System Architect and Release Train Engineer, lead large-scale agile delivery (SAFe), manage cross-team coordination, and ensure transparency across stakeholders.
  
  
**Developer Enablement:**
Champion design thinking and user journey clarity to ensure features address real user needs; attend demos and provide approval when deliverables meet business needs.
  
  
**Agile Ceremony Cadence:**
Drive ART readiness for PI Planning by coordinating across interested parties including, Product Owners, technology, and Business Owners to align scope and objectives.
  
  
**Cross ART Collaboration:**
Work with other ARTs to set product goals and roadmap; promote shared accountability across functions & streams and proactively calling out blockers & risks to ensure a “no-surprises” environment.
  
  
**Innovation, Security & Compliance:**
Champion new technologies and processes, balanced against the need to maintain rigorous security controls, and compliance with applicable regulations and laws.
  
  
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* 15+ years of professional experience in product management, product ownership, and data or platform engineering or a related field.
* Proven ability to communicate succinctly with functional teams, partners of all levels and leadership.
* Product ownership experience working with Scrum teams, attending scrum ceremonies, owning the scrum team backlog.
* Ability to elicit requirements from customers and articulate them as hierarchical user story format (Epics, Features, Stories).
* Financial services experience; knowledge of data used within financial services.
* Experience of Agile methodologies, ideally with a certification (SAFe or similar).
* Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM education.
* Preferred Skills
* Hands-On JIRA and Confluence proficiency, familiarity with agile reporting dashboards.
* Knowledge and experience with end-to-end processes of data collection, processing, and distribution, including understanding of data operations/content operations workflows.
* Exposure to technology platforms, architecture principles, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with value stream mapping, process improvement, and user journey design.
* Strong analytical approach with a focus on measurable outcomes and business value

**What You’ll Get In Return**
**High-impact projects:**
We work on a variety of pioneering AI products and leverage extensive datasets to solve complex, high-value challenges.
  
  
**Competitive benefits:**
You will enjoy a strong compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing investment in career growth and skill development.
  
  
**Industry leadership:**
This is an opportunity to be a founding member of the organization that’s delivering brand-new products that democratize modeling and analytics solutions.
  
  
**Collaborative environment**
: We provide opportunities for continuous learning and professional development in a work environment of dedicated, highly experienced teams.
  
  
We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take a hybrid approach to the workplace; this role is considered ‘digital first’, which requires attending the office at least one day per week while some teams and colleagues choose to collaborate in the office more frequently.
  
  
You will experience the critical role we have in helping to re-engineer the financial ecosystem to support and drive sustainable economic growth. Together, we are aiming to achieve this growth by accelerating the just transition to net zero, enabling growth of the green economy and creating inclusive economic opportunity.
  
  
**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**

title: Manager, Product Management — Sourcing & Procurement
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Product Management — Sourcing & Procurement**
**Zora AI™ by Deloitte | Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**
**About The Role**
Zora AI™ by Deloitte is Deloitte's agentic AI platform, delivering role- and function-specific products — including Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Customer, and Human Capital — built on the NVIDIA AI stack and underpinned by Deloitte's Trustworthy AI™ framework.
  
  
Deloitte is looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own the
**Sourcing & Procurement product area**
within Zora AI end-to-end. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the roadmap, the team, and the outcomes for a defined slice of the procurement portfolio — spanning requisitioning, sourcing and RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding and collaboration, and purchase-to-pay — turning real practitioner pain points into digital workers that deliver measurable value. You'll set direction in partnership with the Product Lead, run discovery and delivery across multiple workstreams, and bring deep procurement domain expertise to every decision, all while ensuring trust, adoption, and business impact for enterprise users.
  
  
This is a builder's role with real ownership: you're accountable not just for what your team ships, but for the vision, prioritization, and people behind it. You'll work closely with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and you'll mentor and grow the Consultants and Analysts around you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for the Sourcing & Procurement product area, and take a lead role — alongside the Product Lead — in shaping the 12–18 month vision and strategy
* Make prioritization and trade-off calls across multiple workstreams (requisition, sourcing/RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding, purchase-to-pay), sequencing by value, effort, and readiness
* Define and own the KPIs that prove impact: adoption, efficiency gains, cost reduction, supplier performance, and workflow completion
* Know when something isn't working — flag it early, make the case to change course, and retire low-value work fast

**Discover & Validate**

* Lead discovery to understand procurement practitioners, category managers, and finance stakeholders, and translate what you hear into prioritized, high-value use cases
* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and competitive analysis of procurement platforms before committing to build at scale
* Use generative and evaluative research to continuously answer "are we building the right thing?" and "are we building it right?"

**Ship as One Team**

* Take features and agent capabilities from concept through define, shape, build, and scale
* Own PRDs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow diagrams for agent behaviors, tool use, human-in-the-loop patterns, and exception handling across your product area
* Run sprint planning, reviews, and the daily cadence that keeps delivery moving with engineering, data science, and design
* Own launch, adoption, and iteration — instrument the product and act on what the telemetry and voice-of-customer data show
* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery

**Trust & Governance**

* Partner with risk, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to define evaluation approach, monitoring plans, auditability, and governance requirements aligned to the Trustworthy AI™ framework
* Own trust and audit-readiness outcomes for your product area, including policy adherence and reduction of high-severity model risks

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients — lead demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations with procurement leaders and category managers, and turn what you hear into roadmap decisions
* Own go-to-market inputs for your area: positioning, pricing/packaging input, demos, and enablement, partnering with sales, alliances, and delivery on pursuits, pilots, and launches
* Stay fluent in the market realities shaping procurement products: data privacy, ERP/CRM ecosystems, connector marketplaces, and SaaS vs. on-prem considerations

**Work Across the Network & Lead the Team**

* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align the product area with delivery capacity and real client needs
* Mentor and develop the Consultants and Analysts on your team, raising the bar on product craft, and act as the go-to escalation point for your product area
* Collaborate with Sourcing & Procurement SMEs to collect product feedback and establish an advisory council

**Key Deliverables**

* Owned roadmap and delivery for the Sourcing & Procurement product area, with direct input into broader portfolio strategy
* PRDs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria across all agent capabilities in your area
* Use-case catalog and prioritization framework (value, feasibility, risk, readiness)
* MVP/pilot plans with success metrics, rollout phases, and scale criteria
* Trust & governance artifacts: evaluation approach, monitoring plan, audit/logging requirements
* Release plans and launch-readiness inputs (docs, training, demo scripts, enablement)
* Customer feedback loop: telemetry dashboards, voice-of-customer insights, iteration plan
* Development plans and coaching cadence for direct reports/mentees

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Adoption: active users, repeat usage, workflow completion rates, feature utilization
* Business impact: cycle-time reduction, cost-to-serve/spend reduction, supplier performance and exception-resolution improvements
* Quality & reliability: task success rate, low rework/rollback rates, latency/uptime, healthy incident trends
* Trust & compliance: audit readiness, policy adherence, governance review outcomes
* Delivery excellence: roadmap predictability, on-time releases, stakeholder satisfaction
* Team leadership: growth and performance of mentees/direct reports, delivery quality across the product area
* Customer outcomes: pilot-to-scale conversion, referenceable wins in procurement engagements

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to a Senior Manager / AVP of Product Management. Works as one team with engineering, data science, and design; partners with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders; collaborates with GTM, account, risk/compliance, and Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India. May mentor or informally guide Consultants and Analysts on the team.
  
  
**Working Model & Stakeholders**
Remote + hybrid model (typically 2–3 days onsite), with flexibility based on team and client needs, operating in agile product teams on a regular release cadence.
  
  
Core stakeholders: Engineering (platform + product squads), Data Science/Applied AI, Design/Research, Cybersecurity & Privacy, Risk/Legal/Compliance, Domain SMEs (procurement, sourcing, supply chain, finance), Sales/Alliances/Delivery, and client-side procurement leaders, category managers, process owners, IT, and operations.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 8–12 years in product management or product ownership, including owning a product area end-to-end with measurable business outcomes
* Track record of shipping products or major features from discovery to launch, and leading through ambiguity across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Strong hands-on product craft: backlog, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and day-to-day partnership with engineering and design in an agile setup
* Fluent in discovery and validation — user research, hypothesis testing, experimentation — not just delivery
* Experience delivering products involving AI/ML (GenAI preferred), including evaluation, monitoring, and iteration loops
* Exposure to procurement, sourcing, or supply chain — either as a product focus or through direct stakeholder work — with demonstrated ability to build domain depth quickly
* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders
* Experience mentoring or informally leading other product managers, owners, or analysts
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration patterns (APIs, identity/SSO, RBAC, data pipelines)

title: Group Product Manager
description:
**About WorkIndia:**

WorkIndia is India's largest blue- and grey-collar hiring platform, built with a clear purpose: to provide meaningful livelihoods to 23.7 crore blue-collar individuals across India.

WorkIndia helps millions of job seekers connect with employers across the country. On the employer side, WorkIndia serves tens of thousands of businesses every month, enabling them to discover, evaluate, and hire relevant candidates at scale.

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the Centre of Excellence — WorkIndia's central matchmaking engine. You'll own product strategy and outcomes across the end-to-end hiring funnel, translating company strategy into a roadmap that improves experience and retention on both sides of the marketplace, alongside driving candidate growth.

You will lead a team and work closely with the Head of Product, business leads across the org, and Engineering/Data partners whose infrastructure your roadmap depends on.

This role requires strong product judgment on a genuinely hard, two-sided problem — what looks like a candidate-side fix is often the difference between an employer renewing or churning.

**About the Centre of Excellence (CoE):**

The CoE owns WorkIndia's central matchmaking engine — the capability that drives world-class matching by solving for the end-to-end hiring funnel. This manifests as improved experience and retention on both sides of the marketplace. Additionally, CoE carries the responsibility for candidate supply — acquisition and reactivation.

**What You'll Do:**

Strategic Ownership

* Own and evolve the CoE product strategy in service of WorkIndia's matchmaking goals
* Translate company goals into a clear CoE roadmap
* Balance near-term KPI delivery with longer-term platform investments that unlock them

User Thinking & Product Judgment

* Build deep fluency in consumer behaviour and the drivers of activation and retention
* Ground every roadmap decision in real candidate and employer outcomes, not proxy metrics

Business & Product Leadership

* Own outcomes, not features: growth, retention, and long-term matchmaking capability
* Manage and grow a cross-functional team spanning product management and analytics
* Partner closely with marketing and engineering on channel and delivery strategy
* Represent CoE in cross-functional forums where outcomes are shared with other business units

Execution & Systems Thinking

* Drive roadmap sequencing across near-term fixes and longer-term platform bets
* Convert repeated operational patterns into scalable product systems rather than one-off fixes
* Push for systems that hold up at significant scale, in coordination with platform teams

Data & Decision Making

* Own the CoE metrics tree and use data to prioritise across the charter
* Push the team to instrument outcome metrics over vanity metrics

**Team & Reporting:**

* **Reports to**
  : Head of Product
* **Directly manages**
  : A team spanning product management and analytics
* **Key partners**
  : Marketing, Engineering & Data, other product business units, Design

**What We're Looking For:**

* 9+ years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning large, metric-accountable product areas
* Demonstrated ability to drive both growth and retention/matching-quality metrics
* Strong systems thinking and comfort resolving ambiguity
* Deep data fluency
* Experience managing a cross-functional team
* Marketplace or two-sided consumer product experience strongly preferred

**Why Join WorkIndia?**

* **Impact:**
  Be a part of a mission-driven company that impacts millions of lives daily
* **Growth:**
  High ownership environment where your initiatives directly shape the company culture
* **Location:**
  Work out of our vibrant office in HSR Layout, the startup hub of Bengaluru

title: Product Owner, Workday, US Payroll & Benefits
description:
**Position Overview**
The
**Experienced Product Owner**
is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the
**US Payroll & Benefits**
Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): US Payroll & Benefits end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to configure, test, validate and deploy.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Create design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Own day-to-day delivery.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Nice to have experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience**
**US Payroll**
Payroll processing, tax configuration, and compliance — configuration and operational support.
  
  

* Payroll Processing: Pay group setup, payroll calendars, run categories, gross-to-net calculation, and on/off-cycle run management.
* Earnings & Deductions: Earning codes, deduction codes, arrears handling, garnishments, and pay component mapping from time and compensation.
* Tax Configuration: Federal, state, and local tax setup, reciprocity rules, tax withholding elections, and year-end W-2 processing.
* Compliance: ACA reporting, FLSA overtime, pay equity audits, and regulatory filing support.
* Integrations & Reporting: GL mapping, bank file generation, payroll reconciliation, and audit-ready payroll registers.

**US Benefits**
Benefit plan configuration, open enrollment, and compliance — configuration and operational support.
  
  

* Plan Configuration: Medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, life, disability, and voluntary benefit plan setup including carrier connections.
* Eligibility & Enrollment: Eligibility rules, dependent coverage, qualifying life events, passive and active enrollment configuration.
* Open Enrollment: OE event setup, employee self-service configuration, enrollment windows, and communication triggers.
* ACA Compliance: 1095-C configuration, measurement periods, affordability calculations, and IRS filing support.
* Integrations & Reporting: Benefit carrier file feeds, COBRA administration handoffs, benefit cost reporting, and enrollment audits.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
* Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
* Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

**About Revantage**
Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
  
  
Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. This complexity demands technology professionals who thrive in ambiguity, operate with an enterprise mindset, and can design solutions that scale across legal entities, geographies, and business models.

title: AI Transformation Manager
description:
**The Company**
The Kantata Cloud for Professional Services™ gives businesses the clarity, control, and confidence they need to optimize resource planning and elevate operational performance. Our purpose-built software is helping over 2,500 professional services organizations in more than 100 countries focus on and optimize their most important asset: their people. By leveraging Kantata, professionals gain access to the information and tools they need to win more business, ensure the right people are always available at the right time, and delight clients with exceptional project delivery and outcomes.
  
  
Kantata is well-capitalized, hiring, and growing our loyal and diversified customer base faster than we ever have. Most importantly, we have a clear vision of where we’re going and how to get there. (Hint: It involves you.) Did we mention that Kantata is also an awesome place to work? You’ll have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with a team that loves what they do. A talented team, great perks, and an amazing culture = an employee-rated Best Place to Work!
  
  
Did we mention that Kantata is an awesome place to work? You’ll have the opportunity to work in an energetic environment with a smart team that loves what they do.
  
  
**About The Role**
Kantata is building a connected customer journey spanning implementation, adoption, optimization, renewal, and expansion. We’re seeking an AI Transformation Manager to lead the application of AI, automation, and workflow redesign across our post-sales organization.
  
  
You will own a portfolio of AI transformation initiatives from opportunity discovery through adoption and measurable business impact. Working across Professional Services, Customer Success, CX Operations, Digital Engagement, Education Services, and Renewals, you will redesign workflows, build and test solutions, lead pilots, and scale what works.
  
  
This is a hands-on transformation role—not a research or traditional project-management position. You’ll be expected to turn business problems into solutions that teams trust and use.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Develop and manage the internal post-sales AI transformation roadmap.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities based on customer impact, business value, feasibility, risk, and time to value.
* Map and redesign workflows to reduce manual work, improve handoffs, accelerate cycle times, and strengthen customer continuity.
* Build prototypes and lightweight solutions using approved AI, agent-building, and no-code or low-code tools.
* Lead initiatives from discovery and requirements through testing, launch, adoption, and optimization.
* Partner with IT, Engineering, Data, Security, and governance teams to transition successful prototypes into secure, scalable solutions.
* Create reusable AI plays, prompts, agents, and digital experiences that extend team capacity.
* Lead training, communications, documentation, and champion programs that drive sustained adoption.
* Establish appropriate human oversight, quality standards, monitoring, and exception processes.
* Measure adoption and business impact, including capacity released, cycle-time improvements, customer outcomes, cost to serve, and renewal readiness.
* Communicate portfolio priorities, progress, risks, and results to executive leadership.

Initial opportunities may include implementation automation, customer-health insights, next-best-action recommendations, AI-generated customer review preparation, renewal-risk detection, and role-based copilots.
  
  
What You Bring
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in business transformation, product or program management, operations, professional services, customer success, revenue operations, or a related field; B2B SaaS experience is strongly preferred.
* A track record of redesigning and scaling cross-functional processes with measurable business results.
* Strong knowledge of the post-sales customer lifecycle, including implementation, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
* Practical experience applying generative AI, workflow automation, copilots, agentic workflows, or no-code and low-code tools to real business processes.
* A product mindset with strengths in problem framing, user discovery, prioritization, experimentation, adoption, and outcome measurement.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, PSA systems, support tools, product analytics, learning platforms, or knowledge systems.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to build business cases, establish baselines, and quantify value.
* Experience leading organizational change and influencing teams without direct authority.
* Sound judgment regarding data quality, privacy, security, responsible AI, and human oversight.
* Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Leading an AI, automation, transformation, or center-of-excellence portfolio.
* Working with PSA platforms or services-oriented SaaS businesses.
* Building workflows with tools such as Workato, Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, Retool, Glean, or comparable platforms.
* Moving prototypes into secure, monitored production environments with Engineering or IT.
* Applying Lean, service design, process mining, change management, or value-stream mapping.
* Understanding services P&L, utilization, and delivery-efficiency metrics.

How You’ll Work
  
  
You are a customer-focused systems thinker and hands-on builder. You can move from an executive roadmap discussion to a frontline workflow session, create a practical first version, test it with users, and apply the rigor required to scale it responsibly.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
AI is central to Kantata’s vision for delivering exceptional customer outcomes without linear headcount growth. This role offers the opportunity to shape how AI transforms post-sales operations, with executive sponsorship and broad cross-functional partnership.
  
  
Kantata offers competitive compensation and benefits, flexible time off, a remote-first environment, and professional-development support. Benefits are based on location and applicable local programs.
  
  
Kantata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Principle Supply Chain AI Solution Lead
description:
**Job Summary:**

* Champion the implementation and scale-up of advanced AI and AI Agent solutions (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot and custom generative AI assistants) across the global supply chain, bridging business needs with digital technology capabilities to accelerate transformation.
* Lead the introduction of new digitalization capabilities by integrating generative AI tools and AI co-worker (Copilot-style) functionalities into supply chain processes, driving greater efficiency, enhanced decision-making, and semi-automation of routine tasks.
* Serve as a cross-functional product owner for supply chain AI initiatives, coordinating with supply chain teams, IT, and data science to ensure AI tools align with business goals, integrate with enterprise systems (ERP, analytics platforms), and deliver measurable value.

**A Day in the Life:**

* Start the day by reviewing AI tool usage and adoption metrics (e.g., how employees are using new Copilot features or AI assistants). Address any overnight user feedback or technical incidents to continuously improve the AI tools’ performance and user experience.
* Mid-morning: Host a workshop with supply chain process owners to identify and prioritize new opportunities where AI co-workers or generative AI could streamline tasks (such as automating data analysis or augmenting planning decisions). Collaboratively outline use cases and gather requirements.
* Midday: Collaborate with IT and data engineering to fine-tune AI configurations or set up Copilot Studio agents and workflows, ensuring solutions are technically sound and securely integrated with SAP/Oracle ERP systems and data platforms.
* Afternoon: Lead a training session for end-users (planners, buyers, analysts) to drive adoption of a new AI capability. Demonstrate real-world scenarios (e.g., using a supply chain Copilot to expedite report generation or analyze inventory) and share best practices to build user confidence.
* Late afternoon: Develop or refine change management communications – such as announcements, how-to guides, FAQs – to support upcoming AI tool releases. Emphasize business benefits, user guidelines, and available support, fostering an environment of openness to digital change.
* End the day by compiling a progress update for leadership. Highlight key milestones (e.g., pilot results, adoption rates, early wins like time saved) and outline next steps or resource needs for the AI roadmap. Plan for future iterations and new AI pilots based on feedback and evolving technology.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* AI & Digital Capability Introduction: Identify, evaluate, and introduce new AI and digital automation tools (including generative AI co-pilots, AI assistants, multi-agent solutions) to digitize and improve supply chain processes. Translate manual or legacy workflows into AI-enabled, efficient operations.
* Enterprise AI Implementation & Integration: Lead cross-functional projects to implement and scale AI co-worker capabilities (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot features, custom Copilot Studio agents) in the supply chain environment. Ensure seamless integration of these solutions with existing systems (ERP, planning tools, data platforms) and embed AI outputs into daily workflows for direct business use.
* Product Ownership & Value Delivery: Act as the Product Owner for supply chain AI initiatives from concept through deployment. Develop business cases, define scope and success metrics, and coordinate development and deployment. Track and communicate value delivered (operational improvements, ROI) to stakeholders.
* Change Management & Adoption: Own the change management strategy for AI tool rollout. Drive user adoption through comprehensive plans – stakeholder alignment, training programs, internal marketing, user support, and feedback loops. Ensure high end-user engagement and smooth transitions to AI-enhanced processes.
* Governance & Compliance: Ensure AI solutions adhere to enterprise governance, security, and responsible AI policies. Obtain necessary approvals (e.g., for sensitive data usage in AI), maintain clear documentation, and enforce guidelines for safe, ethical AI usage in supply chain contexts.

Demonstrated ability to define use cases, configure/implement these tools, manage their rollout and drive successful adoption in a business environment.
* Project & Change Leadership: Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects introducing new technology. Strong skills in change management, including developing user adoption strategies, training plans, and communications to ensure new digital capabilities are embraced by target users.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Familiarity with AI/ML technologies (e.g., basic understanding of large language models, prompt engineering, data analytics). Comfortable working with enterprise systems and integrating digital tools via APIs or low-code platforms (e.g., Power Platform). Able to analyze process data and AI output to refine solutions and demonstrate value.
* Supply Chain Domain Knowledge: Solid knowledge of supply chain processes and systems (planning, procurement, sourcing, logistics) in a manufacturing or operations environment. Understanding of ERP data (SAP/Oracle) and analytics tools in decision-making, to effectively integrate and tailor AI solutions.
* Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills. Able to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders – explaining AI solutions in business terms and gathering business requirements for technical teams. A collaborative team player who can align diverse groups toward common digital goals.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Data Science) is a plus.
* Strategic & Innovative Mindset: Demonstrated ability to shape and execute a digital transformation strategy. Experience identifying opportunities to use AI/digital solutions to solve business challenges, and balancing innovation with governance in a large enterprise context.
* Broader Technology Skills: Familiarity with cloud-based AI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS AI/ML services). Exposure to Robotic Process Automation (RPA) or similar process automation tools. Understanding of data architecture and data governance principles.
* Global Business Experience: Experience working in global, cross-functional teams or multi-site projects. Proven success leading change across different regions or cultures, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs.
* Certifications: Professional certifications in project management (PMP, Agile/Scrum) or change management (e.g., Prosci) are desirable. Any relevant AI/ML or data analytics certifications (e.g., Azure AI, data science) is an advantage, signaling continuous learning.

**Success Measures:**

* Deployment & Adoption: Number and reach of new AI capabilities delivered, and their adoption rates among target users. Measured by active usage metrics and user satisfaction scores, indicating that AI co-worker tools (like Copilot features) are being utilized effectively.
* Process Efficiency Gains: Improvements in supply chain process metrics attributable to AI tools – such as reductions in manual work hours, faster planning cycles or data analysis, increased throughput, or improved accuracy in routine tasks due to AI support.
* Business Impact & ROI: Tangible business value realized from AI initiatives, demonstrated by return on investment or impact on key performance indicators. Examples include cost savings, faster decision making, improved inventory management or service levels, and other quantifiable benefits tied to AI-enabled solutions.

title: Founder's Office
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
  
  
  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote
* Working with: CEO and Cofounder

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
  
  
**About The Role**
You’ll work closely with the founders on some of the most important problems at the company.
  
  
There isn’t a fixed lane for this role. What you work on will depend on what the company needs at the time. That could mean figuring out why a product isn’t growing, launching a new product or market, improving an internal process, working with customers, researching a new opportunity, or taking on a project that simply doesn’t have an obvious owner yet.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. We’re not looking for someone whose job ends at analysing a problem and making a recommendation. You should be comfortable getting into the details and doing the work yourself.
  
  
As the company grows, the problems you work on will change. We expect the role to change with them.
  
  
What you’ll work on
  
  
Depending on the week, you might:
  
  
  

* Take a new idea from a rough hypothesis to something we can actually test
* Dig into a part of the business that isn’t working well, understand why, and fix it
* Work on growth for an existing product, including talking to customers, improving positioning, running experiments, or helping close important deals
* Research a new market, product, partnership, or business opportunity and decide whether it is worth pursuing
* Build a process or internal tool where none exists today
* Work with product and engineering to turn customer or business problems into product changes
* Take ownership of projects that cut across teams and would otherwise fall between the cracks
* Help the founders make decisions by getting to the underlying facts quickly

Some projects will last a few days. Others may become something you own for months.
  
  
What we’re looking for
  
  
  

* You’re good at figuring things out. You can take a vaguely defined problem, ask the right questions, and get to a useful answer without needing a detailed brief
* You’re comfortable doing the work yourself. If something requires talking to customers, going through data, writing copy, building a spreadsheet, or putting together a quick script, you’ll do it
* You have good business judgement. You can distinguish between something that is interesting and something that actually matters
* You’re comfortable with numbers and technology. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be able to work with data and use technology to make yourself more effective
* You communicate clearly. You can write well, explain what you’ve learned, and say when something isn’t working
* You take ownership. Once you take something on, the founders shouldn’t have to keep checking whether it is moving
* You care about details. A lot of this job involves noticing things other people miss and following through on them
* You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Priorities will change and you won’t always have a playbook to follow

We care less about whether you’ve had a “Founder’s Office” title before. You could come from startups, consulting, product, growth, operations, investing, or something else entirely. What matters is whether you can learn quickly and get useful things done.
  
  
What you get
  
  
You’ll work directly with the founders and get exposure to most parts of the company.
  
  
You’ll see how decisions get made, work on problems before they have dedicated teams around them, and have a lot of room to take ownership. If something you start becomes important enough, there’s a good chance you’ll continue to own it.
  
  
This role is a good fit for someone who eventually wants to build a company, run a business or product line, or become a generalist operator at an early-stage company.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Associate, Business Analysis
description:
Voyager (94001), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
  
  
Senior Associate, Business Analysis
  
  
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and relational databases—cutting-edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward to today, and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
  
  
Today, we are a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one, impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry, and each other.
  
  
As a Senior Associate at Capital One, you will apply your analytical skills to major company challenges. You'll team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact how the company manages customer friction and resolution. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.
  
  
**Team Description**
Welcome to Customer Navigator. We are the central nervous system for enterprise-wide customer resolution, serving as the one-stop engine to resolve complaints across all Capital One Lines of Business (LOBs).
  
  
We are not just improving processes; we are completely re-engineering how we understand and resolve customer friction. Our platform aggregates massive amounts of fragmented enterprise data, mapping it into a seamless, chronological "journey format" for our agents. By layering advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning over this data within an easily understandable User Interface (UI), we empower our teams to resolve complex customer issues with unprecedented speed, empathy, and accuracy.
  
  
**Role Description**
General responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Bridge Business and Data: Partner with cross-functional teams (Tech, Lines of Business, Product) to translate complex data requirements into actionable product features for the Customer Navigator platform.
* Analytical Problem Solving: Support the business strategy by analyzing data to identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI for predicting, understanding, and resolving complaints before they escalate.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a liaison between business users and the product team; gather feedback, understand processes, uncover opportunities to improve decision-making, and drive continuous improvement in workflows.
* Data Translation: Interpret and translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that inform complaint resolution strategies.
* Communication: Communicate technical concepts and research results effectively to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and non-specialist colleagues, through structured presentations and storytelling.
* Execution Focus: Display an intense focus on achieving both short- and long-term goals, helping drive business intent and product adoption in an uncertain and fluid environment.

**The ideal candidate is:**

* Inquisitive: You thrive on solving big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
* Technical: You’re comfortable navigating complex analytical solutions and have hands-on experience conducting business analyses using modern data tools.
* Innovative: You continually are on the lookout for novel approaches, solutions, and emerging technologies (like GenAI) to solve business problems and improve the customer experience.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economics, Econometrics, Finance or Operations Research).
* At least 2 years of professional work experience in analytics, business analysis or data-driven product management.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience with Python, R, SQL and relational databases.
* Experience in the financial services industry, specifically dealing with cross-LOB operations, customer experience or complaint resolution.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy, and proficiency in key econometric and statistical techniques (such as hypothesis testing, regression modeling, etc.).
* Experience translating ambiguous business problems into clear analytical questions and tangible product features.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

description:

title: Director AI
description:
**Job Description**
The Director, AI Transformation is an AI-first technical leader responsible for defining and driving the HTCS AI strategy and converting it into deployed, scalable solutions and measurable business outcomes. The role will establish, operationalize, and scale enterprise AI initiatives, working closely with SBG leaders, Engineering, Digital/AI teams, IT, Cybersecurity, Legal, Data Privacy, HR, and other cross-functional stakeholders. This is an Individual Contributor role that leads through technical credibility, influence, and end-to-end ownership rather than direct people management.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Principal Responsibilities

The role will provide technical and strategic leadership across the AI lifecycle, including the following priorities:
  
  

* Define and drive the HTCS AI strategy, technology roadmap, operating model, and prioritized portfolio of AI opportunities aligned to business and engineering needs.
* Lead AI programs from opportunity identification and solution design through build, validation, deployment, adoption, scaling, and sustainment.
* Provide strong technical direction across generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, data and analytics, copilots, knowledge assistants, and related enterprise AI capabilities.
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex problems into clear AI use cases, solution architectures, delivery plans, and measurable success criteria.
* Hands-on lead the deployment of AI solutions within the organization, including pilots, production rollouts, integration with enterprise platforms, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Establish repeatable standards, governance, and processes for AI use-case intake, feasibility assessment, data readiness, model or tool selection, validation, responsible AI review, deployment, and value realization.
* Build and scale an AI operating rhythm covering portfolio governance, architecture and design reviews, delivery checkpoints, risk management, executive reporting, and benefits tracking.
* Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise expectations for cybersecurity, data privacy, legal compliance, responsible AI, reliability, quality, and operational support.
* Drive adoption and capability building through technical playbooks, communities of practice, learning pathways, demonstrations, office hours, and knowledge transfer to business and function owners.
* Mobilize cross-functional teams, resolve technical and organizational blockers, facilitate decisions, and maintain alignment across multiple stakeholders, sites, and time zones.
* Track and communicate outcomes using relevant measures such as adoption, active usage, productivity, quality, cycle time, cost, solution performance, and user satisfaction.
* Principal Networks & Contact Links
* HTCS leadership and function leaders; SBG Engineering leaders; AI/Digital leaders; enterprise architects; data, platform, product, and engineering teams.
* IT, Cybersecurity, Legal, Data Privacy, Procurement, Finance, HR/L&D, change management, and communications teams.
* External technology partners and service providers, where required for AI solution delivery and scaling.
* Supervisory Responsibilities
* Individual Contributor role with no direct reports.
* Leads through technical depth, influence, and matrixed collaboration; coordinates cross-functional teams and workstreams to deliver AI outcomes.
* Geographic Scope & Travel Requirements
* The position is based in Bangalore, India, and may require occasional travel to HTCS and SBG Engineering locations globally, as required.

**Qualifications**

* Education Required
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
* A master's degree in a relevant technical discipline or business administration is preferred.
* AI/ML, data, cloud, architecture, or engineering certifications are advantageous. Program management certification is desirable but not a primary requirement.
* Work Experience Required

Typically 10+ years of experience in technology, software engineering, data, digital transformation, or related fields, with substantial experience leading enterprise AI initiatives. Candidates with a strong software development background and proven AI delivery experience will be considered.
  
  
Must-have experience
  
  

* Strong AI knowledge and technical depth, with the ability to evaluate technologies, challenge solution designs, and guide technical delivery teams.
* Demonstrated experience defining and driving AI strategy, roadmaps, operating models, and investment priorities.
* Proven experience establishing, scaling, and operationalizing AI initiatives across an enterprise or large, complex organization.
* Hands-on experience deploying AI solutions into organizational environments, moving beyond proof of concept to production adoption and sustained operations.
* End-to-end delivery of AI programs, including use-case discovery, data readiness, architecture, build or configuration, testing, governance, rollout, monitoring, and value realization.
* Experience with generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, copilots or assistants, data and analytics platforms, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience applying responsible AI, data privacy, cybersecurity, legal, compliance, and model-risk controls in solution delivery.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to senior leaders and translate business priorities into executable technical plans.
* Strong stakeholder management and experience leading cross-functional teams in a matrixed, global environment.
* Preferred Profile
* Technical Manager, Technical Director, AI Engineering Leader, AI Transformation Leader, or equivalent profile with strong technical capability and demonstrated AI implementation experience.
* Software development or engineering background, including experience with software architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines, DevOps/MLOps, or enterprise application integration.
* Experience building AI governance, reusable delivery frameworks, centers of excellence, communities of practice, or enterprise AI capability-building programs.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and to operate effectively as a senior Individual Contributor.
* Behavioral Competencies Required
* Enterprise mindset with strong ownership, sound judgment, and a focus on measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, influencing, facilitation, and executive storytelling skills across functions, countries, and cultural boundaries.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, make informed trade-offs, and remove barriers to execution.
* Demonstrates Honeywell behaviors, including Act with Urgency, Think Big and Make It Happen, and Be Courageous and Inspire Greatness.
* Language Requirements
* Must be able to communicate effectively in English, including with senior technical and business stakeholders.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Product Expert - Clinical Data Management - India
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Clinical Data domain. You will drive impactful product communication and champion customer success with our Clinical Data Management applications, Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS, partnering closely with our customers in India. You will also continuously grow your own expertise by staying at the absolute cutting edge of AI and digital transformation in clinical trials. To apply for this role, you must have recent hands-on experience in either Veeva EDC or Veeva DQS.
  
  
As part of the global Product Expert team, you will play a key role in the Product organization. Most importantly you will:
  
  

* Build and foster highly engaged Users Communities; regularly engage with the customers in a range of forums to provide clear and impactful communication that drives shared understanding & education, promotes product adoption, and delivers customer value.
* Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, and at industry events.
* Drive increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion.
* As a Voice for the Customers, capture and relay their needs, and industry-specific learnings, to our Product Management team based in the US, helping them to inform product decisions and improve designs that ultimately create better Clinical Data products that enable:

+ AI & Digital transformation
+ Risk-based decision making
+ Regulatory compliance
+ A culture of continuous improvement
+ Excellence across the pharmaceutical industry

* Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices, and Veeva Product success.

To apply for this role, you must have recent hands-on experience in either Veeva EDC or Veeva DQS.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Be the product evangelist and provide subject matter expertise for the Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS products, staying up to date with the latest features and communicating Product roadmap directions.
* Act as a champion for Veeva's key product enhancements (for example, learning the overarching Veeva AI and RBQM visions to effectively guide customers through their transformation journeys together with Veeva colleagues).
* Provide product education to Veeva Clinical Data customers in meetings (in a range of forums) and our online communities (Veeva Connect); Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality.
* Be the customer advocate internally. Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer feedback. Feed these insights into release planning, contributing to future product innovations.
* Collaborate with Product teams to deliver valuable content and resources for product and release communication.
* Provide cross-functional support to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years working in the Clinical Management space, usually from Product Management, Consulting or Professional Services/Implementation roles
* Recent hands-on experience with Veeva EDC and/or Veeva DQS. Do not apply if you do not have this experience.
* Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to technical product requirements, preferences, and limitations
* Ability to understand Product Vision, Technical Specifications and Software Development Documentation, and translate them into language and content for both business and technical stakeholder
* Experience in interacting with customers from business users, IT departments, and executive suite, as well as internal teams, both in-person and remote (including software demonstrations and presentations).
* Strong analytical skills and English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations).
* A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features solve clinical trials challenges.
* Self-directed team player with a positive attitude.
* Willingness to travel between 15-30%.
* Based in India.

****Nice to Have****

* Preferred location: Bengaluru or Hyderabad
* SQL knowledge
* Fluency in at least one widely used Indian language

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

 Amazon's GSARC team is seeking a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to drive AI\-powered operational products that transform last\-mile delivery and logistics operations across international markets.  You will take the lead on initiatives and deliver independently, seeking direction when needed. You will influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, and organization priorities.  Key job responsibilities

* Serve as Voice of the Customer — conducting research, usability studies, and focus groups to identify best\-of\-breed benchmarks and competitive landscape
* Demonstrate deep technical curiosity — understanding core technologies within your product domain, architecture decisions, and their implications on performance, scale, and innovation
