description:
**Description**
 The vision for Alexa is to be the world’s best personal assistant. Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. We’re leveraging Generative AI to reimagine how hospitality, healthcare, senior living, and other verticals deliver magical experiences to their guests, patients, residents, and staff.
   

  

 If you’re passionate about building enterprise\-grade communication and device management solutions — while applying GenAI to solve hard, complex technical problems — then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, content management systems, third party integrations , and enterprise SaaS platforms to deliver delightful, scalable features for our B2B customers and their end users.
   

  

 Come join us to invent the future of how millions of enterprise end users communicate and connect through Alexa\-powered devices — and how businesses manage those experiences at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Senior Product Manager — Technical in Alexa Smart Properties, you will own and drive the product vision and execution for our enterprise staff personas to make it easy for staff to manage their content, get real time insights, and engage with their end customers. You will own our enterprise console and integrations with third party systems. You will manage how staff manage content in our enterprise console including menus, events, promotions, alerts, and contacts. You will create features to deliver staff real time insights \- through intelligent real time events to analytics. You will also build out capabilities to track tickets, orders, and other tasks directly in our enterprise console.
   

  

 With Alexa Smart Properties, you can also manage your content and end customer engagement using a third party system such as a property management system or resident engagement system. You will manage the roadmap of integrations we develop as well as improvements to accelerate integration speed and scale.
   

  

 Across both pillars, you will use all means possible — including AI capabilities — to accelerate development cycles, enable faster learning, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation. You will leverage GenAI to rapidly generate prototypes, specifications, and documentation to validate customer value propositions faster. You will deeply understand your product’s business context — market dynamics, competitive landscape, pricing strategy, and profitability drivers — and articulate how product decisions impact business outcomes.
   

  

 You will define vision (PR/FAQ), problem statements, tenets, and strategy while owning roadmap and priorities. You will influence without authority, building alignment across teams with different priorities — engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, sales, legal, and operations. You will establish key performance indicators, drive feature adoption, and measure the health of your product and business, distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You will create buy\-in for your vision across the Alexa organization and with external partners, and conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and competitive analysis to identify best\-of\-breed benchmarks and understand market opportunities.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Sr. PMT in Alexa Smart Properties, rarely are two days the same. You are a business owner, the voice of the customer, and the point person for partner teams across communication and device management experiences.
   

  

 On a daily basis, you will be working with enterprise customers to understand the needs of the staff persona \- including needs to manage content, engagement with end customers, and get real\-time insights. Your day could consist of writing PRFAQs and BRDs, building a prioritized roadmap, sprint planning/bug bashing, iterating on product decisions with Engineering teams, evaluating how GenAI and agentic systems can accelerate your roadmap, working with partners in business development, solution architects, legal, privacy, documentation, and more. You will think big to envision what’s next for enterprise communications, and exhibit “Learn and Be Curious” for different technologies — including emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

 You will make informed trade\-offs, build your own mockups and prototypes, define acceptance criteria, and participate in testing and validation. You’ll evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses — including extensibility, performance, and scalability — asking the right questions to identify risks before commitments are made. You’ll assess how AI capabilities can reshape product architectures, when autonomous agent patterns enhance versus complicate product design, and how to leverage GenAI to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment. You will use AI on a daily basis to increase your velocity and scale your impact.
   

  

 You will meet with customers to understand our core strengths and weaknesses, synthesize feedback with business and service data, and drive decisions using sophisticated judgment when data is incomplete. People will look to you to solve problems, connect them with specialists, and hold the tension between business outcomes and customer value honestly.

title: Senior Product Manager (B2B)
description:
**About Refold AI** 




  





 Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 
 



  





 We've grown rapidly, reaching seven\-figure ARR and 30\+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.
 



  





 Refold AI has raised $6\.5M from world\-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb \& Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




  




* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.



  





**What we're looking for:** 




  




* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade\-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade\-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two\-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made



  





**Experience** 




  




* 5\+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top\-tier institution, or hands\-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

The role functions as a central resource, interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during product development, and formulates and executes long\-term plans for cost and profit control. Product Managers promote the use of new technologies and industry\-leading trends.
   

  

 All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Direct product strategy from conception through implementation.
* Identify and evaluate new business and market opportunities.
* Develop business plans and determine market requirements for products.
* Ensure product consistency with organizational image and objectives.
* Serve as a central resource, collaborating with systems, marketing, and sales during product development.
* Formulate and execute long\-term plans for cost and profit control.
* Promote adoption of new technologies and industry\-leading trends.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience in product management, product ownership, business process analysis, or sales operations.
* Experience applying Agile principles across design, development, testing, and product management.
* Experience developing software capabilities to support sales, service, or customer relationship management functions.
* Experience in managing and implementing complex projects directly or through supervision.
* Experience working in cross\-functional teams to implement and assess operational impact of process changes.
* Experience soliciting and translating user feedback to inform product development.
* Experience driving product development with high velocity and quality.
* Experience in project management techniques, methodologies, and best practices such as Agile.
* Experience leading large Scrum teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD.
* Agile certifications such as CSM and CSPO, or their equivalent.
* Experience working with issuers and clients in the financial services industry or high\-growth technology companies.
* Experience in product management in payments, common services, and identity and access management.
* Experience in API development using SOAP or REST, JSON, and XML.
* Experience in API security, security standards, data encryption, and HSMs.
* Experience managing cross\-functional teams in global, highly matrixed organizations.
* Experience developing and executing product strategies that drive adoption and revenue growth.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Product Manager, Developer Platform
description:
**Let’s Build What’s Next, Together.**
 We are Spotnana. We’re on a mission to modernize the infrastructure of the $11\.7 trillion travel industry to power the perfect trip for travelers everywhere. Our Travel\-as\-a\-Service platform is designed to make every trip better, whether someone is booking for work or leisure travel, building a travel tool, or looking to offer personalized experiences at scale.
   

  

 We’re not just modernizing tech, we’re rethinking how the industry works. And to get there, we’re bringing together innovative, ambitious, and open\-minded people who want to build something that lasts.
   

  

 At Spotnana, our values and principles guide how we work and grow together:
   

  

* Build the future – We are leaders, we are innovators, we are ambitious.
* Commit to excellence – We’re accountable, we are partners, we are agile.
* Stronger together – We lead with respect and integrity, we are inclusive, we are lifelong learners.


**How You'll Help Us Build**
* Product Strategy \& Vision: Architect a global product strategy, working closely with executives and stakeholders across the organization.
* Customer Insight \& Market Analysis: Understand and anticipate customer needs through direct interaction, market research, and competitive analysis.
* Product Roadmap: Create and execute a product roadmap.
* Cross\-functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success teams to deliver innovative products and features.

**Experience You Bring**
* 5\+ years of experience in product management. You've either built developer\-facing products, or you've been the developer consuming them — hands\-on engineering experience counts.

* Strong leadership skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams.

**What To Expect Next**
 The process typically begins with an introductory call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team, where we'll discuss your background, career aspirations, and what makes Spotnana a great fit for you. Then a live virtual and onsite interview with a panel of engineers and hiring managers.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive environment and to encourage these values in everyone on our team. We provide an environment of mutual respect where opportunities are available without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that diversity and inclusion for people from all walks of life is key to our success as a company.
   

  

**Protect yourself from recruitment scams** 
 \- All recruiting outreach and communication comes directly from our internal team via an email with an @spotnana.com address or through LinkedIn. We encourage candidates to verify the source of any outreach before sharing personal information. We do not use external recruiting partners for our hiring efforts or Microsoft Teams for interviews. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, visa fees, or anything else during the hiring process. We do not extend offers via text\-based apps or use Microsoft Teams for interviews. All legitimate openings are listed at https://www.spotnana.com/careers/careers\-listing/.

title: Product Manager, Engagement
description:
Join Skillz and Level Up Your Career!
   

  

 Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join Skillz, the first publicly\-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi\-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
   

  

 At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. That's why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition.
   

  

 Life @ Skillz
   

  

* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your entire family. Additionally, take advantage of tax benefit options (PF \& NPS), expense reimbursement, and more.
* Perks: We believe in enhancing your work experience. We offer competitive paid time off (PL \& sick/casual) \& company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions.


 Why Skillz?
   

  

* Pioneers of Skill\-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill\-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T\-Mobile, Buzztime, Bowlero, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all.
* Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion\-Dollar Startups, and the \#1 fastest\-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more.


 The Future of Gaming Awaits!
   

  

 The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest\-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025\. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the Product Manager, Engagement \- you'll be focused on driving roadmap execution and delivery. You will be instrumental in shaping the technical delivery within our Consumer Experience division, headquartered in our new office in Bangalore. In this key leadership position, you will be responsible for providing strategic direction for the product management function, ensuring the successful implementation of our roadmap, and contributing to the overall success of Skillz. Your role will encompass inspiring a culture of challenging the status quo, promoting data\-driven decisions and KPIs, leading by example, and fostering innovation within the eSports domain. This is a unique opportunity for an experienced product manager to impact the eSports space significantly.
   

  

* 3\+ years of PM/live operations experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in building and delivering user\-centered, engaging experiences across a range of platforms, with the ability to demonstrate the success and impact of efforts for both users and businesses. This should include at least 3 years in games (RMG or mobile).
* Demonstrated experience in increasing activity spent in app/per session, quantity of games played, and increased % of AGPP.
* Experience in the Gaming Industry (ideally). Experience in building web or mobile gameplay, competition features, and/or social experiences in social casino or puzzle games is a strong plus. Knowledge of consumer products, refined visual design sensibility, and a passion for mobile.
* Able to work in\-office 5 days a week in Bangalore, India.
* A great communicator (verbal, written, and visual) who can influence and build consensus within a product team and with executive stakeholders across the company.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Durability and Resiliency \- A startup mindset and comfort in building from the ground up.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with stakeholders to define the consumer product vision, strategy, and roadmap for achievements and social game modes aligned with the overall company product roadmap and business strategy.
* A strategic thinker who can own the overall plan, including design, implementation, GTM (Go\-To\-Market), and analysis framework of features and functional refinements.
* Ability to work with the Leadership team to estimate ship dates of major deliverables with 75% accuracy or better.
* An excellent communicator capable of clearly sharing feature development progress, metric impact, etc., with a multi\-functional group.
* Ability to understand and articulate the company mission to the Engineering and Design teams.


 Join Skillz and Let's Redefine the Boundaries of Gaming!
   

  

 Together, we'll create a world where skill, passion, and innovation thrive. Join our team and be part of the journey. We look forward to having you on board!
   

  

 Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
 *.*

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, helping businesses improve performance across the commerce journey. Our technology enables brands to drive growth, optimise operations, and deliver better customer experiences through a suite of products and solutions.
   

  

 With a growing global merchant base, GoKwik is building a scalable, AI\-powered technology ecosystem that enables brands to grow faster and operate more efficiently. As we continue to expand, we are focused on building innovative products, strong technology foundations, and exceptional experiences for our customers.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 As a Principal Product Manager, you will play a key role in shaping product strategy and driving some of GoKwik's most important and complex product initiatives. You will operate at a company\-wide level, identifying high\-impact opportunities, defining product direction, and leading cross\-functional teams to build products that create significant customer and business value.
   

  

 This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, strong product judgment, deep customer understanding, and hands\-on execution. You will work closely with senior leadership, Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, and Business teams to influence the direction of GoKwik's product ecosystem.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

 Product Strategy \& Vision
   

  

* Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and long\-term roadmap for high\-impact product areas.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities that can create significant customer and business value.
* Translate company\-level objectives into clear product strategies and measurable outcomes.
* Develop a deep understanding of customers, markets, competitors, and emerging technology trends.
* Make strategic product decisions balancing customer needs, business impact, technical feasibility, and long\-term scalability.
* Influence broader product strategy and contribute to GoKwik's overall product direction.


 Product Discovery \& Problem Solving
   

  

* Identify complex, ambiguous customer and business problems and define clear problem statements.
* Lead deep customer discovery, market analysis, and data\-driven research to uncover high\-value opportunities.
* Develop and validate product hypotheses through research, experimentation, and rapid iteration.
* Challenge existing assumptions and identify new opportunities for product differentiation and growth.
* Build a strong understanding of customer workflows, pain points, and evolving needs.


 Product Execution
   

  

* Own complex product initiatives from discovery and strategy through execution, launch, adoption, and optimisation.
* Define product requirements, success metrics, prioritisation frameworks, and execution plans.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to develop scalable and intuitive product solutions.
* Navigate complex dependencies, technical constraints, and organisational trade\-offs.
* Maintain strong execution discipline while ensuring teams remain aligned with the broader product strategy.
* Identify and remove execution bottlenecks across cross\-functional teams.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Lead large, complex initiatives involving multiple Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, and Business teams.
* Build alignment across senior stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Partner with leadership to shape strategic priorities and investment decisions.
* Communicate product strategy, trade\-offs, progress, and outcomes clearly to executive stakeholders.
* Act as a product thought partner to senior leaders across the organisation.
* Establish strong operating rhythms for strategic initiatives, roadmap reviews, and product performance.


 Product Growth \& Business Impact
   

  

* Define and own the metrics that measure product success and business impact.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights to identify growth and optimisation opportunities.
* Drive product adoption, engagement, retention, revenue, and other relevant business outcomes.
* Establish experimentation frameworks and use data to guide product decisions.
* Continuously evaluate product performance and identify opportunities to improve customer and business outcomes.
* Connect product investments to measurable business impact.


 Product Leadership
   

  

* Raise the bar for product thinking, customer obsession, experimentation, and execution across the organisation.
* Mentor and coach Product Managers and help develop product capabilities within the team.
* Establish strong product practices, frameworks, and decision\-making mechanisms.
* Share product insights, frameworks, and learnings across the broader Product organisation.
* Help build a culture of ownership, data\-driven decision\-making, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a role model for high\-quality product strategy and execution.


 Who You Are
   

  

* 5 \- 9 years of product management experience, with significant experience owning complex products or product portfolios.
* Proven track record of building and scaling products that have delivered meaningful customer and business impact.
* Experience working in B2B SaaS, fintech, eCommerce, payments, consumer technology, or other technology\-driven businesses.
* Strong product strategy and vision\-setting capabilities with the ability to operate at both company and product levels.
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills and comfort navigating highly ambiguous and complex problems.
* Deep understanding of product discovery, customer research, prioritisation, experimentation, analytics, and product execution.
* Strong commercial understanding and ability to connect product decisions to business outcomes.
* Comfortable working with Engineering and Design leaders on complex technical and product challenges.
* Strong data orientation with the ability to use quantitative and qualitative insights to make product decisions.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead through influence rather than authority.
* Experience mentoring Product Managers and contributing to the development of product teams and practices.


 Why GoKwik
   

  

 At GoKwik, you'll have the opportunity to shape products that power the growth of a global commerce ecosystem. You'll work on complex, high\-impact problems at the intersection of technology, commerce, data, and AI. As a Principal Product Manager, you'll have significant ownership and influence across the organisation, working closely with senior leadership and cross\-functional teams to shape product strategy and build products at scale. This is an opportunity to solve meaningful customer problems, influence company\-wide product direction, mentor the next generation of product leaders, and create lasting impact across GoKwik's product ecosystem.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About StanceBeam** 




 StanceBeam is a Bengaluru\-headquartered sports technology company. We built the world's first commercial smart cricket bat sensor and have since grown into a full performance\-technology stack: sensors, ball tracking, computer vision, video analytics and an affordable Decision Review System. Our technology is deployed across India, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, the United Kingdom and the United States, and our work has been recognised through the KPMG Game Changers Award, the Karnataka Government's Elevate100 programme and a granted patent portfolio.
 



**About the role** 




 You will be the product manager across StanceBeam's product portfolio: the mobile and tablet applications our players, coaches and operators use, the web platforms and administration tools behind them, and the sensor, ball\-tracking and computer\-vision systems that feed them. A significant part of the role is our international client engagements.
 



 The product is a connected suite rather than a single app: consumer applications on iOS and Android, tablet applications used in live operational settings, web\-based administration portals and websites, with integrations across hardware, access control, payments and analytics.Underneath that sit our sensors, ball tracking and computer vision.
 



**You will work directly with the founders and directly with our clients.** 
 The founders will set direction and commercial priorities with you, and you will be working directly with international clients and product teams.
 



**Why this role** 



* Ownership of live products with real users, in facilities, academies and matches
* A rare mix of software, hardware, AI, and computer vision in one portfolio.
* International exposure: clients in the US, UK, Australia and the Gulf, overseas travel a few times a year, and work that spans time zones.
* A small, senior team where the scope is as large as you can handle.



**What you will do** 




**Discovery and definition** 



* Own the product backlog across the portfolio and keep it prioritised, current and understood by everyone who works from it.
* Talk to the people who actually use the product. Separate what they ask for from the job they are trying to get done, and write up the difference.
* Write PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can build and test from, and a proper technical specification with a rollback plan for anything that touches firmware or devices.
* Prioritise in a way you can defend, showing the reasoning and the trade\-off, not just the ranking.



**Where hardware meets software** 



* Keep track of which app versions, firmware versions and hardware revisions work together, and plan releases accordingly.
* Plan staged rollouts for firmware and model updates, with a kill switch and a rollback plan written before launch.
* Take responsibility for the data pipeline from device to screen. Everything downstream is only as good as what comes in.
* Plan around hardware lead times. A software fix ships in a sprint; a firmware or hardware change is measured in months, and sequencing around that is your job.
* Where the physical world is involved, run structured pilots rather than live experiments, with defined cohorts and clear exit criteria.



**Client\-facing work** 



* Be the day\-to\-day product contact for our clients' product and operations teams \- for features, releases, defects and timelines.
* Run weekly working sessions, sprint demos and release walkthroughs.
* Capture incoming requests, diagnose the underlying business need, and turn them into considered proposals
* Translate technical and hardware constraints into language the client can act on, and translate their operational reality back into requirements the team can build.
* Protect the integrity of the platform. Know when a one\-off request would fragment the product, and be able to say no while keeping the relationship intact.
* Assess change requests for effort and timeline impact, present the trade\-off clearly, and bring anything with commercial or contractual implications
* Keep the client informed in writing: release notes, status summaries and decision logs, so nothing important lives only in someone's memory.



**Delivery, quality and release** 



* Run sprint planning, refinement and reviews with the engineering and QA leads, and keep the delivery plan realistic and current.
* Coordinate acceptance testing with clients: prepare the scope, support them through it, triage findings and drive the agreed fix list to closure.
* Own release readiness: release notes, environment checks, sign\-off criteria and the go/no\-go call. Flag risk before a date slips, not after.
* Work with the technical lead on third\-party integrations so partner and vendor commitments stay aligned with our release calendar.
* Make a considered call on technical debt: when to accept it to hit a hardware\-linked date, and when it is too risky to defer.
* Contribute to operational readiness for each launch: standard operating procedures, administrator playbooks, training material and support documentation.



**What we are looking for** 




**Essential** 



* **6 to 10 years** 
 in product management, business analysis or a closely related role, with clear ownership of a backlog and written specifications.
* Direct client\-facing experience. You have run meetings with a client, taken difficult questions and been trusted to represent your company without supervision.
* Hands\-on experience with a product where software meets the physical world: hardware and firmware, sensors or IoT, computer vision, embedded systems or similar. You personally owned part of it rather than sitting next to the team that did.
* Experience across more than one platform, for example a consumer app alongside an internal or administrative system.
* Comfort working closely with engineers: you can read an API contract or a technical specification, understand why something is hard, and question an estimate without being adversarial.
* Agile delivery in practice, sprint planning through to release, not just as a certification.
* Confident use of AI tools in your day\-to\-day work, drafting, synthesising feedback and analysis, with the judgement to know when the output is wrong.
* Comfort with ambiguity and a start\-up reality. You will often be the person who has to go and find the answer.



**Desirable** 



* A technical background: an engineering or computer science degree, or time spent as a developer, data or QA engineer before moving into product. We want someone who can hold their own in a technical discussion and read code when needed.
* Interest in sport and sports technology. It is the domain we work in, and curiosity about it will make your product decisions better.
* Experience with a product where a machine\-learning or vision model was part of the user\-facing behaviour.
* Experience supporting international clients.
* Familiarity with Jira or Azure Boards, Figma, Postman, and an analytics stack

title: Product Manager
description:
**Product Manager – Collections \& Fintech** 




**Location: Bangalore** 




**Experience: 5–10 years** 




**Function: Product Management** 




**Company: Collekto / Pernimius Financial Technologies Pvt. Ltd.** 




**About Collekto** 




 Collekto is a fintech SaaS platform focused on retail debt collections, helping lenders
 



 improve collections outcomes through technology, data, analytics, automation and AI.
 



 We are building the next generation of AI\-led collections infrastructure, bringing together
 



 borrower intelligence, allocation, communication, field collections, analytics, strategy
 



 orchestration and last\-mile conversion into a unified platform.
 



**The Role** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager with a rare combination of hands\-on product
 



 management capability and deep collections domain experience.
 



 This is not a conventional Product Manager role where domain knowledge can be learned
 



 after joining. The ideal candidate should understand how collections actually work on the
 



 ground including DPD\-based strategies, allocation, agency management, field collections,
 



 calling, digital collections, PTP management, settlements, recoveries and collection KPIs—
 



 and be able to translate that understanding into scalable technology products.
 



 You will work closely with clients, collections teams, engineering, design, data/AI and
 



 leadership to define and build products that materially improve collection efficiency and
 



 recovery outcomes.
 



  





**What you will own** 




 • Own one or more products/modules within Collekto's collections platform from discovery to adoption and continuous improvement.
 



 • Translate real\-world collections problems into clear product requirements, workflows and technology solutions.
 



 • Engage directly with collection heads, operations teams, lenders, agencies and other stakeholders to understand their challenges.
 



 • Define product vision, roadmap, priorities and release plans for your area.
 



 • Convert business requirements into PRDs, user journeys, functional specifications, acceptance criteria and product backlogs.
 



 • Work closely with Engineering, UX/UI, Data and AI teams through the complete product development lifecycle.
 



 • Use collections data and operational metrics to identify opportunities for product improvement.
 



 • Drive product adoption with clients and internal operations teams.
 



 • Participate in client discussions, product demos, solution workshops and implementation discussions.
 



 • Balance customer requirements, product scalability, engineering effort and commercial priorities.
 



 • Identify opportunities to use AI, automation and predictive intelligence to improve collections effectiveness.
 



**Domain Responsibilities** 




 The candidate should be comfortable working across areas such as:
 



 • DPD and delinquency\-based collection strategies
 



 • Early bucket and late bucket collections
 



 • Allocation and reallocation of accounts
 



 • Agency and field\-agent management
 



 • Calling and tele\-collections
 



 • Digital collections – SMS, WhatsApp, email, IVR and other channels
 



 • Promise\-to\-Pay (PTP) management
 



 • PTP fulfilment and broken PTP strategies
 



 • Field visit planning and execution
 



 • Collection productivity and efficiency
 



 • Borrower segmentation and propensity
 



 • Settlement and resolution workflows
 



 • Roll\-forward / roll\-back analysis
 



 • Collection MIS, dashboards and operational analytics
 



 • Incentives and performance management
 



 • Last\-mile conversion and recovery strategies
 



 The expectation is not merely to understand these concepts, but to challenge existing processes and identify how technology can fundamentally improve them.
 



**Product Management Responsibilities** 




 1\. Product Discovery
 



 • Understand the problem before jumping to a solution.
 



 • Conduct user and stakeholder interviews.
 



 • Map existing collection processes and identify inefficiencies.
 



 • Quantify the business impact of identified problems.
 



 • Define clear problem statements and hypotheses.
 



 2\. Product Definition
 



 • Develop product vision and roadmap.
 



 • Create PRDs and detailed functional specifications.
 



 • Define user journeys, workflows and business rules.
 



 • Prioritise features using business impact, customer value and engineering effort.
 



 • Define measurable success criteria for every major initiative.
 



 3\. Product Development
 



 • Work closely with engineering and design teams during execution.
 



 • Clarify requirements and resolve functional ambiguities.
 



 • Manage product backlog and sprint priorities.
 



 • Ensure quality and usability of releases.
 



 • Drive UAT and production readiness.
 



 4\. Product Adoption \& Outcomes
 



 • Work with clients and internal teams to drive adoption.
 



 • Track usage, engagement and business outcomes.
 



 • Analyse collection performance before and after product interventions.
 



 • Continuously improve the product based on data and feedback.
 



**What We Are Looking For** 




 Must Have
 



 • 5\+ years of experience in product management, product ownership or product\-led business roles.
 



 • Significant experience in retail debt collections / lending / BFSI, preferably in collections operations.
 



 • Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end collections lifecycle.
 



 • Experience working with collection platforms, LOS/LMS, collection agencies or fintech products.
 



 • Ability to independently write PRDs and translate business problems into technology requirements.
 



 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Experience working closely with Engineering and Technology teams.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
 



 • Ability to operate comfortably with both business/operations teams and technology
 



 teams.
 



**Strongly Preferred** 




 Experience with one or more of:
 



 • Digital collections
 



 • Collection strategy engines
 



 • Account allocation engines
 



 • Field\-force applications
 



 • Telecalling/dialers
 



 • WhatsApp or conversational collections
 



 • Collection analytics
 



 • AI/ML\-led borrower segmentation or propensity models
 



 • Settlement platforms
 



 • Agency management
 



 • Incentive engines
 



 • Workflow/orchestration platforms
 



**You should be:** 




 • Domain deep – You understand collections beyond terminology.
 



 • Product minded – You think in problems, users, outcomes and scalable solutions.
 



 • Data driven – You use numbers to validate decisions.
 



 • Technically comfortable – You can work effectively with engineers, APIs, data and system workflows.
 



 • Customer obsessed – You spend time understanding how products are actually
 



 used.
 



 • Execution oriented – You take ownership from idea through production.
 



 • Commercially aware – You understand the business impact of product decisions.
 



 • Curious about AI – You see AI as a way to fundamentally rethink collections, not
 



 simply as a feature.
 



**Why This Role Is Different** 




 At Collekto, the opportunity is to build the technology layer for the future of debt
 



 collections.
 



 You will not simply manage a backlog or coordinate releases. You will have the opportunity
 



 to take deep collections knowledge and turn it into repeatable, scalable and intelligent
 



 products used by lenders and collection organisations at scale.
 



 If you have spent years understanding why collections teams succeed or fail and now want
 



 to use technology, data and AI to fundamentally change how collections are executed, this
 



 role is for you.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Swish is building the next generation of rapid food delivery. We run our own kitchens and own the journey end to end — from preparing the food to getting it to the customer. Our promise is simple: hot, fresh food, delivered when we say it will be.
 



  





 We’re looking for an Associate Product Manager to help us solve the product and operational problems behind that promise.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  




* **Own product problems end to end** 
 – Identify opportunities, write PRDs, work with engineering and design to ship, and measure impact.
* **Turn data into product decisions** 
 – Use SQL, dashboards and customer/order data to understand delays, missed promises, drop\-offs and other product problems.
* **Run experiments** 
 – Design A/B tests and phased rollouts, analyse results and use learnings to improve the product.
* **Work with operations** 
 – Spend time with kitchen, rider and operations teams to understand real\-world workflows and build tools that make their work easier.
* **Build smarter delivery experiences** 
 – Work with data science and engineering on delivery\-time estimates, order operations and customer communication.
* **Drive execution** 
 – Track product health, write clear specs and work across teams to get things shipped.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 1–3 years of experience in product management, analytics, consulting, engineering or a similar problem\-solving role
* Strong analytical skills with SQL and dashboards
* Structured thinking and the ability to break down ambiguous problems

title: Gameberry Labs - Lead Product Manager - Game Design
description:
**About The Role**
 We're building a new game engine, and this role owns it. It exists to do something structurally different from what made us successful so far: instead of deepening one enduring title, it puts many concepts into the market quickly, reads the signal honestly, and doubles down only on what earns it. We run this as a factory, not a series of bets. Concepts move through a staged funnel: creative signal, then install economics, then engagement, then ROAS, and most of them die at a stage. That is the point. The ones that survive get built into hybrid\-casual titles: ads\-led at the core, with a meta layer engineered to carry IAP as the game matures. You'll own that engine end to end.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Vision: Set the thesis for what we build and why. Decide which mechanics, genres, and audiences we chase this quarter and which we deliberately ignore. Turn market signals, competitive intel, store movement, creative trends, and UA data into a portfolio strategy leadership can back.
* Product: Own the full lifecycle on titles in the pipeline: concept, prototype, soft launch, and scale. Write the specs, design the core loop and progression, define the economy, and shape the meta layer that takes a title from ad\-monetized to hybrid.
* Production: Own throughput. Small pods, tight cadence, and external partners where it makes sense. You are accountable for how many concepts reach the test, how fast they get there, and what each one costs us to learn from. Judgment. Run the kill/scale calls. Defend them with data, own them when they're wrong, and keep the bar honest when a concept everyone loves isn't clearing its numbers.
* People: Mentor and grow the product and game designers working across the pipeline. Build the practice, not just the product.
* Own the product vision, roadmap, and portfolio strategy for Gameberry's hybrid\-casual line.
* Drive concepts through the full lifecycle, writing specifications and working across design, art, engineering, and UA to ship playable builds fast.
* Define and defend the metrics that gate each stage of the testing funnel, and make the kill/scale decision at every gate.
* Design core loops, progression systems, economies, and the meta layer that carries a title from IAA\-led to hybrid monetization.
* Partner closely with UA and creative teams in this genre; creative is product, and the two cannot be sequenced.
* Own production planning, team allocation, and delivery cadence across multiple concepts running in parallel.
* Present strategy, results, and honest post\-mortems to founders and senior leadership.
* Mentor and guide product and game designers; raise the analytical and craft bar across the pod.
* Build the operating system playbooks, scorecards, and benchmarks so the pipeline gets better with every cycle, not just busier.


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years in product management, with meaningful time in game development. A hybrid\-casual, hypercasual, or casual puzzle experience is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ownership of a title from concept to launch, ideally more than one, ideally including one that didn't work.
* Fluency in the economics of the genre: CPI, IPM, D1/D7 retention, ARPDAU, LTV, and payback. You should be able to read a ROAS curve and say something useful about it without an analyst in the room.
* Strong grasp of ad monetization and how an IAP meta layer is built on top of it.
* Ability to create wireframes, product specifications, and system designs that engineers and artists can build from without a translation layer.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to present work to executive staff.
* Comfort with ambiguity and speed. This is a zero\-to\-one function; the process is partly yours to invent.
* Self\-starter with a bias for action and a genuine love for solving unsolved problems.
* Previous start\-up or studio\-building experience is a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of AI tooling in the production pipeline is a plus; we're actively building this into how the team operates.

title: Lead - E-commerce Marketplaces
description:
**Role Overview** 




 Drools Pet Food is looking for a commercially driven E\-commerce Marketplaces Lead to own and scale the Amazon and Flipkart businesses. The incumbent will lead the KAM and AKAM team, own channel revenue and profitability, strengthen marketplace relationships, and drive disciplined execution across assortment, pricing, promotions, media, inventory and customer experience. The role requires the ability to translate marketplace data into clear growth plans while building a high\-accountability team and strong cross\-functional operating rhythm.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ·   Own the Amazon and Flipkart annual operating plan, including gross merchandise value, net sales, market share, contribution margin, advertising investment and working\-capital objectives.
 



 ·   Lead, coach and develop the KAM and AKAM team; define account ownership, targets, review mechanisms and capability\-development plans.
 



 ·   Build senior relationships with marketplace category, commercial, marketing, supply\-chain, finance and operations teams.
 



 ·   Lead Joint Business Planning and negotiate margins, commercial terms, event participation, visibility, media support, assortment commitments and growth targets.
 



 ·   Develop account\-wise growth strategies covering assortment expansion, search and content improvement, geographic reach, pricing, promotions, advertising and new product launches.
 



 ·   Own channel P\&L and investment governance; evaluate platform margins, discounts, claims, returns, media spend and other costs to deliver profitable growth.
 



 ·   Establish weekly and monthly performance reviews across accounts, categories, brands and SKUs, and ensure timely corrective action against agreed targets.
 



 ·   Translate consumer demand and platform data into rolling forecasts, event plans and inventory requirements in partnership with demand planning and supply chain.
 



 ·   Improve availability, fill rate, days of inventory and replenishment while controlling overstock, ageing, expiry, returns and cancellation risks.
 



 ·   Drive portfolio and assortment strategy across pet\-care categories, with clear roles for core, premium and innovation portfolios.
 



 ·   Ensure pricing discipline and parity across marketplaces, with defined escalation and correction mechanisms for pricing or MOP breaches.
 



 ·   Lead marketplace media and digital\-shelf strategy across sponsored search, display, brand stores, SEO, product detail pages, ratings and reviews; improve traffic, conversion and ROAS.
 



 ·   Create launch and event playbooks covering product proposition, inventory, pricing, content, media, visibility and post\-event performance evaluation.
 



 ·   Oversee catalogue quality, brand protection and operational hygiene, including listings, content, purchase orders, claims, deductions and reconciliations.
 



 ·   Identify category trends, competitor actions, emerging marketplace capabilities and partnership opportunities that can accelerate Drools' online growth.
 



 ·   Partner with brand marketing, finance, supply chain, category, customer service and technology teams to ensure seamless execution of marketplace plans.
 



 ·   Present account performance, risks, investment requirements and growth recommendations to senior leadership through clear dashboards and business reviews.
 



  





**Education and Eligibility** 




 ·   MBA or postgraduate qualification in business, marketing, sales, strategy or a related discipline is required.
 



 ·   Minimum 8 years of post\-MBA experience for candidates from Tier 1 institutes, or 10 years of relevant experience for candidates from other institutes.
 



 ·   At least 5 years of direct experience in e\-commerce, marketplace sales, category management or key account management, including ownership of Amazon and/or Flipkart.
 



 ·   At least 2 years of experience leading KAMs, AKAMs, account managers or a comparable commercial team.
 



 ·   Demonstrated ownership of a sizeable marketplace P\&L, annual operating plan, commercial negotiations and senior platform relationships.
 



 ·   Experience in pet food, pet care, FMCG, consumer goods, nutrition or another high\-repeat consumer category is strongly preferred.
 



 ·   Hands\-on experience with marketplace advertising, demand forecasting, assortment planning, pricing, promotions, inventory and account operations is required.
 



 ·   Location \- work from Bengaluru and flexibility to travel for partner meetings and internal reviews when required.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 ·   Commercial leadership with strong understanding of marketplace economics, channel P\&L and profitable growth.
 



 ·   Strategic account management and the ability to convert JBPs into measurable commercial and operational outcomes.
 



 ·   Strong people leadership, coaching, delegation and performance\-management capability.
 



 ·   Advanced analytical skills with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, dashboards and business\-performance analysis.
 



 ·   Strong negotiation and influencing skills across senior internal and external stakeholders.
 



 ·   Deep understanding of Amazon and Flipkart business models, category levers, fulfilment models, advertising and event calendars.
 



 ·   Ability to translate large datasets into clear insights, priorities and executable account plans.
 



 ·   Strong forecasting, inventory\-planning and operational problem\-solving skills.
 



 ·   Clear written and verbal communication with confidence in executive\-level presentations and reviews.
 



 ·   High ownership, attention to detail and disciplined follow\-through in a fast\-paced environment.

 **Bengaluru** 




  





**About Us :** 




 The Souled Store is a homegrown youth casual\-wear brand founded in 2013\. Today, we are one of India's largest online merchandising platforms, with licensing partnerships including Disney, Warner Bros., WWE, IPL and Viacom18 among others. We create products inspired by pop culture — superheroes, movies, TV shows, cartoons — while also staying deeply rooted in evolving youth fashion and lifestyle trends. title: Software Development Manager, Product & Offers Experience
description:
**Description**
 Do you shop on Amazon? Have you ever browsed a product detail page; scrolling through images, comparing prices, checking delivery dates and then clicked "Add to Cart"? That entire experience? Our team builds it. The Product \& Offers Experience organization is responsible for building the world's best product evaluation and discovery experiences for Amazon shoppers. We own the experiences that help hundreds of millions of customers worldwide make confident purchase decisions, from the moment they land on a product page to the moment they add to cart. Our work spans offer selection, offer display, pricing presentation, and the rich product information that surrounds the buy box. As the worldwide product showroom for the "everything store," we directly drive the majority of purchase decisions on Amazon across all surfaces; mobile, desktop, and voice. Our focus spans three areas: helping customers discover, evaluate, and compare products and offers; enabling effortless shopping without disrupting their current context; and empowering builders through a scalable, federated architecture that allows hundreds of partner teams across Amazon to innovate within the product and offers experience.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers who are customer obsessed and deeply technical. You will define the vision and build a technical roadmap for your team, identifying where to invest, what to build next, and how to evolve the architecture to meet the needs of customers, the business, and partner teams at scale. You will gather requirements from a broad set of stakeholders across the Amazon Consumer organization, explore existing and emerging technologies, identify opportunities and gaps, and drive your team to deliver results that directly impact how customers shop on Amazon.
   

  

 You will also be a people leader first. You will hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent. You will invest deeply in the growth of your engineers — through mentorship, career development, and creating an inclusive team culture where people do their best work. You will set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and build a high\-performing team that is motivated, engaged, and continuously learning. You will champion a healthy work environment and foster psychological safety so your team can take bold bets and innovate fearlessly.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has excellent technical depth, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to communicate effectively across all levels. You are equally passionate about building great technology and building great teams. You care deeply about people development, operational excellence, and delivering results that matter. If you want to shape how hundreds of millions of customers make purchase decisions on Amazon and grow the next generation of engineering leaders along the way then we want to meet you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Software Development Manager on the team, you will be expected to:
   

  

 Take on hard, ambiguous problems and break them down to their simple parts.
   

  

 Manage a team of high caliber Software Development and Quality Assurance Engineers working on building world class, scalable distributed systems and mobile customer experiences.
   

  

 Recruit, hire, mentor, and coach Software Development Engineers at different levels of experience.
   

  

 Manage and execute against project plans and deliver commitments within a professional, high paced engineering environment.
   

  

 Interface with our internal customers to understand requirements, set priorities and communicate direction and progress.
   

  

 Own all operational metrics and support for your teams' software.
   

  

 Drive improvements in software engineering practices.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Brainstorming meetings with product managers and leadership team on new product ideas.
   

  

 Work with engineers to design, scope, plan and deliver features for offer display.
   

  

 Meet with stakeholders (internal and external) and dependencies to build relationships, align on roadmap and delivery timelines.
   

  

 Work with a team of recruiters to hire great talent for the team.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Manager, Product Design
description:
**Who We Are**
 Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
   

  

 Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
   

  

 Visit gomotive.com to learn more.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Product Design to lead our new Maintenance and Fuel vertical and grow our design presence in Bangalore. This role is both hands\-on and organizationally pivotal. You will lead a team of designers working within our growing Maintenance and Fuel vertical, delivering intuitive, scalable experiences across web and mobile platforms.
   

  

 In parallel, you will serve as a local design leader for South Asia, supporting and mentoring designers across teams, many of whom may report into different managers globally. You’ll play a critical role in strengthening design culture on the ground, elevating craft, and ensuring designers in the region feel supported, connected, and set up to succeed. You will also be instrumental in building and scaling our design team in India, helping us attract and hire exceptional talent in a highly competitive market.
   

  

 You will be pivotal in defining and executing the product strategy, working in close partnership with cross\-functional leaders to deliver exceptional and user\-centric experiences for fleet managers, drivers, and back\-office personnel.
   

  

 As a design leader who remains highly connected to the craft, you will champion the growth and development of a talented team of designers through effective mentorship and coaching, fostering a high\-performance design culture. You will also be a key driver in the evolution and adoption of AI\-centric product development, ensuring a scalable, unified, and high\-quality user experience across our entire product ecosystem.
