title: Product Manager – Founding Team (Growth)
description:
**ABOUT REO** 




**Who we are** 





 Reo.Dev
 
 is a modern revenue stack for Developer focused companies. We help Developer Tool companies identify which Engineering Teams have an Urgent need for their product and the highest likelihood of conversion. We capture and analyze a wide array of developer activity data from Github, Docs, Docker Installs, Communities, other dev specific sources and convert them to sales signals.
 



 Read more here:
 
 https://app.notion.com/p/roverly/About\-Reo\-Dev\-18c33e0c3ba2808280f8e4235365a052
 




  





**ABOUT ROLE** 




**🎉 What will you be working on?** 




 We're looking for a Growth PM to join our early team. You'll own growth as a product surface — how people find their way into Reo.dev, how quickly they get to real value, and what makes them stay and expand. You'll work directly with the founders, marketing and demand\-gen.
 



 More generically, you will be:
 


* Owning the growth surface of the product end to end\- first\-run experience, activation, adoption, expansion\- and the numbers that come out of it.
* Owning activation as the core problem. Getting a user into the product is the easy half; getting them to complete setup, trust what they're seeing and build a habit around it is where the funnel actually lives.
* Co\-owning packaging, limits and pricing levers, and the qualification logic that decides when a user is ready for a conversation with our team.
* Running growth experiments across the funnel \- onboarding, nudges, lifecycle messaging, in\-product education, empty states, CTA and copy, and building an experimentation practice that is honest about what our traffic volumes can and can't tell you.
* Owning instrumentation. Defining the events, funnels and dashboards that let the whole company see where users drop and why, and making sure the numbers are actually trustworthy.
* Holding the cross\-product experience quality bar.
* Working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with PMM and demand\-gen on positioning, landing pages, lifecycle campaigns and the loop between what marketing promises and what the product delivers.
* Prioritize ruthlessly\-know what moves the needle and cut what doesn't.
* Write clear specs and keep the team aligned on what's next. Own documentation of everything you have delivered.
* Be a true owner\- think about growth, retention, and long\-term value, not just features.



  





**👯 Skill we are looking for in this role** 




 This is a key role in Reo.Dev. We are looking at ambitious people who will lead Reo.Dev in our next level of growth. Hence we are looking at following qualities/ profiles:
 


* You have at least 4\-6 years of Product Management experience, with a meaningful stretch of it owning growth or product\-led adoption in a B2B SaaS product\- ideally one where you built the motion rather than one where it already existed.
* You have a real eye for design and a high bar for craft. You can look at a flow and say precisely what's wrong with it \- which step is carrying too much, which word is doing the wrong work, where three screens should have been one. You care about spacing, hierarchy, motion and microcopy, and you find it hard to ship something that merely works. Be prepared to walk us through products you think are beautifully made and explain exactly why.
* You have owned a funnel number, not just a roadmap. You can talk specifically about activation or conversion rates you moved, what you tried that failed, and how you knew.
* Comfort with packaging and pricing as a product decision
* You are hands\-on in the literal sense: you write the copy, mock the flow, build the prototype, set up the campaign. You don't wait for design or engineering capacity to start.
* You can operate inside a company where growth and sales share the same pipeline. You'll work closely with CS and sales rather than treat growth as a separate world.
* Bonus: you've built for a developer or technical audience, or worked on a data/AI product where the value depends on setup and data coverage.



  





**👯 What qualities we look for in our team members?** 




 While there is no stencil for the type of people we like, there are a few traits that might make Reo.Dev a better fit for you. Reo.Dev might be a good fit if you:
 


* Work hard, hands\-on (that's very important to us!) and want to grow really fast.
* Care about your work a great deal, find it highly unsettling if the quality of work is even slightly sub\-par.
* Execute fast.
* Are hands on (we will not have elaborate reporting structures for the foreseeable future and hopefully ever).
* Are someone people like to work with, low on ego, high on humility.
* Have the ability to fail, learn and keep trying till you win. Start\-ups are tough and we will not get everything right the first time.
* Have a longish view of your career growth and not optimising for the next 1\-2 years.

description:
******Job Description******
 Become part of the team powering household names like Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, and WypAll®. At Arbex, everything you need is right here—innovation, growth, and the chance to leave a real mark.
   

  

 You were made to create what’s next: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimising digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, well\-being, and career development while you help us shape the future of tissue and hygiene for billions of people around the world.  We’ll be Unstoppable Together.
   

  

****About You****
 In one of our professional roles, you’ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the centre.
   

  

 The HR Digital Technologies team is focused on creating a world\-class employee experience that leverages digital enablers to drive business value for the Arbex organization. We are a group focused on solving the problems of today and opportunities of the future through applied intelligence, process simplification, global standardization, and self\-solve enabled solutions. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced individual to join our team as Service Now HRSD Product Owner and Senior Analyst. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the ServNow HRSD system and serving as the product owner. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure the successful optimization and configuration of ServNow HRSD, along with other HR technology. This role is a mix of maintaining product roadmap and stakeholder engagement, as well as hands on aspects of configuration.
   

  

 DTS Product Owner is accountable for HR Service Now technological strategy; application roadmap, implementation \& support coordination; key DTS business contact landscape.
   

  

 Team Structure
   

  

* Reports to DTS HR \& Legal global lead
* Coordinate and provide functional leadership to the DTS Workday team


 Job responsibilities include:
   

  

* Serve as the product owner for Service Now HRSD platform.
* Business Analyst and Platform Architect of Workflow Management, Dynamic workflow, Service Request Management and Service Portal however will not limit to this only when requirements come from other Modules
* Manage the configuration, maintenance, and support of HRSD.
* Partner with key HR stakeholders to maintain a backlog, prioritize work, design solutions and define Ways of Working that meet the business needs.

* Configure ServNow HRSD to meet business requirements, including business process workflows, portal, integrations and custom reports.

* Establish and lead governance process, including intake, approval and demand prioritization.

* Develop UI/UX design, wire frames to support functional design including full documentation of user journey when new project is chartered

* Serve as the ServNow HRSD Release Manager, coordinating with HR, DTS and business stakeholders ensuring smooth deployment of system updates to align releases with business objectives and through annual releases and hotfixes.
* Collaborate across other product owners/product teams to understand planned activities and potential impacts on the product and/or team’s capacity.
* Partner on technology roadmap tied to business strategy.
* Create clear and comprehensive product documentation, including user stories, acceptance criteria, change and configuration documentation, and product roadmaps.


 To succeed in this role, you will need the following experience and qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of proven experience managing Service Now ITSN Tool set and processes and 4 years on HRSD
* Minimum of 4 years of ServiceNow implementation and Administration experience in large complex environments is required

* Advanced ServiceNow technical skill \- UI Policies, UI Macros, UI Pages, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Business Rules, Mid Server Configuration \& Architecture, ACL’s, Import Sets, Transform Maps and Update sets

* Proficient in Agile development and all phases of the Application Development Lifecycle

* Experience working in a global organization.
* Experience coordinating small teams across multiple geographies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into technical solutions.
* Decision\-making – Capability to make informed decisions quickly and effectively, balancing competing priorities and risks
* Backlog management – Skills in creating, prioritizing and managing the product backlog to ensure that the development team works on the highest\-value items
* Developing/mentoring others and providing guidance/feedback to drive outcomes.
* Experience proactively engaging available technology resources to develop a strong network and growth (e.g., ServNow Community, user groups, etc).
* Data Analysis – Ability to analyze data and metrics to understand product performance, user behavior, and areas for improvement.
* Problem solving – Aptitude for identifying issues and obstacles and finding practical solutions to keep the product development on track.
* Ability to work in a virtual team which may work across distance, cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines.

title: Platform Product Delivery Manager- Talent & NOW P&C
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 Are you a strong delivery leader within digital products and platforms, who enjoys leading cross\-functional teams and creating real business impact through technology? Do you thrive in complex environments where you balance product vision, engineering excellence, and operational performance?
   

  

 If yes – keep reading, as this might be your next role!
   

  

 We are looking for a Platform Product Delivery Manager to join IKEA Group Digital. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of digital products within a platform subdomain, ensuring they are built and operated with quality, scalability, and business value in mind.
   

  

 You are someone who inspires others, builds strong teams, and creates clarity in complex situations. You combine a strong customer focus with a deep understanding of technology and delivery, and you have the ability to translate insights into tangible product outcomes.
   

  

 Above all, you take ownership, show initiative, and are passionate about delivering high\-quality digital products that make a difference.
   

  

 Furthermore, we believe that you bring:
   

  

 Strong experience in leading cross\-functional product and engineering teams
   

 5–8 years of hands\-on experience in HR technology platform delivery or product management, with deep expertise in ServiceNow HR Service Delivery and its integration within an HR technology ecosystem
   

 Deep functional and technical knowledge of ServiceNow HRSD—including Case \& Knowledge Management, Employee Service Centre, Journey Accelerator, Virtual Agent, and HR workflow configuration and automation
   

 Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture—including scoped applications, integration frameworks, business rules, and how HRSD modules interact with core HR systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, and Avature
   

 Working knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (SF EC) — understanding how core HCM data flows into and supports SNOW HRSD service delivery processes
   

 Experience in configuring and managing SNOW HRSD service catalogue, SLA frameworks, and case routing rules across multiple countries and business units
   

 Solid understanding of HR service delivery models — including Tier 0, Tier 1, and Tier 2 support structures and how SNOW HRSD enables self\-service and operational efficiency
   

 Experience delivering end\-to\-end SNOW HRSD implementations or enhancements — from requirements gathering, solution design, and build through to testing, release, and stabilization
   

 Experience working with agile methodologies and outcome\-oriented ways of working
   

 Experience delivering end\-to\-end platform solutions — from requirements gathering, solution design, and build through to testing, release, stabilization, and adoption
   

 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
   

 Understanding of cost drivers in software delivery and the impact of technical decisions
   

 A passion for digital product delivery, innovation, and continuous improvement
 



  





**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 




  





 As a Platform Product Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for driving the full lifecycle of digital products – from discovery and development to deployment and operations – ensuring they deliver value to the business and our customers.
   

  

 You will work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to secure alignment, remove obstacles, and ensure seamless delivery across teams and dependencies.
   

  

 You will also play a key role in building strong, high\-performing teams and enabling ways of working that support speed, quality, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 To be concrete, you will:
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle of ServiceNow HR Service delivery— from discovery and design through to deployment, operations, and adoption
   

 Drive prioritisation, delivery speed, and quality across platform releases
   

 Ensure SNOW HRSD configurations are accurately maintained, compliant, and aligned to business compensation processes and pay structures across all markets
   

 Ensure operational excellence across all platforms — including availability, performance, compliance, and data integrity requirements
   

 Remove blockers and manage cross\-team dependencies across other platforms
   

 Lead and develop high\-performing cross\-functional teams, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and collaboration
   

 Use data, KPIs, and insights to drive decisions — including platform performance metrics, SLA adherence, and delivery outcomes
   

 Contribute to reducing technical debt and improving long\-term platform sustainability across SNOW HRSD
   

 Govern platform documentation, configuration standards, and compliance requirements across the platform
 



  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





 You will be part of Group Digital, where we set the digital agenda to keep IKEA leading in a fast\-moving and uncertain world. We develop and operate digital products and platforms that support the entire IKEA value chain and enable better experiences for both customers and co\-workers. You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People \& Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk \& Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingkas global organisation.
   

  

 We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle\-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

title: Director of Product Management
description:
**About Tekion** 




 Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud\-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting\-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 Tekion enables Product teams to address customer and business challenges through innovative approaches. The company is looking for a Director, Product Management, to define and guide the direction of its overall CRM product portfolio. This position requires strong knowledge of CRM workflows, customer engagement, lifecycle management, AI\-enabled experiences, and user experience.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling complex tasks and building effective product solutions. Responsibilities include developing and executing the CRM product roadmap, prioritizing tasks with cross\-functional teams, making informed decisions based on data, presenting findings and recommendations to both customers and executives, and overseeing product lines from initial concept to post\-production support. The role also involves collaborating with a team that works on complex issues and aims to deliver effective solutions to customers.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Align Strategy to Execution** 
 – Partner closely with Business Product leaders who define product strategy, translating strategic direction into executable CRM roadmaps, delivery plans, and clear priorities for Product, Engineering, Design, and cross\-functional teams.
* **Drive CRM Execution and Outcomes** 
 – Own execution rigor across the CRM product portfolio, ensuring initiatives move from strategy to delivery with clear milestones, accountable owners, measurable business outcomes, and disciplined follow\-through across product adoption, retention, revenue goals, and new AI SKU launches.
* **Establish Success Metrics** 
 – Define and monitor metrics to evaluate platform success and foster a culture of data\-driven decision\-making. Regularly assess core business metrics and adjust priorities in response to evolving team goals.
* **Champion the Customer Perspective** 
 – Collaborate with our Business Teams and serve as the advocate for our products with customers by actively gathering feedback, communicating updates and improvements, and fostering customer advocacy. Develop a strong understanding of the business environment, communicate effectively in business terms, and bridge the gap between our customers and products. Maintain an in\-depth knowledge of user expectations to ensure applications align seamlessly with user workflows.
* **Blend Entrepreneurial Drive with Structured Methodology** 
 – Lead pivotal strategic initiatives by identifying areas for improvement and implementing solutions to refine customized processes. Approach challenges with both agility and discipline, ensuring projects are initiated efficiently and executed through systematic, scalable methodologies toward productization and repeatability.
* **Champion Product Process Discipline** 
 – Drive Agile practices, structured JIRA methodology, sprint planning, backlog grooming, prioritization rigor, and consistent execution tracking across the CRM product organization.
* **Manage and Mentor** 
 – Guide our dedicated team of Product Managers toward excellence. Support their professional and personal growth, facilitate skill development, and cultivate a high\-performing, dependable, and unified team.
* **Prioritize Across Organizational Priorities** 
 – Partner with Business Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and product vertical leaders to align CRM roadmap execution with broader company priorities. Make trade\-offs transparent, sequence work effectively, and ensure teams focus on the highest\-impact initiatives.
* **Lead Product Engagement and Communication** 
 – Build strong relationships with leaders across Business Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Learning \& Development, Customer Success, and General Management. Provide crisp execution visibility, escalate risks and dependencies early, and ensure stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, decisions, and delivery progress.
* **Enable Scalable Speed** 
 – Design and implement processes that support rapid execution while maintaining sustainability and scalability. Prioritize resources effectively, clearly articulate trade\-offs, and position the team to achieve immediate targets as well as long\-term objectives.



**Requirements** 



* Strong business acumen with experience navigating complex product development cycles
* 10\+ years in Product Management, with deep user empathy and process understanding
* 4\+ years directly managing product managers
* Advanced degree (MBA or Engineering) from a top\-tier institution
* Experience leading both onshore and offshore teams
* Proven ability to drive prioritization and collaborate across functions
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Successful track record in CRM space
* End\-to\-end product lifecycle management, including post\-release support
* Skilled in designing scalable processes
* Hands\-on approach and proactive contributor
* Exceptional collaboration skills within cross\-functional environments
* Ability to anticipate user needs and identify improvement areas
* Dedicated to delivering superior user experiences with measurable business results



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in the automotive retail industry or with dealer/ OEM data.
* AI/ML product management experience

title: Sr. Manager, Technical Programs
description:
**The Company**
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.
   

  

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

 Role Overview:
 



  





 We are a technology\-led healthcare solutions provider enabling healthcare and pharmaceutical organizations to be future\-ready. At the intersection of AI, digital transformation, and commercial excellence, we help our clients modernize content, marketing operations, and engagement models using Generative AI.
 



 We offer accelerated global growth opportunities for bold, entrepreneurial, and high\-impact talent. You will work in a fast\-evolving AI landscape, partnering directly with senior client stakeholders to drive digital and content transformation programs powered by GenAI.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 The GenAI Consultant will lead digital and content transformation initiatives leveraging Generative AI technologies. This role is highly client\-facing and consultative, requiring strong business acumen, communication skills, structured thinking, and the ability to translate AI capabilities into measurable commercial outcomes.
 



 You will work across pharma marketing, medical, brand, and content teams to modernize workflows including modular content creation, omnichannel personalization, AI\-assisted value chain transformation, AI video generation, automated asset assembly, and much more.
 



 This is not just a technical role — it is a consulting\-driven transformation role.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Client Engagement \& Stakeholder Management (Critical)
 



  





 • Act as a trusted GenAI advisor to senior marketing and digital leaders.

 • Build strong client relationships and influence decision\-making.
 



 • Drive alignment across marketing, IT, compliance, and agency teams.
 



 • Demonstrate strong storytelling, presentation, and workshop facilitation skills.
 



  





 This role demands exceptional communication skills and executive presence.
 



  





 Digital \& Content Transformation Consulting
 



  





 • Identify and structure high\-value GenAI use cases across commercial, marketing, medical, and content operations.
 



 • Lead discovery workshops and executive discussions to define AI transformation roadmaps.
 



 • Develop business cases, ROI models, and capability maturity assessments.
 



 • Design operating models for AI\-enabled content supply chains.
 



 • Translate digital transformation objectives into scalable GenAI solution frameworks.
 



  





 Program Delivery \& Execution
 



  





 • Lead pilot design and scale\-up initiatives.
 



 • Manage cross\-functional teams across technology, content, and data.
 



 • Develop transformation playbooks, governance models, SOPs, and capability frameworks.
 



 • Define KPIs to measure AI\-driven efficiency, speed, and quality improvements.
 



 • Drive change management and adoption enablement.
 



  





 GenAI Tools \& Solution Design (Optional, but good to have)
 



 Hands\-on exposure and advisory capability across tools such as:
 



  





 • LLM Platforms: ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude, Gemini
 



 • Content AI: Jasper, Copy.ai, Writer
 



 • Enterprise AI: Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Einstein GPT
 



 • AI Video: Synthesia, Runway, Pika Labs, HeyGen
 



 • Image \& Creative AI: Midjourney, DALL·E, Adobe Firefly
 



 • RAG \& Knowledge Systems: LangChain\-based frameworks, vector databases
 



  





 Responsibilities include:
 



  





 • Designing prompt frameworks and reusable AI modules.
 



 • Building structured prompt libraries for AI\-based content generation.
 



 • Designing AI\-driven content workflows (from source to derivative assets).
 



 • Implementing AI video generation for training, sales enablement, brand communication.
 



 • Ensuring governance, compliance, and responsible AI deployment in pharma.
 



  





 GenAI Video \& Multimedia Capabilities (Optional, but good to have)
 



  





 • Advise clients on AI\-driven video generation for HCP engagement, internal training, product explainers, and personalized content.
 



 • Design AI\-powered avatar videos, voiceovers, subtitles, and localization workflows.
 



 • Integrate GenAI video into omnichannel strategies.
 



 • Build scalable frameworks for rapid video content production using AI.
 



  





 Desired Profile (Experience, Key Skills)
 



  





 • 3\+ years of experience in GenAI, digital consulting, content transformation, or AI\-led marketing initiatives.
 



 • Pharma or healthcare background preferred.
 



 • Experience in content operations, omnichannel strategy, or marketing transformation.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or digital/AI certification preferred.
 



  





 Skills \& Competencies
 



  





 • Strong consulting mindset with structured problem\-solving ability.
 



 • Deep understanding of Generative AI applications in digital and content ecosystems.
 



 • Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Ability to influence and manage senior stakeholders.
 



 • Strong storytelling and business case development skills.
 



 • Hands\-on knowledge of GenAI tools and AI video platforms.
 



 • Ability to operate in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments.
 



 • Strong documentation, PowerPoint, and framework\-building capability.
 



 • High ownership and proactive leadership mindset.

title: Release Manager
description:

 Rakuten India is the Development Centre and key technology hub of the Rakuten Group, Inc. With 1700\+ employees and growing, Rakuten India is housed in Crimson House Bangalore in the heart of the city.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for an experienced Release Manager to own and orchestrate the end\-to\-end software release lifecycle across multi\-cloud environments (GCP, Opensource) and a distributed microservices architecture. Operating at the intersection of engineering, operations, and business delivery, the role ensures that BSS platform releases — spanning billing, charging, customer management, and digital channels — are deployed to production safely, predictably, and with full stakeholder alignment.
 



  





 You will coordinate releases across engineering, QA, DevOps, and product teams — ensuring quality, stability, and speed of delivery while managing a structured release calendar from scope freeze through post\-deployment closure.
 



  





***Works closely with:***
*Engineering Leads, QA, Security, DBAs, Product, SRE/Ops, and Platform teams.* 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Release Planning \& Coordination** 



* Define and maintain release schedules, release trains, and sprint\-to\-production pipelines
* Coordinate with product managers, tech leads, and QA to align release scope, timelines, and dependencies
* Manage release calendars across multiple microservices with independent deployment cadences
* Run release readiness reviews, align stakeholders, and manage maintenance windows for successful production deployments
* Chair the release kick\-off with the Change Management team to freeze release scope (CRs, Trouble Tickets, Problem Tickets, Technical Enhancements etc.)
* Conduct CR explanation sessions with Functional Leads.



**2\. CI/CD \& GitHub Management** 



* Own and maintain branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk\-based development) in GitHub
* Manage GitHub Actions workflows, pull request policies, and branch protection rules
* Coordinate merges, feature flags, and hotfix processes across 100\+ microservice repositories
* Enforce tagging, versioning (SemVer), and changelog standards across repos
* Collaborate with DevOps/Platform teams on Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE), Helm charts, and Terraform\-based infrastructure changes



 Validate branch commits for each Microservice against release scope
 



**3\. Infrastructure \& Configuration Management** 



* Manage environment\-specific config promotions and secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault)
* Ensure zero\-downtime deployment strategies: blue/green, canary, and rolling updates
* Execute configuration comparison across QA, Pre\-prod and Production environments
* Review PR checklists covering: EPIC completeness, flow impact analysis, NFR compliance, code coverage, and unit test coverage
* Perform replication validation of production deployment on pre prod environment.



**4\. Database Release Management** 



* Coordinate schema migrations and data migrations across polyglot database stacks (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Couchbase, Elastic)
* Partner with DBAs to review, test, and schedule backward\-compatible DDL changes
* Ensure migration rollback plans exist for every release
* Oversee data remediation MOP preparation and obtain DBA/Designer/EM approvals before release



**5\. Runbook \& MOP Ownership** 



* Author step\-by\-step runbooks covering execution sequence, expected timings, approver/reviewer names, rollback steps, and PR \& Docker image details
* Prepare MOPs for all applicable release items — particularly manual activities such as DB field additions, template creation/activation, and config changes
* Conduct rollback simulation testing in the Staging environment and update runbook accordingly
* Create and maintain the Dependency Matrix mapping EPICs to Microservices for partial rollback analysis



**6\. Quality Gates \& Risk Management** 



* Define and enforce release quality gates (test coverage, DAST/SAST scans, performance benchmarks)
* Identify, track, and communicate release risks and cross\-service dependencies
* Lead post\-release retrospectives and blameless post\-mortems; maintain an incident escalation playbook
* Conduct pre\-release BU (Business Unit) impact assessment and communicate risks to stakeholders



**7\. Monitoring \& Observability** 



* Verify release health via monitoring dashboards (Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, Dynatrace)
* Define and track release KPIs: deployment frequency, change failure rate (CFR), MTTR, and lead time for changes (DORA metrics)
* Coordinate rollback execution when SLOs are breached post\-deployment



**8\. SVC, CR \& Approval Management** 



* Create and drive approvals for SVC (Security Change) tickets and Release Requests (RR)
* Ensure all regulatory, security, and process compliance gates are cleared before production deployment authorization



**9\. Stakeholder Communication \& Release Reviews** 



* Prepare and present release materials for L3 stakeholder review including release scope, risk summary, and deployment plan
* Facilitate L2 and L1\.5 release review sessions for management sign\-off
* Communicate release status, delays, and re\-scheduling internal and external stakeholders with appropriate approval materials



**10\. Security, Compliance \& Post\-Release** 



* Manage Security Vulnerability (SecEx) ticket status and obtain extension approvals for vulnerabilities deferred to future minor releases
* Lead post\-release RCA processes; track and close all open action items before the next release kick\-off
* Drive process improvement initiatives in SCM, config validation, automated quality gates, and pre\-production environment parity

 Indicate if this role is an office/field/onsite role.

 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.

* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Strategy\-specific experience:**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (TMT \- Technology, Media, Telecommunications )**
* Understanding of value chain, key business capabilities, processes, and user journeys enabling organizations in one or more of TMT sectors (Technology, Telecommunications, Media \& Entertainment) in B2B and / or B2C domains
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends including the associated technology implications within TMT industry. Interest and knowledge about the current trends in one or more of TMT sectors.
* Ability to develop business requirements and translate them into technical requirements.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end digital architecture principles, leading technology stacks (e.g. BSS / OSS in Telcos, Lead to Cash in Tech Cos, Enterprise stacks like ERP, HR, etc.), infrastructure with exposure to new age tools, within TMT industry
* One life cycle project execution experience in defining and/or implementing technology strategy, target\-state solutions, and roadmap for improving business outcomes.
* Candidates with project experience on either one or more of the following areas:
* IT Strategy \& Alignment – Delivering IT Strategy, driven both from a top\-down analysis starting with an articulated business strategy and a bottom\-up technology capability analysis; Experience working on IT cost reduction techniques, portfolio modernization and delivery roadmap creation within TMT.
* Technology Operating Model Design \- Assessment of current state operating model, ability to identify pain points and process gaps; design of target state operating model and associated roadmap for TMT companies.
* Enterprise Architecture – Experience of Enterprise Architecture capabilities such as Blueprinting, solution architecture, architecture assessment, planning and cost estimation. Knowledge of any of the major Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (preferred) E.g., TOGAF, FEA(F), and DoDAF
* IT Outsourcing \- Experience working on IT Outsourcing model, vendor analysis and benchmarking, contract analysis and understanding of how IT resources create shareholder (business) value.
* Cloud Strategy – Understand the impact of cloud computing in business and technology decisions, ability to identify and articulate the business and technology drivers of cloud computing within TMT, design of business cases for cloud. Certifications such as AWS, GCP, Azure will be a plus. Experience with workload assessment, business cases development, operational assessment, roadmap creation, vendor selection.
* AI (GenAI, Agentic AI) – Knowledge and experience in AI and GenAI concepts, landscape (E.g., OpenAI, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, NVIDIA AI Foundations, GPT3 etc.) use cases and ability to assess AI use case fitment based on client demands. Understanding of the application of latest trends such as Agentic AI to TMT companies. Ability to quantify AI value for organizations and create AI business/value case along with an AI adoption roadmap.
* Technology Program Management – Understanding of IT program and project management principles, techniques and tools, including Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, Site Reliability Engineering. Experience on tools such as JIRA, Miro / Lucidchart, SQL is desirable but not mandatory.
* Preferred experience of engaging in strategic issues for senior\-level clients including C\-Suite executives
* Exposure to working in non\-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders.


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Clear and concise communication \- Conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Good client presence – Interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- Ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- Develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Network \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.
* AI and analytics tooling \- Ability to use AI tools for professional\-level research and consulting artifacts creation; Exposure to basic automation for productivity using these tools is a good to have; Ability to use analytics tools such as Tableau, PowerBI and basic awareness of SQL

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 Cohesity is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive execution for our Filesystem \& Storage portfolio. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You'll own execution for a defined area of our filesystem and storage platform spanning customer\-managed and cloud SaaS working in tight partnership with engineering, UX, and go\-to\-market teams, directly with customers across the globe.
   

  

**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:**
* Own the roadmap and PRDs for your area within Filesystem \& Storage driving innovation and adoption across \- Enterprise file systems and storage protocols (NFS, SMB, S3, etc.), Scale\-out and distributed storage architecture, Data mobility, interoperability, and platform performance, Storage efficiency, resiliency, and scalability at petabyte scale, Cloud/hybrid\-cloud extensions, and adjacent agentic AI\-driven data management.
* Go deep with engineering, daily — understand system internals well enough to drive real design conversations, not just requirements hand\-offs.
* Work through disagreements with engineering using data and trade\-off framing — not by pulling rank or escalating by default.
* Own release trade\-off calls when scope, quality, and timeline conflict, and communicate the “why” clearly.
* Stay engaged from PRD through design review, build, GA, and beyond. Shipped is the starting line, not the finish.
* Define success metrics before you ship and track them after: adoption, usage depth, retention, support tickets, NPS/CSAT.
* Be the voice of the customer — keep a constant pulse on markets, competitors, and technology trends to spot opportunities and risks early.
* Partner with Marketing on packaging, pricing input, blogs, and launch events for your area.
* Track your product after it ships — revisit adoption and quality data at 30/60/90 days and feed learnings back into the roadmap.


**You'll partner closely with:**
* A Principal PM or Head of Product for Filesystem \& Storage, aligning your execution with the broader roadmap.
* Peer PMs across adjacent areas of the Cohesity platform.
* GTM teams — Marketing, Ecosystem, Support, Enablement, Sales, and Sales Engineering.
* A progressive UX team, and a world\-class engineering team you'll work alongside daily — not just at the start and end.


**WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:**
* 7–10 years of PM experience owning and shipping complex, technical B2B/infrastructure products end to end — not just writing requirements and moving on.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with enterprise filesystems and storage (block/file/object); exposure to cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) or agentic AI is a plus, not required.
* Strong grasp of distributed systems, storage protocols, and performance/scalability trade\-offs — you can read an architecture diagram and hold your own in a design review.
* A track record of delivery you can walk through in detail: what you shipped, why, the impact, and how you measured it.
* A customer\-obsessed, ownership\-driven philosophy — “shipped” is the starting line, not the finish line.
* Experience partnering with Marketing on launches, packaging/pricing, and blogs — and a habit of tracking a product after it ships.
* MBA, cloud certifications, or exposure to agentic AI/LLM system design are a plus, not a requirement.

title: Product Manager, Patient Messaging
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Join athenahealth's Patient Experience (PEX) division as a Product Manager for the Patient Messaging Zone in Bangalore. In this role, you will own a defined product area within Patient Messaging, driving the roadmap for AI\-enabled communication capabilities that help patients and care teams connect efficiently and safely. You will work closely with engineering, data science, UX, and analytics teams to deliver messaging experiences that are usable, trustworthy, and grounded in responsible use of AI. This role partners closely with US\-based product peers and reports to the Zone's product leadership in Bangalore.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Patient Messaging Zone brings together Product Management, Engineering, UX, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve how patients and provider staff communicate. The team is expanding its use of AI to reduce staff burden while keeping patients safe and informed. This role will help shape product decisions for an assigned area within that portfolio, working in close partnership with the Bangalore development organization and US stakeholders.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& AI\-Enabled Delivery**
* Define and manage the product strategy and roadmap for an assigned area within Patient Messaging.
* Learn users' workflows (patients, front\-desk/clinical staff) and propose AI\-enabled solutions that reduce friction and improve response times.
* Collaborate with data science and engineering to shape AI features ensuring they are measurable and appropriate for patient\-facing communication.
* Define expected behavior for AI\-enabled capabilities, including guardrails for trust, explainability, escalation to a human, and handling of low\-confidence outputs.
* Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements that support engineering delivery, including requirements specific to model behavior, edge cases, and fallback paths.
* Use AI\-enabled tools and product analytics to inform requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and speed up decision\-making across planning and delivery.


**Cross\-Functional Execution**
* Work with engineering and scrum teams to prioritize backlog items and guide day\-to\-day delivery in an Agile environment.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to evaluate customer needs, market trends, and competitive signals relevant to patient messaging and conversational AI.
* Contribute to product discovery: identifying problems, testing concepts, and validating solutions (including AI\-generated outputs) with users and stakeholders.
* Monitor product and model performance after release; use feedback, quality metrics, and user input to guide iterative improvement.
* Support launch planning, alpha/beta feedback cycles, adoption activities, and resolution of production issues.
* Represent the voice of the customer in product and design discussions, balancing efficiency gains from AI against patient safety and data sensitivity considerations.
* Coordinate with legal, compliance, security, and patient safety partners on responsible\-AI review processes for messaging features.


**Collaboration Across Geographies**
* Work closely with US\-based product peers to align on workflow design, requirements, and roadmap sequencing.
* Contribute to measurement frameworks for feature and model performance within the zone.
* Support continuous improvement efforts across the product lifecycle, including documentation of AI feature behavior for internal and client\-facing teams.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree required; a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
* 8\+ years of product management experience; healthcare or health technology experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and how they apply to product delivery, including familiarity with model lifecycle concepts (training, validation, deployment, monitoring).
* Understanding of responsible AI principles \- bias, explainability, human oversight, and trust.
* Familiarity with data pipelines, data quality considerations, and experimentation methods (e.g., A/B testing of model\-driven features).
* Experience bringing AI\-driven or data\-intensive products to market and supporting adoption post\-launch.
* Technical understanding of mobile, SaaS, messaging infrastructure, and APIs sufficient to assess feasibility and timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI/technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable gathering requirements from globally distributed teams and coordinating delivery across geographies.


**About Athenahealth**

 —

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Axiamatic is the AI\-native control plane for enterprise transformation. Large transformation programs — ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, enterprise\-wide operating model changes — have for decades exceeded what any human team can coordinate. Roughly 70% of these multi\-year, multi\-hundred\-million\-dollar initiatives fall short of expectations. Misalignments and drift build up quietly, and by the time they surface, the cost is already in.
   





 We're changing that. Axiamatic builds a Living Context Graph — a continuously updated digital twin of a customer's transformation, ingesting structured and unstructured signals from 250\+ enterprise systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, Teams, Slack, and more). On top of it, our Transformation Agents detect translation loss, cross\-stream drift, and change resistance as they form, and our Playbooks route remediation to the right stakeholder in the tools they already use.
   





 We came out of stealth in March 2026 with $54M from Greylock and Bessemer. Our founders Rajiv Gupta and Kaushik Narayan have done this before — most recently at Skyhigh Networks (acquired by McAfee), where they defined the Cloud Access Security Broker category that Gartner once named the fastest\-growing in cybersecurity. Rajiv previously co\-founded Confluent Software (Oracle) and Securent (Cisco). Our early customers include the Heico Company and Marmon (a Berkshire Hathaway subsidiary), and we're working with the world's largest systems integrators.
   





 About the role
   





 You'll be one of the early product managers at Axiamatic, owning a major area of our platform end\-to\-end and working with our product and engineering leadership, SMEs and our customers. This is a rare 0→1 \+ scale role: the product is in market with reference customers, the platform is real, and the category is wide open.
   





 You'll define how some of the world's most consequential transformation programs are run — what signals we capture, what risks our agents detect, and how guidance reaches executives, PMOs, and change leaders in the flow of their work.
   

  





 What you'll do
   




* Own a major product area end\-to\-end — strategy, roadmap, execution and enablement.


* Live with our customers and design partners. Sit in on transformation steering committees, ride along with SI delivery teams, and bring the texture of the work back to engineering and design.


* Drive 0→1 and 1→N in parallel. Take new concepts from problem definition through alpha, beta, and GA while continuing to harden what's already in production at Fortune 500 customers.


* Partner deeply with engineering. Work with engineering scrums to prioritise sprints, groom stories, and make sharp trade\-offs across scope, quality, and time. Translate ambiguous customer signals into crisp product specs.


* Shape the Agentic experience. Define how Transformation Agents, the Living Context Graph, and Playbooks come together for executives, PMO leaders, and OCM teams.


* Define and own metrics. Instrument the product, set the bar for adoption and outcomes, and use data to refine the roadmap.


* Be a voice of the company externally. Write blogs, present at customer briefings and partner events, and help shape how the market understands the category we're building.


 Requirements
   

  

* 5\-7 years in product management, with meaningful time at enterprise B2B SaaS companies. Bonus if you've worked on AI/ML and agentic systems.


* A track record of owning a product from inception to launch


* Strong technical instincts. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be able to reason about LLM\-powered features, distributed systems, data pipelines, and integration architectures, and hold your own in technical tradeoff conversations.


* Customer obsession. You discern signal from noise across customer conversations, market feedback, and product telemetry — and you let data refine your intuition rather than replace it.


* Excellent communication. You write clearly, present confidently to executives, and are equally comfortable in a customer war room, a sprint review, and a partner kickoff.


* Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity. Early\-stage pace, continuous iteration, and shipping under uncertainty energize you.


* Lead by example. Humble, low\-ego, intellectually honest, and genuinely curious. You raise the bar for the people around you.



 Even better
   




* Experience building or shipping LLM\- or agent\-powered products in production.


* Background as an engineer, consultant, or transformation practitioner before becoming a PM.


* Familiarity with the enterprise integration landscape (SAP, Jira, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday, Azure DevOps, SharePoint).

title: Senior Product Manager - Clinical Data

**Position Summary:**

 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to join the
 **Patient Record \& Insights Zone (PRIZ)**

 **Chart Data \& ChartSync team** 
 in
 **Bangalore**

The Patient Record \& Insights Zone is focused on making every practice ready for every patient by helping practices understand a patient’s evolving clinical story through connected longitudinal data across care settings, improving readiness, strengthening care transitions, and supporting better decisions before, during, and between visits.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Manager on the
 **Chart Data \& ChartSync team**

 **ChartSync** 
 helps bring important patient information from organizations, documents, and external data sources into
 **athenaOne** 
 and make it usable within the patient record.

 **Chart Data \& ChartSync roadmap** 
 , working closely with
 **Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Management, and other cross\-functional teams**

 **seamless, intelligent, and automated** 
 by getting the right information into the record at the right time, reducing unnecessary manual review and reconciliation, and helping clinicians quickly understand what has changed and what requires their attention.
   

  

 This role requires someone comfortable managing
 **multiple product threads simultaneously** 
 , balancing longer\-term roadmap discovery with near\-term delivery questions, customer needs, technical dependencies, cross\-product dependencies, and emerging opportunities.
   

  

**AI**

 . You will also partner with Engineering and Design to identify opportunities to incorporate AI directly into the products and experiences delivered to customers.

 The
 **Patient Record \& Insights Zone (PRIZ)**

 **longitudinal data across care settings** 
 , improving readiness, strengthening care transitions, and supporting better decisions before, during, and between visits.
   

  

 The
 **Chart Data \& ChartSync team**

 **athenaOne**

 The team is focused on creating a more
 **complete and useful patient record** 
 without creating additional work for the people caring for the patient. This includes improving the flow, quality, relevance, and usability of incoming clinical data and ensuring information is available within the workflow where it is most useful.
   

  

 You will work across
 **clinical record, interoperability, documents, clinician workflow, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product Marketing, and other Product teams**

* Partner with Product Management leadership and other Product Managers to shape product strategy, priorities, and multi\-release roadmaps for the broader product area.
* Develop deep expertise in users, customers, clinical workflows, and the underlying data ecosystem.
* Understand how clinicians find, review, reconcile, and use clinical information from outside their practice and identify opportunities to reduce friction and improve confidence in the patient record.
* Manage multiple product threads simultaneously, balancing discovery, delivery, customer needs, technical dependencies, and longer\-term roadmap work while maintaining focus on the highest\-value problems.
* Serve as Product Owner for Agile/Scrum teams supporting assigned areas of Chart Data and ChartSync.
* Define priorities, refine epics and user stories, and make thoughtful trade\-offs between scope, quality, and timing.

* Partner closely with Engineering, UX/Design, Analytics, and other Product teams to simplify the flow of incoming clinical data, improve data quality and relevance, and bring information into workflows where it is most useful.
* Identify and manage cross\-product dependencies across athenaOne to create a coherent experience rather than solving individual data and workflow problems in isolation.

* Partner with Engineering and Design to use AI to improve how the team discovers, designs, builds, tests, and iterates on products.
* Identify opportunities to thoughtfully incorporate AI into Chart Data and ChartSync experiences where it can reduce manual work, improve understanding of clinical information, or create better outcomes for users.
* Continuously evaluate customer and user feedback to identify emerging product opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Balance near\-term delivery needs with longer\-term product strategy and roadmap discovery.
* Determine what requires immediate attention, what can wait, and what needs to be true to move each product area forward.

* Demonstrated experience owning complex product problems from discovery through delivery, adoption, and measurement.
* Proven ability to manage several meaningful workstreams simultaneously, navigate ambiguity and changing priorities, and make clear decisions about where to focus.
* Strong ability to take complicated and ambiguous problems and translate them into clear product direction and a sequence of achievable investments.
* Experience working with products involving complex data, integrations, workflows, or platform capabilities.

* Experience working closely with Agile/Scrum Engineering teams as a Product Owner.
* Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience using quantitative and qualitative evidence to make product decisions.

description:

 Are you a strong delivery leader within digital products and platforms, who enjoys leading cross\-functional teams and creating real business impact through technology?  We are looking for a Platform Product Delivery Manager to join IKEA Group Digital. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of digital products within a platform subdomain, ensuring they are built and operated with quality, scalability, and business value in mind.
   

  

 You are someone who inspires others, builds strong teams, and creates clarity in complex situations. You combine a strong customer focus with a deep understanding of technology and delivery, and you have the ability to translate insights into tangible product outcomes.
   

  

 Above all, you take ownership, show initiative, and are passionate about delivering high\-quality digital products that make a difference.
   

  

 Furthermore, we believe that you bring:
   

 Strong experience in leading cross\-functional product and engineering teams including people management in an international distributed setup
   

 5\-8yrs years of hands\-on experience in HR technology platform delivery or product management, with deep expertise in SAP SuccessFactors Compensation, Employee Central, Variable Pay, and Benefits modules
   

 Deep functional and technical knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Compensation (SF Comp) — including compensation plan configuration, salary structures, merit cycles, bonus plans, and pay scale management
   

 Strong understanding of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (SF EC) — including data models, position management, and how core HCM data flows into and supports compensation and pay processes
   

 Working knowledge on Benefits and Variable Pay solutions — understanding configuration, eligibility rules, and end\-to\-end process flows

 Experience working with agile methodologies and outcome\-oriented ways of working
   

 Experience delivering end\-to\-end platform solutions — from requirements gathering, solution design, and build through to testing, release, stabilization, and adoption
   

 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
   

 Understanding of cost drivers in software delivery and the impact of technical decisions
   

 A passion for digital product delivery, innovation, and continuous improvement
 



  





**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 




  





 As a Platform Product Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for driving the full lifecycle of digital products – from discovery and development to deployment and operations – ensuring they deliver value to the business and our customers.
   

  

 You will work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to secure alignment, remove obstacles, and ensure seamless delivery across teams and dependencies.

 Own the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle of SAP SuccessFactors Compensation as well as other solutions within Variable Pay, Benefits, Responsible Wage, and Gender Equal Pay processes — from discovery and design through to deployment, operations, and adoption

 Ensure configurations are accurately maintained, compliant, and aligned to business compensation processes and pay structures across all markets
   

 Ensure operational excellence across all platforms — including availability, performance, compliance, and data integrity requirements particularly during critical pay cycle periods
   

 Remove blockers and manage cross\-team dependencies across teams to enable smooth and predictable delivery flow
   

 Lead and develop high\-performing cross\-functional teams, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and collaboration
   

 Use data, KPIs, and insights to drive decisions — including performance metrics, SLA adherence, and compensation cycle delivery outcomes
   

 Contribute to reducing technical debt and improving long\-term platform sustainability
   

 Govern platform documentation, configuration standards, and compliance requirements
 



  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**

**Job Title: Senior Manager \- AI Product \& Portfolio Management**

**Job Summary:** 




 Senior Manager \- AI Product Portfolio Management will lead a team of applied AI and generative\-AI engineers and own the product management of AI solutions within the India COE, accountable for the vision, design, development, and production delivery of AI and generative\-AI products, including LLM\-powered assistants, agentic and retrieval\-augmented (RAG) applications, and machine\-learning models, that drive measurable business outcomes across the enterprise.
 



 This role reports to the Director of Applied AI and operates within a multi\-disciplinary delivery organization collaborating closely with data scientists, data engineers, analytics engineers, and data governance professionals to take AI products from business problem to production, with the reliability, guardrails, and Responsible\-AI standards required in a regulated MedTech environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the design, development, and production delivery of applied AI and generative\-AI products LLM\-powered assistants, agentic workflows, RAG applications, and ML models from business\-problem framing through deployment and adoption
* Partner with business and functional leaders to identify high\-value AI use cases, frame problems, and translate them into well\-scoped, deliverable products with clear success metrics
* Own the AI product vision, strategy, and multi\-quarter roadmap, prioritizing a portfolio of AI and generative\-AI initiatives by business value, feasibility, and risk
* Serve as product owner for AI products: define target outcomes, write user stories and acceptance criteria, groom the backlog, and lead sprint prioritization and release planning
* Run product discovery with business, functional, and end\-user stakeholders to validate problems, shape target\-state workflows, and translate needs into clear, well\-scoped product requirements
* Define product success metrics and KPIs (adoption, value realized, accuracy, and efficiency), own the business case, and track and report realized benefits to leadership
* Manage the end\-to\-end AI product lifecycle from concept and pilot through scale\-up, iteration, and eventual retirement, balancing scope, timeline, cost, and quality
* Drive go\-to\-market, change management, and user enablement for AI products, including onboarding, training, documentation, and adoption campaigns that maximize usage and impact
* Manage AI use\-case intake and the product portfolio, applying prioritization frameworks and communicating trade\-offs, sequencing, and decisions to senior stakeholders
* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for AI products, including multi\-agent (Planner–Executor) designs, retrieval pipelines, tool orchestration, and integration of LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) with enterprise data
* Establish reference architectures and reusable patterns hybrid deterministic/non\-deterministic frameworks, prompt\-engineering standards, and shared services and APIs that accelerate delivery across teams
* Define and enforce LLMOps and MLOps practices: CI/CD for AI applications, environment promotion across dev, QA, and prod, model and prompt versioning, and horizontally scalable deployment
* Build evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and automated testing that gate every release including groundedness and quality checks, content\-safety controls, and business\-owned acceptance criteria
* Implement monitoring, observability, and feedback loops for AI products in production tracking accuracy, cost, latency, drift, and user adoption
* Establish coding standards, peer\-review processes, quality gates, and definition\-of\-done criteria for AI engineering deliverables consistent with how ANSR MedTech’s established Data \& AI teams operate
* Establish and operate the Responsible\-AI and governance pathway for AI and LLM usage on sensitive and regulated data spanning risk assessment, security testing, documentation, and compliance controls
* Ensure all AI products are secure, auditable, and compliant with data\-privacy, security, and regulatory requirements before production release
* Partner with data governance and security teams to define guardrails for approved models, data access, and human\-in\-the\-loop review
* Recruit, develop, and Manage performance of and lead a multi\-disciplinary team of applied AI and GenAI engineers, ML engineers, and full\-stack developers at varying experience levels
* Build and lead delivery PODs, hand\-picking talent and shaping team structure to match program demand
* Conduct regular design reviews, code reviews, and peer\-learning sessions to maintain quality and grow technical depth across the team
* Manage vendors and delivery partners end\-to\-end including selection, contracting, and performance to secure the strongest talent for each program
* Manage senior stakeholders across business, functional, and technology leadership, communicating progress, risks, and realized business impact
* Collaborate across data science, analytics engineering, and data engineering to share standards, patterns, and reusable components
* Contribute to the COE’s shared library of reusable AI components, agent and RAG patterns, and platform services
* Participate in roadmap definition, sprint planning, and capacity alignment with the I\&A organization
* Contribute to cross\-functional reviews of delivery metrics, adoption, and business value



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelors’ degree or above in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, engineering, or a related quantitative field or a Bachelor’s degree with equivalent depth of hands\-on experience
* 10\+ years of hands\-on in AI/ML, data science, or software engineering, with at least 3–5 years leading technical teams delivering products to production
* Proven track record of delivering generative\-AI and LLM products end\-to\-end from problem framing to production with measurable business impact
* Hands\-on as a product owner or (technical) product manager for AI or data products, including roadmap ownership, backlog Management, and stakeholder\-driven prioritization
* Deep hands\-on expertise with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) and GenAI patterns: agentic and multi\-agent architectures, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation
* Strong software and data engineering foundation: Python, SQL, and cloud data and AI platforms (Azure Databricks, Data Factory, Azure ML/Foundry, App Services or equivalent)
* Experience productionizing AI and ML with LLMOps/MLOps: CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, guardrails, evaluation harnesses, and monitoring
* Experience establishing Responsible\-AI and governance practices for AI system
* Demonstrated success building and scaling teams and/or delivery PODs, including hiring, mentoring, and vendor management
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to translate business problems into deployed AI solutions and to communicate outcomes to senior leadership



  





**Preferred skills:** 



* Experience in medtech, life sciences, healthcare, pharma, or other regulated industries
* Experience with agentic frameworks and orchestration, vector and retrieval stores (e.g., FAISS), and content\-safety or guardrail tooling (e.g., Azure Content Safety)
* Experience with Databricks (SQL, Unity Catalog) and the broader Azure AI ecosystem
* Familiarity with Responsible\-AI / GRC frameworks
* Experience standing up or scaling a Global Capability Center (GCC) or offshore AI/analytics team

 Joveo builds AI\-powered recruiting technology. We are building a team to deliver specialist human data and AI evaluation programs, with expert judgment at the centre of the work.
 



 We are hiring a director to shape this capability and build the organisation that delivers it.

 Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on.

 For someone who has already led complex AI programs, this is an opportunity to put that experience to work across an entire function. You will help decide which opportunities we pursue, what a successful pilot must demonstrate and how we grow without losing control of quality or cost.
 



  





**🧠 What you’ll do** 



* Shape the offering with leadership. Identify the customer problems we can solve well, define the deliverables and acceptance standards, and establish what we need to prove before expanding a service.

* Lead senior customer conversations. Translate technical needs into realistic commitments, resolve difficult escalations and use customer feedback to improve the offering. Help turn successful pilots into repeat programs.
* Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions.
* Shape tooling priorities with engineering. Turn recurring delivery problems into reusable capabilities, make deliberate choices about automation and maintain strong practices for customer data protection and traceability.

* You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field.

 We will look at the scope you have carried and the judgment you have developed. Your record of building a function matters more than the title you currently hold.
 



  





**✨ Why join Joveo** 




 You will help shape this capability while its operating choices are still taking form. Your decisions will influence the work we pursue, the leaders we hire and the standards customers experience.
 



 This role brings technical delivery and commercial responsibility together. If you have strong convictions about how complex AI programs should run, you will have the scope to build an organisation around them.
