title: Software Business Manager, APAC Enterprise Account
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 The Software Regional Business Manager is responsible for accelerating Emerson Test \& Measurement Group (NI) software growth across assigned regions by connecting global strategy with regional execution. The role partners with sales, marketing, product, customer success, channel, and regional leadership teams to build pipeline, expand adoption, improve renewals, and drive measurable business outcomes across broad\-base and enterprise account motions.
   

  

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* Own and execute the regional software growth plan, translating global software strategy into local market action across territories, channels, and strategic accounts.
* Drive software business performance through pipeline creation, conversion, adoption, renewal, expansion, and retention initiatives.
* Partner closely with sales, marketing, product, customer success, channel, distributor, and regional leadership teams to align priorities and accelerate growth.
* Enable sellers and partners with the tools, messaging, workflow understanding, and technical confidence needed to position Emerson Test \& Measurement Group (NI) software effectively.
* Serve as the regional voice of the customer and field, bringing market feedback and execution insights back to Software BU leadership.
* Lead through influence in a highly matrixed global organization, establishing priorities, operating cadence, success metrics, and accountability.


**Who You Are:**
 You are a results\-oriented business leader who connects strategy to measurable execution and delivers against business objectives; You communicate with clarity and influence, build trusted relationships across teams, and create alignment around shared priorities; You combine commercial acumen, technical curiosity, and customer workflow understanding to identify growth opportunities and remove barriers; You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, managing multiple stakeholders, and driving accountability without relying on direct authority; You bring energy, ownership, and a proactive problem\-solving mindset to complex regional and cross\-functional business challenges.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in business management, sales, marketing, strategy, product management, operations management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience owning business performance, growth initiatives, strategic planning, or regional execution programs.
* Strong ability to work across multiple functions and influence stakeholders in a global, matrixed environment.
* Analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to use data to assess performance, identify risks, and recommend actions.
* Ability to prioritize effectively, manage ambiguity, and execute in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel up to 20%.


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Experience driving software, SaaS, recurring revenue, renewal, adoption, or enterprise agreement growth motions.
* Familiarity with Emerson Test \& Measurement Group (NI) software platforms, customer engineering workflows, AI\-enabled workflows, LabVIEW\+, SystemLink, or related technical software environments.
* Experience working with regional sales teams, channel partners, distributors, or strategic enterprise accounts.
* Proven success scaling repeatable commercial plays across territories, markets, languages, or routes to market.
* Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex business and technical topics for field and leadership audiences.
* Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives that connect customer needs, product strategy, commercial execution, and measurable business outcomes.


**Our Culture \& Commitment to You:**
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
   

  

 We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
   

  

**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
 At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
   

  

 We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award\-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
   

  

 At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

 If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .

 Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.
   

  

 With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.

Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!

description:

title: Director - Founder's office
description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being India's most successful D2C food\-tech brand operating in 14 cities across the country delighting over 5M customers with our de\-licious fresh meat and seafood! Think you have what it takes to be the magic ingredient in the recipe that is Licious? Read on…
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 The Director, Founder's Office will work directly with our co\-founder on the goals that matter most to Licious: Revenue, EBITDA and the core organisational metrics that will power our next phase of growth. This is a high ownership role that sits at the nerve centre of the business, connecting the founder's priorities with how our Category, Growth and Marketing teams deliver against them.
 



  





 This role demands someone who is sharp with numbers, comfortable with ambiguity and able to influence senior stakeholders through clear thinking and solid data. It is a high\-accountability seat with rare exposure to how a fast\-scaling brand is run, and a launchpad into senior leadership roles across Licious.
 



  





**Have you got an awesome appetite for...** 




  





**Business Performance \& Founder Priorities** 



* Partnering with co\-founders to set, track and drive Revenue, EBITDA and other core organisational goals.
* Building the data backbone for founder decision\-making: dashboards, performance models and deep dives that show what is working and what is not.
* Turning numbers into sharp points of view and recommendations that move the business forward.
* Spotting risks and opportunities early and bringing them to the founder with a clear way forward.



  





**Cross\-Functional Goal Tracking \& Stakeholder Influence** 



* Working closely with Category, Growth and Marketing teams to align on the goals they have signed up for and track progress against them.
* Running business review cadences that hold up a mirror to performance, highlight gaps early and drive course correction.
* Influencing senior stakeholders through data and clear reasoning so that priorities translate into action.



  





**Vision, AOP \& Goal Setting** 



* Being a thought partner to the founders on how business performance is narrated to the board, shaping the story behind the numbers instead of only presenting them.
* Building the monthly MIS and board decks that give a clear and credible view of how Licious is performing and where it is headed.
* Being the single point of contact for investor queries, owning how data is defined, reported and explained so that the same number means the same thing everywhere it appears.
* Working with the founders and CXOs to translate the company vision into a concrete plan: annual operating plan design, OKRs, targets and the assumptions that sit underneath them.
* Breaking company level ambition down into function level goals for Category, Growth, Marketing, Supply Chain and Retail, and making sure the numbers add up bottom up as well as top down.



  





**Strategic Projects** 



* Leading special projects from the founder's desk as priorities evolve, from framing the problem through to execution.
* Picking up new business questions quickly, getting to the heart of them and landing outcomes with the right teams.



  





**We hope that you...** 



* Bring 4 to 6 years of post\-MBA experience, ideally a combination of management consulting \& investment banking or management consulting \& a consumer brand.
* Are genuinely data\-first: you can read P\&L fluently, understand unit economics and use numbers to build a point of view rather than just report them.
* Have strong stakeholder influencing skills and can drive alignment with senior leaders without formal authority.
* Bring the rigour and polish to own investor\-facing work, with board decks and MIS that stand up to close scrutiny.
* Thrive in ambiguity and switch contexts quickly without losing sight of the details.
* Are a structured thinker and a crisp communicator, both on paper and in the room.
* Take ownership end to end and are energised by a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment.
* Are excited about building a long\-term career at Licious, with the ambition to step into senior roles in functions such as supply chain, category, growth or tech.

- Expertise in Agentic AI, multi\-agent systems, autonomous workflows, AI orchestration, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, LLM fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, AI governance, Responsible AI, knowledge graphs, AI copilots, and enterprise\-scale LLM solutions.

 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 



**Get to know Okta** 




 Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.
 



 At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box \- we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 
 



 Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.
 



**Authentication Experience** 




 Okta supports a wide variety of organizations across both the Workforce and Consumer spaces. These diverse environments present unique challenges; no two organizations have the same requirements when it comes to the desired authentication experience for their end users. We are dedicated to striking the perfect balance between robust security and effortless usability. We are constantly building cutting\-edge authentication mechanisms designed to make access seamless, specifically tailored for the fast\-paced, user\-centric world of consumer identity and security\-centric world of workforce identity.
 



 If you are driven to innovate, passionate about the intersection of product flexibility and security, and want to help shape how the world connects to technology—we’d love for you to join us.
 



**Job Duties and Responsibilities:** 



* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Architects, QA, Product, Documentation, and UX teams) to ideate, design and implement features that drive the core authentication experience for users in the Workforce and Customer identity landscape
* Manage entire lifecycle of major features from ideation to delivery by maintaining strong emphasis on broader alignment, accurate estimations and high bar for quality and security
* Propose and align on technical strategy
* Contribute to technical designs, proposals, and architectural decisions
* Develop high\-quality, maintainable software components with comprehensive unit/functional tests
* Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and ensuring adherence to coding standards and security best practices
* Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team
* Mentor and coach junior engineers



**Minimum Requirements** 
**:** 



* Extensive experience working on medium to large projects in a technical capacity through accurate estimations, precise project planning, project oversight and delivery
* Strong hands\-on experience designing \&  developing enterprise software using Java with Springboot
* Proficient in object\-oriented programming principles, design patterns, server\-side technologies and distributed system concepts(caching, asynchronous processing, multi\-threading)
* Skilled in debugging and troubleshooting complex java codebase
* Passionate about writing clean, maintainable and scalable code with a deep focus on security
* Solid experience with cloud infrastructure platforms particularly AWS and databases
* Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills and proven ability to work with cross\-functional(Product/Design/QA) and geo\-distributed teams
* Lead and mentor junior engineers



**Nice to have** 
 :
 


* Prior experience as TechLead
* Strong understanding of IAM protocols(FIDO, WebAuthn, SSO, SAML, OAuth) and identity management best practices
* Strong understanding of multi\-factor authentication and phishing resistance
* Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and secure coding practices
* Some experience with javascript frameworks and basic UI development
* Prior experience building teams from ground\-up



**Education and Training:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of software development experience, with at least 5 years of experience designing and building enterprise grade software using Java at scale



 P25468\_3497187

title: SMB Implementation Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 \- all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors \- including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Implementation is an essential differentiator for Rippling. As an Implementation Manager, you will work with our customers to implement and drive the adoption of Rippling’s suite of products. You will consult with the customer to understand their unique objectives and leverage deep knowledge of Rippling’s products as well as a strong commitment to customer experience to help clients realize the full potential of our offerings.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Partner one\-on\-one with clients to develop custom plans and implement the Rippling products they have purchased across HR, Payroll, Benefits Administration, IT platform, and various other products tailored to the customer’s specific business objectives
* Proactively manage the implementation process end\-to\-end, consulting with customers to align on target timelines and specific goals, ensuring that each milestone meets their operational needs
* Drive adoption of purchased products providing bespoke guidance, best practices, and insights that empower clients to maximize the platform’s capabilities
* Partner with Sales, Account Management, Technical Account Management, and Support to ensure seamless hand\-offs and long\-term customer success
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to offer feedback on customer insights, partner on technical issues, and advocate for product enhancements that align with customer needs and industry trends
* Collaborate with internal teams in the development of processes and best practices which integrates customer feedback and learnings to increase operational efficiency and success


 What you will need
   

  

* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Implementation and/or Customer Experience at a rapidly growing SaaS company.
* Proven project management experience, deploying multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Stellar communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills along with a deep commitment to driving an exceptional customer experience.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with partners across Sales, CX, Product, and Engineering teams


 Bonus
   

  

* 2\+ years experience in a customer\-facing position within the HCM or IT space (HR, Payroll, Benefits, Identity Management, Device Management, etc).


 Note
   

  

* This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out of our Bangalore office three days a week.
* This job requires you a to work in the EST/PST shift

title: Lead Product Engineer - Design Verification (MM/VIP)
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**Job Title:** 
 Lead Product Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad
   

  

**Cadence** 
 is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality. Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health.
   

  

**The Cadence Advantage**
* The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge technology in an environment that encourages you to be creative, innovative, and to make an impact.
* Cadence’s employee\-friendly policies focus on the physical and mental well\-being of employees, career development, providing opportunities for learning, and celebrating success in recognition of specific needs of the employees.
* The unique “One Cadence – One Team” culture promotes collaboration within and across teams to ensure customer success
* Multiple avenues of learning and development available for employees to explore as per their specific requirement and interests
* You get to work with a diverse team of passionate, dedicated, and talented individuals who go above and beyond for our customers, our communities, and each other—every day.


**Job Summary**
 Drives development of products and technologies and has material responsibility for the success of that product/technology. MM VIP PE is expected to become an expert in the Memory domain of Verification IP family – protocol and product\-wise. The memory domain has many protocols such as SDRAM protocols (DDR5\), SGRAM protocols (GDDR6\), Memory Controller and PHY protocols (DFI), and others. The Cadence VIP Portfolio includes Memory Models that enable advanced verification of these protocols. The PE’s main role is to help accelerate VIP Portfolio adoption at Cadence’s top tier customers by supporting pre\-sales technical activities. To ensure that, one must have strong verification expertise and understand customer design and verification flows. As a MM VIP and protocol expert, PE drives product knowledge transfer across our field engineers and customers, providing training and developing collaterals. The PE will also need to translate high\-level requirements from customers into a technical spec and drive the product definition that fits the customer needs. The PE is expected to work independently and collaborate with other team members (R\&D, Marketing, Customer Support, Field Teams) to ensure all dimensions of the product are aligned. This role requires approximately 20% travel and cross\-site collaboration over multiple geographies (Asia Pacific, Europe, US\-East, US\-South and US\-West).
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Leads projects with high resource, risk and/or complexity
* Develops and leads large and multiple cross\-functional and cross\-organizational programs, initiatives, and activities with high resource requirements, risk and/or complexity
* Continually evaluates technology effectiveness/data interoperability of complex systems
* Manages issue resolution with vendors on tech/product quality and functionality and influences vendor roadmap and direction of products
* Communicates highly complex ideas, anticipates potential objections and persuades others, often at senior levels, to adopt a different point of view.


**Experience And Technical Skills Required**
* At least 4 – 8 years of experience with Design and Verification
* Experience with Developing Verification environments using System Verilog
* Working knowledge and experience with the UVM methodology
* Good experience on solving complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of various factors.
* Exercises judgment within broadly defined practices and policies in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Excellent problem\-solving and debugging skills
* Familiarity with Memory protocols is a must.
* Knowledge of the DFI protocol is a plus.


**Qualifications**
* BTech/BE/MTech/ME or equivalent with Electrical, Electronics \& Comm or Computer Science Engineering


**Behavioral Skills Required**
* Must possess strong written, verbal and presentation skills
* Ability to establish a close working relationship with both customer peers and management
* Explore what’s possible to get the job done, including creative use of unconventional solutions
* Work effectively across functions and geographies
* Push to raise the bar while always operating with integrity


**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Sr. Automation Lead–Enterprise Service Workflow (ServiceNow)
description:
The Sr. Automation Lead – Enterprise Service Workflow is responsible for transforming enterprise service operations through intelligent automation and AI, powered by the ServiceNow platform. This role owns the functional strategy and execution of enterprise\-wide workflows, enabling seamless, scalable, and resilient services across IT, employee, and business operations.
   

  

 Automation Lead will functionally guide SRE practices, enable production\-grade automation from federated development teams, and ensure platform stability, risk management, and audit readiness. This role bridges innovation and operational rigor—ensuring advanced automation and AI use cases reach production safely, compliantly, and at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own and execute the automation vision and roadmap for ServiceNow\-based service workflows.
* Identify, prioritize, and lead high\-impact automation opportunities across ITSM, ITOM, and custom enterprise workflows.
* Define platform standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures for enterprise service automation.
* Drive adoption of AI\-powered capabilities such as Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, AI Search, workflow intelligence, and GenAI experiences.
* Support transformation of CMDB to enable strong foundation
* Translate business needs into intelligent, outcome\-driven workflows that reduce manual effort and improve service quality.
* Establish KPIs to measure automation effectiveness, AI value realization, and operational impact.
* Support production readiness for enterprise workflows, including deployment standards, automated testing, and rollback strategies.
* Enable CI/CD\-driven ServiceNow deployments, partnering with DevOps and release teams to improve speed and reliability.
* Ensure automation changes move from ideation to production with minimal risk and maximum observability.
* Functionally lead and influence the SRE practice, embedding reliability into workflow design.
* Define and monitor service\-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, and reliability metrics for ServiceNow workflows.
* Drive platform resilience practices including monitoring, alerting, self\-healing automation, and incident avoidance.
* Establish and support a scalable federated automation model enabling product teams, citizen developers, and platform engineers.
* Define governance frameworks, guardrails, and certification approaches that balance speed with platform integrity.
* Promote reuse, API\-first design, and composable workflows to avoid fragmentation.
* Support the platform risk posture for the ServiceNow platform, including technical debt, upgrade impacts, and dependency risks.
* Partner with security, risk, and compliance teams to support internal and external audits, control evidence, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure enterprise workflows meet standards for data protection, access control, and operational resilience.
* Act as a trusted platform advisor to senior technology, operations, and risk leadership.
* Clearly articulate trade\-offs between innovation, reliability, and compliance.
* Influence outcomes across multiple teams without formal authority.


**Required Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of experience in ServiceNow platform leading, supporting and delivering Platform automations at scale.
* Deep hands\-on experience with ServiceNow workflows, integrations, automation tooling, and platform architecture.
* Proven success delivering automation and AI\-driven initiatives into production at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of SRE principles, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and production operations.
* Experience enabling federated or distributed development models within governed platforms.
* Demonstrated ownership of platform risk management, audit support, and compliance.
* Ability to operate as a senior IC leader, driving alignment and execution across multiple functions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ServiceNow certifications (CSA, CIS, CAD; CTA highly desirable).
* Experience designing or deploying GenAI\-based workflow automation.
* Background in highly regulated industries (banking, financial services, healthcare, utilities).
* Experience modernizing or scaling enterprise ServiceNow platforms.

 High voltage power business of Texas Instruments is looking for talented program manager. If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous \& ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking high voltage technologies \& shapes the future of power managements with products using GaN \- here is an opportunity for you!
 



 We are looking for Program Managers to manage the development of vast portfolio of high voltage products:
 



  





  




* Controllers to enable system solution with our GaN
* GaN based power stages
* GaN SiPs



  





**In this role, responsibilities may include:** 




  




* Responsible for High Voltage Power business unit's new and complex GaN based power stages, controllers, SIPs from concept through release, including advanced technology projects. Managing end\-to\-end product development: including hardware, software, architecture, foundry engagement etc.



  




* Handle the project in a fast and market driven environment with a clear focus on the business objectives, and support customer interactions. Own the project results, deliverables and success \- schedule, cost and quality. Resolves inter\-team and intra\-team conflicts / issues to ensure project goals are met.

 Your track record shows the ability to handle multiple interdependency project variables across different sites. You demonstrate strong communication skills through clarity of the message. title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, AHS
description:
**Description**
 Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.
   

  

 Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager \- Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across data ingestion pipelines, health record enrichment, data quality and normalization, and surfacing insights to clinicians and patients — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying data platforms and ML systems.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing
   

  

 Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
   

  

 Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain
   

  

 Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
   

  

 Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems
   

  

 Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in healthcare
* Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems
* Master's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics

**TITLE: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Application**
**Location: This position must be in the Bay Area, CA or Bengaluru, India and required to be in the office 2 to 3 times a week.**
**What You’ll Do**
 The Senior Product Manager, Agentic Application owns the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for an agentic AI application that automates insurance product configuration for Duck Creek carriers. This role defines how AI agents read, understand, and translate complex carrier product documents into structured, validated Duck Creek product configuration compressing work that takes analysts from weeks to hours.
   

  

 This role converts complex carrier workflow needs, AI accuracy requirements, document understanding challenges, and multi\-line\-of\-business scalability goals into clear product priorities, requirements, and measurable outcomes. It requires deep comfort operating at the intersection of agentic AI, insurance product domain knowledge, and enterprise software delivery.
   

  

 This role exercises independent judgment and partners across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, AI Platform, Customer Success, Professional Services, and carrier stakeholders to deliver governed, accurate, and scalable agentic configuration capabilities.
   

  

* Define and maintain the product strategy and roadmap for an agentic AI application that automates insurance product configuration, including document ingestion, structured data extraction, knowledge graph development, configuration generation, output validation, and human review workflow design.
* Translate carrier product configuration needs, document change workflows, accuracy requirements, and line\-of\-business expansion goals into clearly defined epics, features, use cases, requirements, user stories, and measurable product outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to define scalable, reliable, and maintainable agent pipeline patterns, including agent orchestration design, event\-driven communication, durable state management, and cloud infrastructure requirements.
* Define product capabilities for a knowledge graph that represents relationships between insurance product elements, enabling intelligent change impact detection, cross\-element dependency tracking, and semantic abstraction over raw product document structure.
* Drive an eval\-first product culture: define accuracy targets by capability, establish a continuous evaluation methodology using AI observability tooling, and ensure no feature ships without a measurable accuracy signal.
* Partner with AI Platform, Semantic Insurance Data, Data Orchestration, Security, and Governance teams to support trusted context, responsible AI controls, and reliable execution across carrier document types and product lines.
* Define carrier\-facing product capabilities, including configuration request intake, pipeline status visibility, reviewer experience, extraction result review, and output approval workflows.
* Evaluate trade\-offs across extraction accuracy, pipeline reliability, reviewer burden, scalability, carrier data privacy, infrastructure cost, and time\-to\-market when shaping product priorities and requirements.
* Define adoption, accuracy, reliability, and business impact measures — including extraction accuracy, configuration validity rates, human review approval rates, pipeline throughput, LOB onboarding velocity, and carrier time\-to\-configuration.
* Support release planning, readiness, and communication by clarifying scope, dependencies, risks, acceptance criteria, and expected accuracy outcomes.
* Maintain awareness of emerging agentic AI frameworks, LLM evaluation methodologies, knowledge graph technologies, document understanding models, and insurance product configuration patterns to inform product direction.


**WHAT YOU’VE DONE:**
**Required**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Insurance, Product Management, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of experience in technical product management, AI product management, platform services, software engineering, or related roles.
* Experience owning complex AI, data, platform, or document\-processing product capabilities.
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders, including engineering, architecture, data science, customer\-facing teams, and business stakeholders.
* Experience translating ambiguous business and technical problems into product strategy, roadmap priorities, requirements, release plans, and measurable outcomes.


**Preferred**
* Master's degree or equivalent advanced experience in a relevant field.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks, LLM evaluation, knowledge graphs, document understanding, structured data extraction, or agentic AI pipeline design.
* Experience in property and casualty insurance, InsurTech, financial services, or another complex regulated industry, particularly in product configuration, underwriting, policy administration, or manuscript management.
* Familiarity with event\-driven architectures, cloud\-native platforms, LangGraph or similar agent orchestration frameworks, and human\-in\-the\-loop system design.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
**Knowledge**
* Technical product management practices for complex AI, data pipeline, or document processing capabilities.
* AI agent design, including LLM\-based extraction, deterministic agent patterns, orchestration frameworks, and multi\-stage pipeline architecture.
* Extraction accuracy concepts, including eval harness design, scoring methodology, baseline comparison, and prompt iteration.
* Knowledge graph concepts, including entity relationship modeling, semantic abstraction, dependency graph traversal, and change impact analysis.
* Human\-in\-the\-loop design patterns, including review gate placement, correction capture, audit logging, and reviewer experience.
* Document understanding across complex insurance documents, including rate manuals, carrier filing documents, underwriting guidelines, and product manuscripts.
* Event\-driven system design, including versioned event contracts, Pub/Sub patterns, durable state management, and agent checkpointing.
* Responsible AI practices, including hallucination detection, deterministic output validation, schema\-enforced output gates, and accuracy\-gated deployment.
* Cloud\-native platforms, multi\-tenant SaaS architecture, and enterprise security patterns relevant to carrier data handling.


**Skills**
* Translating ambiguous carrier configuration needs and AI accuracy requirements into structured product requirements, clear priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Evaluating trade\-offs across extraction accuracy, reviewer burden, LOB scalability, infrastructure cost, carrier data privacy, and time\-to\-market.
* Analyzing accuracy, reliability, pipeline performance, and business impact metrics to inform product decisions and prioritization.


**Abilities**
* Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority across a broad cross\-functional organization, including Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Customer Success, Professional Services, and carrier customers.
* Ability to explain complex AI extraction, knowledge graph, and validation decisions in clear business and carrier terms.
* Ability to use AI\-enabled tools to support product discovery, analysis, prototyping, documentation, and iterative product development.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About Certinal:** 




  





**Certinal** 
 is a unified Consent \& Compliance Platform that replaces paper\-based consent, manual intake, and uncontrolled forms with a single, fully digital system built for enterprise organizations. It digitally captures patient consent, enables legally binding electronic signatures, and ensures compliance with major regulations including HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, SOC 2 Type II, and CMS\-0053\-F, while integrating directly with EHR systems like Epic and Oracle Cerner.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




  





 Certinal is looking for a Associate Product Manager to support the product team across discovery, specification and delivery for our e\-Signature and e\-Consent platform. You will work closely with engineering, design, sales and customer success to turn customer problems into shipped, well\-defined product.
 



 This is an execution\-focused role for someone early in their product career. You will write the stories, chase the details, keep the backlog honest and make sure what ships matches what was agreed. Because Certinal operates in regulated healthcare, you will also learn to treat audit trails, evidence and compliance requirements as first\-class product concerns rather than afterthoughts.
 



  





**Experience: 1 to 4** 
 years in product management or a closely related role, including a minimum of 1 year in healthcare SaaS.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and product requirement documents from agreed problem statements.
* Groom and maintain the backlog alongside engineering and QA, and keep priorities, dependencies and status current.
* Participate in sprint planning, refinement and review, and unblock engineering questions during the sprint.
* Triage customer feedback, support tickets and field requests into themes with evidence and frequency attached.
* Run structured competitive teardowns of e\-signature and e\-consent products and keep a living comparison current.
* Translate regulatory and security requirements into testable acceptance criteria in partnership with Pre\-Sales and Engineering.
* Support release planning, write release notes, and prepare internal enablement material for Sales and Customer Success.
* Track adoption, funnel and usage metrics in product analytics, and report on how shipped features actually perform.
* Assist with beta and pilot programmes, including participant selection, feedback capture and readout.
* Contribute to user research: interview scheduling, note\-taking, synthesis and sharing findings with the team.
* Maintain product documentation so that internal teams have one accurate source of truth.



  





**Skills \& Experience Requirements** 



* 1 to 4 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or an engineering, consulting or customer\-facing role with clear product exposure.
* Strong written communication; able to write a requirement that an engineer can build from without a follow\-up meeting.
* Structured problem\-solving and comfort breaking an ambiguous request into scoped, sequenced work.
* Hands\-on experience with an issue tracker such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Working familiarity with Figma and the ability to review and give useful feedback on designs.
* Basic SQL and comfort working with product analytics tools.
* Genuine curiosity about how enterprise software is bought, deployed and audited.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or an equivalent analytical discipline.



  





**Preferred** 



* Exposure to B2B or enterprise SaaS rather than consumer products.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks and reading API documentation.
* Interest in or exposure to regulated domains such as healthcare, financial services or clinical research.
* Experience using AI tooling to accelerate research, synthesis or documentation work.
* Prior internship or project work in product management.



  





**Why Join Certinal?** 



* **Real Ownership Early:** 
 Own features end to end rather than sitting on the edge of someone else’s roadmap.
* **Learn a Hard Domain:** 
 Regulated healthcare product work builds judgement that transfers anywhere.
* **Close to Customers:** 
 Direct exposure to enterprise buyers through Sales, Pre\-Sales and Customer Success.
* **Small Team, Short Loops:** 
 Decisions get made quickly and you will see your work ship.
* **Learning \& Development:** 
 Professional development budget and mentorship from senior product leadership.

description:

 Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept\-to\-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.
   

  

 You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision\-making.
   

  

**Digital Thread**
**Digital Thread** 
 focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept\-to\-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real\-time, data\-driven decision making.
   

  

* Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.
* Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept\-to\-service process integration.
* Current\-state assessments and future\-state operating model design that improve end\-to\-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision\-making across the value chain.


**Connected Twins**
**Connected Twins** 
 build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.
   

  

* Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end\-to\-end supply chains.
* Simulation\-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.
* Process architecture and future\-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision\-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

* Lead Digital Thread and Connected Twin transformation programs from strategy through execution across product development, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions
* Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps and investment strategies for clients seeking to improve traceability, visibility, operational resilience and decision intelligence

* Lead scenario simulation initiatives involving network optimization, disruption analysis, inventory strategies, manufacturing performance, quality improvement and supply chain risk assessment
* Define GenAI\-enabled decision intelligence capabilities, agentic workflows and AI copilots that support operational planning and business decision making
* Contribute to pre\-sales activities including opportunity qualification, client presentations, solution development, proposal creation and business case development
* Develop industry\-specific offerings, consulting methodologies, reusable assets, accelerators and thought leadership related to Digital Thread and Connected Twins
* Partner with Industry X, Data \& AI, Supply Chain, Engineering and Technology teams to develop integrated client solutions

title: TD- Product Owner-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Product Owner**
**Job Summary:**
 We are seeking a Product Owner at Senior Consultant rank to drive the execution of digital products and platforms by translating business needs into clear, actionable and value\-driven product requirements. The role requires strong product ownership, backlog management, agile delivery and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to connect product decisions to measurable business value, outcomes and benefits realization. The core focus of the role remains Product Management—owning the product backlog, shaping user\-centric requirements, enabling agile delivery and supporting adoption—while bringing practical exposure to value management concepts such as value cases, KPI definition, outcome tracking, prioritization by value and continuous value realization. The ideal candidate will bring experience in at least one sector or business domain, with life sciences/healthcare knowledge considered a strong advantage, and will work closely with business, engineering, data and design teams to deliver scalable digital solutions that create clear user and business impact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring features, user stories and enhancements are clearly defined, prioritized and aligned to business value.
* Translate business needs, user feedback and domain requirements into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria and functional requirements for delivery teams.
* Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, engineering, architecture and UX teams to shape solution requirements and deliver high\-quality product increments.
* Support the execution of digital product initiatives, with awareness of business value, user needs and technical feasibility.
* Apply value management principles to support prioritization decisions, linking epics, features and user stories to expected business outcomes, user impact, adoption goals and measurable value.
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, story clarification and acceptance activities to ensure delivery teams have clear priorities and are sprint\-ready.
* Act as the voice of the customer and business, balancing user needs, stakeholder expectations, dependencies and delivery constraints.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support MVP definition, release planning, testing, deployment and adoption of digital products.
* Track product performance, adoption indicators and delivery outcomes, and support continuous improvement through feedback loops and iteration.
* Support value tracking by defining relevant KPIs, benefits hypotheses and success metrics, and by using product feedback, usage data and stakeholder inputs to inform iteration and value realization.
* Apply understanding of product considerations such as usability, data quality, security and compliance in product requirement discussions.
* Bring experience in at least one sector or domain to inform use cases, workflows and prioritization decisions; life sciences or healthcare knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Prepare product updates, demos and working sessions for stakeholders, and support decision\-making through clear documentation and progress visibility.
* Contribute to agile, product management and value management best practices, reusable artifacts and continuous improvement across engagements, while ensuring product management remains the core delivery discipline.


**Must Have Skills:** 
 .
   

  

* Typically, 4–8 years of relevant experience in product ownership, business analysis, product management, digital product delivery or agile transformation roles.
* Working experience with product and delivery management tools including Jira, Aha! and Azure DevOps for roadmap planning, backlog management, sprint tracking, prioritization, release planning and cross\-functional delivery governance.
* Experience working on digital products, platforms or transformation initiatives in cross\-functional delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of agile product delivery practices including backlog management, user story creation, prioritization, sprint planning, acceptance criteria and release support.
* Working knowledge of value management in a product context, including value case support, benefits identification, KPI definition, outcome\-based prioritization and value realization tracking.
* Proven ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, engineers, architects, designers and data teams in a cross\-functional delivery environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clarify requirements, drive alignment and support delivery decisions.
* Experience in at least one sector or domain with the ability to apply contextual knowledge to product requirements and prioritization
* Familiarity with Agile / Scrum ways of working and experience supporting delivery of complex initiatives with quality and governance discipline.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Awareness of emerging technologies, analytics or automation capabilities that may support digital product innovation.
* Fundamental knowledge of and some experience with GenAI or Agentic AI concepts and use cases will be an added advantage.
* Experience working in regulated or data\-sensitive environments, especially life sciences, healthcare or adjacent sectors.
* Exposure to design thinking, customer journey mapping, service design, user\-centric requirement definition and value\-based prioritization approaches.
* Experience using value management artifacts such as value maps, benefits registers, KPI trees, OKRs or outcome roadmaps to support product decisions is preferred.
* Relevant certifications in Product Ownership, Agile, Scrum, Cloud or related disciplines.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Supply Chain optimization,
* Pricing strategy,
* Service Fulfillment (e.g. warranty management, field service management, service parts management, knowledge management).


 Our company has a global presence with offices in US, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, Poland, India and group headquarters in Sweden.

 With this we are
 **winning the hearts and minds of world\-leading organizations** 
 , such as JCB, Kubota, Electrolux, Toyota, Renault and Hitachi.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Owner** 
 to drive the delivery of AI/ML\-powered capabilities for Syncron's Contract Price SaaS platform. You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and business stakeholders to transform customer needs into scalable product capabilities that improve pricing decisions, contract profitability, and customer outcomes.
   

  

 What would you do?
   

  

  

* Design and develop a customer onboarding and analytics configuration and deployment process to support Expert Services and Partner organizations
* Own the product backlog and end\-to\-end delivery of AI/ML features from discovery through release.
* Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Prioritize \& maintain the backlog based on customer value, business impact, technical dependencies, and product strategy.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, UX, Customer Success, and customers to define and deliver innovative AI\-powered solutions.
* Engage key technical and domain experts across our customers
* Drive Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Partner with ML Engineers and Data Scientists to deliver on roadmap requirements for predictive models, model evaluation, explainability, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Communicate roadmap, delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and release plans to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Architecture teams to understand technical trade\-offs, platform \& product capabilities, and architectural decisions, ensuring product decisions support scalability, performance, security, and long\-term maintainability.
* Lead defect triage, manage technical debt, and ensure high\-quality product releases.
* Support release planning, documentation, product demonstrations, and customer enablement.
* Discover new ideas to incorporate AI into Product for new features, capabilities and improving stickiness of the product.
* Ensure AI/ML solutions deliver measurable business outcomes through improved pricing accuracy, profitability, and operational efficiency.


 What we expect
   

  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* 7–12 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst in enterprise SaaS products.
* Experience delivering AI/ML or data\-driven products in an Agile environment and working with Data Scientists.
* Strong experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and analytical skills.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in Contract Pricing, CPQ, Pricing Optimization, Revenue Management, Service Lifecycle Management, Warranty, or Aftermarket solutions.
* Knowledge of AI/ML concepts such as predictive analytics, model evaluation, explainability, and MLOps.
* Hands on experience with GenAI, Agentic AI
* Experience working with cloud\-based B2B SaaS platforms, APIs, analytics, and data products.

**About Certinal:** 




  





**Certinal** 
 is a unified Consent \& Compliance Platform that replaces paper\-based consent, manual intake, and uncontrolled forms with a single, fully digital system built for enterprise organizations. It digitally captures patient consent, enables legally binding electronic signatures, and ensures compliance with major regulations including HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, SOC 2 Type II, and CMS\-0053\-F, while integrating directly with EHR systems like Epic and Oracle Cerner.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




  





 Certinal is looking for a Product Manager to support the product team across discovery, specification and delivery for our e\-Signature and e\-Consent platform. You will work closely with engineering, design, sales and customer success to turn customer problems into shipped, well\-defined product.
 



  





 This is an execution\-focused role for someone early in their product career. You will write the stories, chase the details, keep the backlog honest and make sure what ships matches what was agreed. Because Certinal operates in regulated healthcare, you will also learn to treat audit trails, evidence and compliance requirements as first\-class product concerns rather than afterthoughts.
 



  





**Experience:** 
 4 to 8 years in product management or a closely related role, including a minimum of 1 year in healthcare SaaS.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and product requirement documents from agreed problem statements.
* Groom and maintain the backlog alongside engineering and QA, and keep priorities, dependencies and status current.
* Participate in sprint planning, refinement and review, and unblock engineering questions during the sprint.
* Triage customer feedback, support tickets and field requests into themes with evidence and frequency attached.
* Run structured competitive teardowns of e\-signature and e\-consent products and keep a living comparison current.
* Translate regulatory and security requirements into testable acceptance criteria in partnership with Pre\-Sales and Engineering.
* Support release planning, write release notes, and prepare internal enablement material for Sales and Customer Success.
* Track adoption, funnel and usage metrics in product analytics, and report on how shipped features actually perform.
* Assist with beta and pilot programmes, including participant selection, feedback capture and readout.
* Contribute to user research: interview scheduling, note\-taking, synthesis and sharing findings with the team.
* Maintain product documentation so that internal teams have one accurate source of truth.



  





**Skills \& Experience Requirements:** 



* 4 to 8 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or an engineering, consulting or customer\-facing role with clear product exposure.
* Minimum 1 year of that experience in healthcare SaaS, with working understanding of clinical, compliance or provider workflows.
* Strong written communication; able to write a requirement that an engineer can build from without a follow\-up meeting.
* Structured problem\-solving and comfort breaking an ambiguous request into scoped, sequenced work.
* Hands\-on experience with an issue tracker such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Working familiarity with Figma and the ability to review and give useful feedback on designs.
* Basic SQL and comfort working with product analytics tools.
* Genuine curiosity about how enterprise software is bought, deployed and audited.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or an equivalent analytical discipline.



  





**Preferred:** 



* Exposure to B2B or enterprise SaaS rather than consumer products.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks and reading API documentation.
* Interest in or exposure to regulated domains such as healthcare, financial services or clinical research.
* Experience using AI tooling to accelerate research, synthesis or documentation work.
* Prior internship or project work in product management.



  





**Why Join Certinal?** 



* **Real Ownership Early:** 
 Own features end to end rather than sitting on the edge of someone else’s roadmap.
* **Learn a Hard Domain:** 
 Regulated healthcare product work builds judgement that transfers anywhere.
* **Close to Customers:** 
 Direct exposure to enterprise buyers through Sales, Pre\-Sales and Customer Success.
* **Small Team, Short Loops:** 
 Decisions get made quickly and you will see your work ship.
* **Learning \& Development:** 
 Professional development budget and mentorship from senior product leadership.

title: Software OTA Product owner
description:
**Why join Aptiv?**
 You'll have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge applications, develop breakthrough technologies, and deliver innovative solutions to some of the world's leading automotive brands. See your work come to life on the road, helping make mobility safer, greener, and more connected. Ready to shape the future of mobility with us?
   

  

**YOUR ROLE**
 As a
 **SWDL/OTA Software Product Owner** 
 , you will own the vision, roadmap, backlog, and release outcomes for Aptiv's Software Download (SWDL) and Over\-the\-Air (OTA) platform solutions. You will serve as the bridge between customers, engineering teams, cybersecurity, diagnostics, validation, and vehicle platform stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and production\-ready software update capabilities for next\-generation connected vehicles.
   

  

* Own and prioritize the SWDL/OTA product backlog, translating customer, regulatory, and platform requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Define and drive product roadmaps for software download, bootloader, OTA update, diagnostics, release management, and vehicle update capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including embedded software, cybersecurity, diagnostics, platform, validation, functional safety, manufacturing, and customer teams to ensure successful product delivery.
* Drive release planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, and scope decisions while ensuring predictable delivery and production readiness.
* Act as the primary stakeholder interface for SWDL/OTA programs, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, quality requirements, and business objectives.
* Ensure end\-to\-end update behavior including software flashing, OTA deployment, rollback, recovery, diagnostics, and release governance meets customer expectations and compliance requirements.


**YOUR BACKGROUND**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline.
* 7\-12 years of experience in automotive embedded software with demonstrated Product Owner, Product Management, Technical Program Management, or Systems Ownership experience.
* Strong domain knowledge of Software Download (SWDL), OTA/FOTA updates, Bootloader concepts, ECU flashing, diagnostics, UDS, DoIP, release management, and software lifecycle processes.
* Good understanding of Embedded C, AUTOSAR, MCAL, device drivers, HSM, CAN, Vector Stack, CANoe, DaVinci, Trace32 Lauterbach, Infineon AURIX, and NXP microcontroller platforms.
* Proven experience managing product backlogs, roadmaps, feature prioritization, stakeholder expectations, and cross\-functional dependencies in Agile environments.
* Strong communication, customer\-facing, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business decisions.
* Experience with ASPICE, ISO 24089, UNECE R156, OTA platform solutions, automotive cybersecurity, and release governance is highly desirable.
* Experience supporting global OEM programs such as Ford, Stellantis, or other leading automotive manufacturers is a strong advantage.


**WHY JOIN US?**
* You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.
* You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.
* You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.


**Your Benefits At Aptiv**
* Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development)
* Life and accident insurance
* Sodexo cards for food and beverages
* Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events
