title: Senior Product Manager
description:
*Securonix is leading the transformation of cybersecurity by helping organizations stay ahead of modern threats. Security teams are no longer constrained by data or tools. They are constrained by speed, clarity, and confidence. Securonix was built to close that gap. Our mission is to enable security teams to decide and act faster across the entire threat lifecycle.*
*The Securonix Unified Defense SIEM is the industry’s first platform powered by agentic AI and designed with a human\-in\-the\-loop philosophy. It unifies detection, investigation, and response in a single system. Advanced UEBA delivers deep behavioral insight across users, entities, and data. Native threat intelligence continuously enriches detections and investigations with real\-world context. AI reinforces every layer of the platform while keeping accountability with the security team.*
*Built cloud\-native for scale and performance, the platform enables real\-time analytics, deep investigation, and automated response without compromise. Analysts gain faster access to relevant signals. Investigations move from days to minutes. Response becomes consistent and measurable. The result is a CyberOps experience that scales as threats evolve.*
*Securonix is recognized as a six\-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and a Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights. The company has been featured by leading publications including WIRED, Dark Reading, and Fortune for its innovation and leadership in security operations. Organizations rely on the platform for always\-available data, rapid search and investigation, continuously updated threat content, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response experience.*
*Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s leading enterprise software investors, Securonix benefits from deep operational expertise and a long\-term commitment to innovation and growth. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale the platform, accelerate product execution, and support customers as their security needs evolve.*
*With more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including a meaningful portion of the Fortune 100, Securonix operates at global scale. Our ecosystem of partners and managed security service providers extends that reach, helping organizations deploy and operate with confidence wherever they do business. What drives us is how we work.*
* We win as one team. We operate with trust, respect, and shared accountability.
* We are customer\-driven. Innovation is guided by real security challenges and measurable outcomes.
* We act with agility. Change is constant, and we stay aligned on purpose while adapting fast.


*That focus is how Securonix helps organizations move from reactive security to proactive, autonomous operations.*
 Securonix provides the Next Generation Security and Information Event Management (SIEM) solution. As a recognized leader in the SIEM industry, Securonix helps some of the largest organizations globally detect sophisticated cyberattacks and respond to them within minutes. The Securonix SNYPR platform is built on big data Hadoop technologies and is infinitely scalable. Our platform is used by some of the largest organizations in the financial, healthcare, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, and federal sectors.
   

  

**Summary**
 As a Product Manager at Securonix you will drive product strategy, roadmap execution, and cross\-functional alignment for key areas of the Securonix platform. You will work closely with customers, Engineering, Data Science, UX, Sales, and security practitioners to deliver innovative capabilities that solve real\-world cybersecurity challenges.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with a deep curiosity for cybersecurity, analytics, AI/ML\-driven detection, and cloud technologies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own and define a product domain vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with customer needs and company objectives.
* Gather and prioritize requirements from customers, field teams, analysts, and partner.
* Collaborate with engineering and design teams to deliver high\-quality features and platform capabilities.
* Translate complex cybersecurity workflows into intuitive product experiences
* Drive the full product lifecycle from concept through launch and ongoing optimization.
* Conduct market, competitive, and customer research to identify opportunities and trends.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering to support go\-to\-market activities.
* Develop product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release documentation.
* Analyze product usage, adoption metrics, and customer feedback to guide prioritization decisions.
* Work with data science and threat research teams to improve detection content, analytics, and automation capabilities.
* Represent the product in customer briefings, webinars, conferences, and analyst interactions.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise\-grade SaaS platforms, with at least 4 years in a leading product management role.
* Experience with NextGen SIEM, UEBA, MSSP, EDR, NDR, XDR products, or similar cybersecurity analytics platforms is essential.
* Experience working with SaaS and cloud\-native platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Ability to influence and collaborate across technical and business teams.
* Agile and lead product management experience with a strong entrepreneurial and start\-up mindset.
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, detail\-oriented, and able to juggle multiple projects and tasks.
* The ability to work effectively and independently in a fast\-paced environment, collaborating with geographically distributed teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in cybersecurity operations, threat detection, SOC workflows, Incident Management platforms, AI\-driven threat hunting, reporting, dashboarding, or API technologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications in cybersecurity.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with APIs, data pipelines, telemetry, or analytics platforms.
* Be an expert in competitive analysis and share strategic inputs to drive product definition and prioritization decisions.

title: Associate Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
 Role: Associate Consultant
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
   

  

 As a part of the DnA local products team, you will independently work with local product managers in the market to\-
   

  

* Build their product plan.
* Support in backlog grooming and sprint planning.
* Own the complete development of a product: scoping, prototyping, development, testing and release management.
* Manage the development squad: Form the squads and guide them.
* Work in partnership with all the other CoE teams such as RIS, SI, Hub, Lab etc as per the needs of the product.
* Collect feedback on product usage, gather new requirements and manage the post release lifecycle of the product.
* Support in enabling the sales, AM, Trading teams with operationalising the product for new client opportunities and existing client projects.
* Maintain product Wiki


**Who are your stakeholders?**
 As an Associate Consultant, you are required to work with different stakeholders across the MiQ ecosystem:
   

  

**Programmatic Traders:** 
 As an Associate Consultant, you collaborate with traders to test out the activation solutions to help them optimize campaigns. By leveraging your solution\-developing skills \& understanding of the programmatic landscape, you provide actionable activation segments on audience targeting, ad performance, and bidding strategies. This helps traders make data\-driven decisions, optimize their advertising campaigns, and improve overall campaign effectiveness and ROI.
   

  

**Product Managers:** 
 You work closely with the Product managers to leverage the power of data partnerships and through your EDA skills you help uncover valuable insights about customer behavior, market trends, and campaign performance. This information allows Product managers to create a product requirement \& scoping document with all the necessary details about the product's USP, capabilities thus outlining the course of product development
 **Sales Representatives:** 
 You will also be helping the sales team by creating a pitch document/presentation of the Local Product \& Solution for the clients. Your deck/doc helps identify potential opportunities and develop a gripping sales narrative. Additionally, you assist in responding to Request for Proposals (RFPs) by providing data\-driven pre\-campaign insights / white\-labeled case studies out of the products created under various verticals that help us in increasing the revenue streams.
   

  

**Agencies \& Clients:** 
 Your expertise in data analytics, statistics, data sciences \& solution development skills are invaluable for agency and advertiser clients. By providing them with planning, activation \& performance measurement solutions, you empower them to make informed decisions regarding their marketing strategies. Your final recommendations out of the solutions will help clients optimize their advertising budgets, target the right audience, and maximize the effectiveness of their campaigns. You are required to promote MiQ's internal solutions and capabilities, showcasing MiQ's unique value proposition in the programmatic landscape.
   

  

**DnA Analysts \& Data Scientists:** 
 You are required to work with the DnA Analysts \& Data Scientists to form a team with all the expertise in place for robust product development. The product developed under local products will be a collaborative effort of all the 3 experts. You will also have to train all other DnA Analyst on how to use a product, help them pitch to the client, and how to measure the impact of the solution.
   

  

 In summary, as an Associate Consultant, you add value by providing data\-driven planning, activation \& reporting solutions to traders, product managers, sales teams, and agency/advertiser clients that empower MiQ and its stakeholders to reach the right audience with the right content at the right time.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
**Must Haves**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent quantitative field (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics)
* 3\.5\+ years’ experience in the analytics domain
* Proficient with either R or Python and PySpark
* Expertise in Excel and PowerPoint
* Knowledge of big data processing tools/frameworks like Qubole /Databricks/Spark, AWS
* Descriptive and Inquisitive Analytics, Statistical modelling and Advanced analytics
* Should have developed and implemented at least 3 analytics solutions end to end.
* Able to translate problems into business\-ready deliverables.
* Excellent Storytelling and visualization skills
* Exposure on Machine learning and Deep Learning
* Sound knowledge of Tableau/ PowerBI /Google Data Studio \> Design and analysis of experiments


**Good to Have**
* Exposure on API Integrations
* Programmatic Media / Ad\-Tech domain knowledge
* Knowledge of Agile methodology, Scrum framework, Sprint planning
* Exposure to project management tools such as JIRA, Trello, Monday.com etc.
* Experience applying AI/ML and Generative AI to build practical analytics solutions, including predictive models, LLM\-based tools, AI agents, automated insights and workflow automation.
* Understanding of AI\-powered product development, including translating business problems into scalable AI/data products, validating model outputs, and collaborating with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams to take solutions from proof of concept to production.


 We’ve highlighted some key skills, experience, and requirements for this role. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ.
   

  

 If you have a passion for the role, please still apply.
   

  

**What impact will you create?**
 As an Associate Consultant, your role will create value for MiQ in the following ways:
   

  

* Driving client stickiness: With your ability to leverage different datasets in the MiQ ecosystem and develop solutions out of it, you will help the team in gathering requirements for vertical\-specific products, collecting \& incorporating feedback from the market and the clients, managing the post\-release lifecycle of the product and further identifying enhancement opportunities leading to improved client stickiness
* Driving Profitability: By leveraging the power of data you are expected to identify areas where we can create automated targeting solutions or optimization strategies that optimize costs \& enhance performance of campaigns thus improving profitability and providing competitive edge
* MiQ Growth: Being on top of the key product trends that are leading the industry \& the ability to leverage data within MiQ ecosystem to create competitive or improved solutions to help support MiQ's current business \& tap into new revenue streams to drive growth
* Support Key Decision Making: Your expertise in data analysis and solution development approach provides decision\-makers with the necessary information to make informed choices. Your products help guide agency, advertisers \& internal stakeholders in making strategic and tactical decisions that align with MiQ or client's objectives.
* Analytics Best Practices: As an Associate Consultant, you are expected to introduce analytics, statistics \& solutions best practices within the team, helping in setting up products and quality frameworks within the team \& internal stakeholders
* Developing Custom Analytics Solutions: Leveraging your experience in product development in conjunction with statistics \& advanced analytics, you will be expected to provide solutions to the vertical level problems \& lead the development of MiQ local products technically \& assist in enhancing their adoption within the target market


**What’s in it for you?**
 Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact across our entire global business.
   

  

 MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.
   

  

**Values**
 Our values are so much more than statements
 **.** 
 They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do \- no matter how big or small.
   

  

* We do what we love \- Passion
* We figure it out \- Determination
* We anticipate the unexpected \- Agility
* We always unite \- Unite
* We dare to be unconventional \- Courage


**Benefits**
 Every region and office have specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect:
   

  

* A hybrid work environment
* New hire orientation with job specific onboarding and training
* Internal and global mobility opportunities
* Competitive healthcare benefits
* Bonus and performance incentives
* Generous annual PTO paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives.

title: Founder's Office
description:
Most Strategy and Operations roles quietly turn into reporting jobs. You pull the numbers, format the decks, and remind people about deadlines.
 **This is not that role.** 




  





 This is the role for someone who wants to learn, at close range, how a fast growing company actually plans, prioritizes, and executes. You will work directly with the CEO and the leadership team on the problems that cut across functions, the ones no single team can solve alone. Your job is to turn ambiguity into a plan, and a plan into results.
 



  





 For the right person, this also happens to be one of the best leadership educations available anywhere. People who do this job well at Hevo build the instincts of a real operator, and many go on to run things. But the simplest reason to take it is this: you get to work on what matters most, alongside the people who decide it.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  





**1\. The operational rhythm of the whole company.** 
 You will work with the CEO to keep the entire machine moving across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, HR, Solutions, and Support. You will run the OKR process with the leadership team, drive quarterly planning and goal setting, and track delivery so nothing important slips. You will be the person who can tell, on any given day, how healthy the organization really is and where attention is needed next.
 



  





**2\. The strategic projects that move the needle.** 
 You will partner with the CEO and other leaders to spot the initiatives that genuinely change the trajectory of the business, then own them end to end until they are big enough to stand on their own and get handed to a dedicated team. These are the bets that matter most, and you will be trusted to carry them.
 



  





**3\. Cross functional execution and alignment.** 
 You will be the connective tissue across functions, driving communication so the company moves as one. You will be a real thought partner to leadership on vision, priorities, and the hard tradeoffs. You will manage relationships with stakeholders inside and outside the company, and when needed, represent leadership in reviews.
 



  





**Why this role is special:** 




  





 Three things make this seat genuinely rare.
 



  





**You get the full view.** 
 Most people spend a decade seeing one function. You will see all of them at once, from the vantage point of the executive team, inside a company growing fast enough to teach you something new every week.
 



  





**You work on first of a kind problems.** 
 Nearly every problem you solve will be one you have not solved before. There is no playbook handed to you. You build the playbook. For the right person, that is the most fun part of the job.
 



  





**You build an operator's judgment.** 
 Custodian of rhythm, owner of strategic projects, thought partner to leadership. That is the exact muscle set strong operators and founders are made of. You will leave this role with judgment most people take many more years to develop.
 



  





**What you will need to bring:** 




  





 We hire for abilities first, because knowledge and skills can be taught and abilities are far harder to build. Here is what we are really looking for.
 



  





**1\. Stakeholder management.** 
 You build trust with people at every level and quickly read what actually drives them. People want to work with you, and they tell you the truth.
 



  





**2\. People leadership.** 
 You understand what good leadership looks like up close. You know how to find the right levers and use them to bring out strong performance, and you have nudged teams into action in a way that energized them.
 



  





**3\. First principles problem solving.** 
 You are sharp with data, analytics, and reasoning. You break unfamiliar problems down to their fundamentals and build your way back up to a clear answer.
 



  





**4\. Ownership.** 
 You take a problem and you get it solved, full stop. You enjoy the wins, you own the misses, and you fix them. High accountability, no excuses.
 



  





**5\. Outwork and outsmart.** 
 You bring operational rigour and intensity. You find the smarter path, and you also do the work.
 



  





**6\. Independent thinking.** 
 You form your own point of view from the inputs in front of you, build conviction, and have the courage to make the call.
 



  





**7\. High agency.** 
 You move things forward mostly through influence, rarely through authority. You align people around the company wide goal by convincing them, not commanding them.
 



  





**Who tends to thrive here:** 




 The people who do exceptionally well in this seat usually share a pattern. They are intensely curious about how businesses work. They are comfortable being thrown into something they have never done and figuring it out. They care more about the outcome than the credit. And they have the energy to keep going when a problem turns out to be harder than it first looked, because that is usually where the most interesting work begins.

 You will work in the Nutanix Content Management team that is building a new hybrid cloud infrastructure management plane for management of core infrastructure building blocks like virtual machine templates, virtual disks and virtual appliances. We are looking for engineers with a rare and unique blend of technical and operational skills. You will work with a team of passionate engineers to drive the development and evolution of our hybrid cloud infrastructure management plane. You will play a key role in shaping the future of our product, ensuring product simplicity and delight for Nutanix customers.
   

  

 Engineering / R\&D at Nutanix
   

  

 Nutanix Content Management Service (CMS) simplifies and unifies the management of business\-critical hybrid cloud infrastructure components by extending the management plane across network and geographic boundaries. We are developing a new backend service and architecture focused towards realizing our product vision of effectively scaling to hybrid cloud infrastructure demands. For administrators, CMS speeds time to value and reduces operational risk by introducing a no overhead, easy single pane of glass management model. For business owners, CMS increases cost efficiency and speed towards delivery of a resilient hybrid cloud infrastructure. CMS aspires to exemplify true hybrid cloud model through its product offering and integrate seamlessly with popular hyperscaler cloud platform offerings. CMS is expected to operate in large customer environments spanning hundreds of geographically distributed cluster environments with thousands of hybrid cloud infrastructure management entities. The CMS team’s primary technology stack is authored in Python and Golang. The team is responsible for core Nutanix services responsible for managing hybrid cloud entities.
   

  

 Your Role
   

  

* Team Leadership \& Development: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 6–8 engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous professional development.
* Technical Direction \& Architecture: Own the technical vision and system architecture for CMS and related product areas, driving scalable, performant, resilient, and reliable solutions.
* Execution \& Lifecycle Delivery: Oversee the complete product development lifecycle—from concept, system design, and project planning through implementation, performance engineering, testing, and release.
* Product \& Stakeholder Partnership: Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, and other stakeholders to define aggressive yet achievable milestones, align engineering execution with market trends, and address Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs).
* Engineering \& Operational Excellence: Establish and enforce best practices in coding standards, automated testing, continuous integration, observability, and infrastructure monitoring to maximize developer productivity and deliver high\-quality products. Utilize AI coding tools and models to maintain high quality and velocity. Participate directly in technical deliverables through system design reviews, code reviews, and technical interviewing to maintain high standards for scale, security, and user experience.


 What You Will Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (required)
* 12\-14 years of software engineering experience.
* Proven experience with 2\+ years of managing small\-mid sized engineering teams.
* Proven ability to guide teams working in Go, python or similar systems programming languages.
* Solid hands\-on experience with cloud native platforms, distributed systems, containerization, and building enterprise grade APIs is required.
* Experience working in areas of enterprise product development or hyperscalers, including Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, VMware vSphere, etc.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly and effectively.
* Ability to lead through influence, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and drive alignment across engineering and other stakeholders.

title: Director, Product
description:
**Company Introduction**
 Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting\-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
   

  

 Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**About Availity**
 Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real\-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.
   

  

**About Availity India**
 Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.
   

  

 Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Availity is seeking a Director, Product Management – Core Solutions to lead a portfolio of foundational products and capabilities that have powered the healthcare ecosystem for more than 25 years. This leader will be responsible for driving the strategy, execution, modernization, and operational excellence of Availity's established solutions, including Availity Essentials, Essentials Pro, administrative and clinical connectivity products, and other core platform capabilities relied upon by health plans, providers, and partners every day.
   

  

 This role is uniquely positioned at the intersection of stability and innovation. Success requires balancing reliability, predictability, and disciplined delivery with continuous modernization and thoughtful innovation that advances Availity's vision for the next generation of healthcare connectivity.
   

  

 The Director will lead product managers responsible for critical, high\-scale solutions and will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Operations, Commercial teams, Customer Experience, and executive leadership to deliver efficient, unified, world\-class experiences that customers trust to run their businesses.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& Portfolio Leadership**
* Define and execute the product strategy for Availity's Core Solutions portfolio.
* Establish a clear modernization roadmap that enhances customer value while maintaining operational excellence and platform stability.
* Balance customer needs, business priorities, regulatory requirements, and technical investments across a mature portfolio.
* Identify opportunities to simplify experiences, consolidate capabilities, and create a more unified customer journey across products.
* Drive strategic decisions that strengthen Availity's position as the industry's trusted healthcare connectivity platform.


**Execution Excellence**
* Lead planning, prioritization, and delivery processes across multiple product teams.
* Create a culture of disciplined execution with predictable outcomes, measurable results, and operational rigor.
* Establish clear objectives, success measures, and performance metrics for products and teams.
* Ensure delivery commitments are achieved while maintaining high quality, reliability, scalability, and security standards.
* Use data, customer insights, and market intelligence to guide product investments and tradeoff decisions.


**Customer Experience \& Innovation**
* Champion seamless, efficient, and world\-class user experiences across the Core Solutions portfolio.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce friction, improve usability, and increase customer satisfaction.
* Partner closely with customers and stakeholders to understand evolving market needs and emerging opportunities.
* Introduce innovation thoughtfully and responsibly within established products without compromising trust, stability, or operational performance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, APIs, platform services, and emerging technologies to improve customer outcomes.


**Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of product managers and product leaders.
* Foster a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, customer centricity, and outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, UX, Operations, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and executive leadership teams.
* Elevate product management maturity through best practices in discovery, prioritization, roadmap management, and outcome measurement.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leadership.


**Business \& Operational Ownership**
* Manage portfolio performance through business metrics, customer outcomes, adoption, retention, and operational KPIs.
* Develop business cases and investment recommendations for modernization and growth initiatives.
* Ensure products remain compliant with evolving healthcare regulations and industry standards.
* Drive operational improvements that increase efficiency, scalability, and customer value.


**Required Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in US healthcare leading product teams and managers.
* Proven experience managing mature, enterprise\-scale products with large customer bases and high operational complexity.
* Demonstrated success balancing product innovation with stability, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Strong background in platform, enterprise software, healthcare technology, or connectivity solutions.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams through large\-scale modernization and transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and decision\-making skills.
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Track record of delivering measurable business and customer outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in healthcare technology, payer\-provider connectivity, revenue cycle, clinical interoperability, or related healthcare domains.
* Familiarity with healthcare transactions, administrative workflows, clinical data exchange, APIs, and interoperability standards.
* Experience managing platform products, ecosystem products, or network\-based businesses.
* MBA or advanced degree preferred.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within this role, you will:
   

  

* Deliver highly reliable and predictable product outcomes across a mission\-critical portfolio.
* Modernize core solutions while preserving customer trust and operational stability.
* Improve customer satisfaction through more consistent and unified user experiences.
* Increase delivery effectiveness and execution discipline across product teams.
* Strengthen product\-market fit of established solutions through continuous innovation and customer engagement.
* Help evolve Availity's platform toward the future of healthcare connectivity while protecting and growing the business that customers depend on today.


**Leadership Competencies**
**The Ideal Candidate Demonstrates**
* Customer Obsession – Deep understanding of customer workflows and business outcomes.
* Operational Excellence – Drives reliability, consistency, and predictable execution.
* Strategic Vision – Balances today's commitments with tomorrow's opportunities.
* Ownership \& Accountability – Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs.
* Systems Thinking – Understands interconnected products, processes, and ecosystems.
* Talent Development – Builds strong teams and develops future leaders.
* Influence \& Collaboration – Aligns diverse stakeholders around shared objectives.
* Innovation with Discipline – Advances modernization while protecting mission\-critical operations.


**Why Join Availity India?**
* Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
* Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office\-based models.
* Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
* Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
* Office experience: For office\-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night\-shift transportation support.


**What To Expect From The Hiring Process**
 Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.
   

  

**Eligibility**
**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera\-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non\-participants.*

Position SummaryAre you passionate about transforming how Finance teams leverage AI to work smarter? Join Walmart’s AI Center of Excellence, where you'll provide technical leadership for cutting‑edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) initiatives that empower our Finance organization.

Your expertise in modern AI patterns\-including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG)\-will help shape the future of AI‑driven financial workflows at one of the world’s largest retailers.

 Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication

 What You’ll Bring

 – Enterprise AI solution design patterns
   

  

* Experience working with large datasets and data‑informed systems
* Strong SQL skills for validation, analysis, and optimization
* Exposure to Business Intelligence (BI) and analytical ecosystems
* Excellent communication skills for diverse audiences
* Strong stakeholder partnership and cross‑functional collaboration skills
* Self‑starter mindset with curiosity, adaptability, and comfort navigating ambiguity


 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience applying AI solutions in Finance or large enterprise environments
* Familiarity with enterprise AI governance and responsible AI practices
* Ability to evaluate and improve end‑to‑end quality of AI solutions
* Experience debugging or enhancing AI‑generated or rapidly‑prototyped applications (including “vibe‑coded” solutions)
* Knowledge of Finance workflows, analytics, and reporting requirements

* Contributions to open‑source AI projects or broader technical communities

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6\.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
 



  





 At Greenlight, we're here to make the day\-to\-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.
 



  





 Common Platforms builds the foundations every other product team depends on. Access, identity management, authentication and notifications are the foundation every Greenlight experience runs on, they decide who gets into the door, and whether the right person hears from us at the right moment. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Common Platforms to own this layer end\-to\-end: the Identity and access management, the permissions that govern what parents and kids can each do, and the multi\-channel notification platform that reaches millions of families every day.
 



  





 This is a high\-leverage, high\-trust role at the center of Greenlight's platform organization. Your customers are both the families using our products who should never have to think about any of this and the product teams building on top of you, who ship faster when your systems are reliable. You'll work cross\-functionally across teams at Greenlight (US \& India) , and you'll have direct line\-of\-sight to executive leadership on the decisions that shape customer trust and platform reliability. The right person thinks in systems, and is comfortable building core platform products.
 



  





 This role reports to the Director of Product and sits within the Common Platforms team.
 



  





**Your day\-to\-day:** 



* Working closely with Engineering and design to ensure building great product.
* Work closely with key stakeholders for new requirements and ensure to keep teams updated on ongoing items
* Owning the key metrics for your product and ensuring the reliability of the product.
* Embedded in a dedicated cross\-functional pod with Engineering and Design, with close partnerships across Security, Risk and Compliance, Legal, Data, Customer Support, and the consumer product teams who depend on your platform.



  





**What you’ll bring to the team:** 



* 6\+ years in product management, with at least 2 years building platform products
* Comfortable to build long term strategy for your product vertical and drive the key projects independently end to end.
* Strong cross\-functional instincts \- you’ve navigated complex stakeholder environments including Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Payments, and know how to move fast within constraints.
* Executive presence: you communicate up and across clearly, adapt your message to your audience, and don’t wait to be asked for updates.
* Ownership mentality \- you proactively identify gaps, propose solutions, and follow through. You don’t need a playbook to get started.
* Urgency and scrappiness: experience in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments where speed matters and you figure things out yourself.



  





**Good to have:** 



* Fintech experience or a familiarity with identity and access management (IAM), authentication standards



  





**Who we are:** 




 It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.
 



  





 Greenlight is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on age, race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

 Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds.  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 Wrike is seeking a highly adaptable Senior Product Manager to join our global product organization. As a strategic leader, you will own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of your product area, driving measurable business impact and solving complex problems for millions of users.
   

  

 We are looking for a versatile generalist who is comfortable tackling diverse challenges as business needs evolve, but who is ready to immediately dive into a high\-impact, transformative domain:
 **AI\-driven Work Intake** 
 .
   

  

**Your Impact:**
* Deliver Innovation: Validate and ship solutions that revolutionize how work flows into systems, saving customers time and boosting work quality for both administrators and end\-users. Evolve Wrike's work intake experience through platform and agentic capabilities within your first 6 months.
* Drive Discovery \& Vision: Deeply understand customer workflows and underlying business pains to uncover emerging needs. Paint a compelling product vision and propose pragmatic, innovative solutions — whether through advanced AI, platform capabilities, or a combination of both — that best solve the core problem.
* Adapt \& Scale: Act as a flexible product leader capable of pivoting to new, critical product domains as our overarching business strategy evolves.

**About Narayana Health:**

Narayana Health Group is India’s leading healthcare provider and one of the largest hospital groups in the country, with a network of 21 hospitals, 5 heart centres, and 19 primary care facilities. The NH group treats over 2\.6 Million patients every year from over 78 countries, covering 30\+ medical specialities.Our Centers of Excellence help in treating Adult \& Pediatric patients, and we have one of the largest transplant centers in India. We have a strong presence across 17 locations in India, and an overseas hospital in the Cayman Islands, USA. Two of our hospitals have international accreditation from the Joint Commission International (JCI), and 19 hospitals have domestic accreditation from the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals (NABH).For more details, please refer to our website at: https://www.narayanahealth.org
 **About Medha:** 
 Medha is the Advanced Analytics \& AI arm of Narayana Health, focused on transforming healthcare through data, intelligence, and thoughtfully designed digital products. Our mission is to simplify decision\-making across hospitals, clinics, and care teams by bringing clarity, precision, and actionability to every layer of healthcare operations.Our products power large health systems, influence mission\-critical workflows, and support clinical and non\-clinical teams in delivering safer, faster, and more coordinated care.
 **For more details, please refer to our website at** 
**https://www.medha\-analytics.ai/** 
**Why Join Medha:** 
* Shape next\-generation healthcare intelligence products that drive decisions for clinicians, operations leaders, and frontline care teams.
* Own and influence multi\-product roadmaps from day one, working at the intersection of clinical insight and technology.
* Solve real, high\-impact problems — every product you build directly supports patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and healthcare quality.
* Collaborate in a vision\-led, cross\-functional environment alongside Engineering, Design, Data, and Clinical domain experts.
* Grow fast in a team that values ownership, analytical rigour, and user empathy equally.


**Job Purpose:** 
* The Product Manager will own product roadmaps across multiple products in the Medha portfolio and lead them through the full lifecycle — from discovery and prioritisation to delivery and post\-launch optimisation.
* This role sits at the nexus of Leadership, Design, Engineering, and Quality, and also carries responsibility for user onboarding, training, and first\-line query resolution — ensuring products deliver measurable value in live healthcare environments.


**Candidate Requirements:** 
**Education:** 
 Master's in Business Administration (MBA) from a premier institute preferred; equivalent analytical or technical postgraduate qualification considered.
 **Experience:** 
 3 – 6 years in product management, preferably in health\-tech, enterprise SaaS, or data/analytics\-driven products.
 **Location:** 
 Bengaluru (primary); travel as required.
 
**Key Responsibilities:** 
**Product Roadmap Ownership** 
* Own and drive product roadmaps for multiple products within the Medha portfolio, ensuring alignment with organisational strategy and business goals.
* Translate high\-level business objectives into clearly defined epics, user stories, and prioritised backlogs.
* Lead quarterly and annual roadmap planning cycles in collaboration with Leadership, balancing strategic bets with near\-term delivery commitments.
* Continuously evaluate and re\-prioritise the roadmap based on user feedback, competitive signals, and data insights.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 
* Partner closely with Leadership to understand strategic intent and cascade it into product direction.
* Work hand\-in\-hand with the Design team to drive user research, define experience requirements, and review design artefacts.
* Collaborate with Engineering to scope, estimate, and deliver features on time with high quality — participating in sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives.
* Engage with the Quality team to define acceptance criteria, support UAT, and ensure post\-release stability.


**User Training \& Query Resolution** 
* Lead user onboarding and training sessions for new product releases, ensuring clinical and operational users are confident and proficient.
* Create and maintain user\-facing documentation, FAQs, and training guides tailored to varied user personas (clinical, operational, administrative).
* Serve as the primary escalation point for user queries, coordinating with Engineering and QA for swift resolution of product issues.
* Track recurring issues and user pain points, feeding them into the product roadmap as prioritised improvement items.


**Discovery \& Validation** 
* Conduct user interviews, contextual inquiry, and observational research across hospital environments to deeply understand workflows and unmet needs.
* Perform market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for product differentiation and innovation.
* Define and validate hypotheses through rapid prototyping, pilots, and structured feedback loops.


**Product Documentation \& Metrics** 
* Author and maintain comprehensive product documentation: PRDs, user stories, feature specifications, and release notes.
* Define product KPIs and success metrics; build dashboards and reports to track adoption, engagement, and outcome impact.
* Drive post\-launch reviews, compiling lessons learned and sharing actionable recommendations with stakeholders.


**Go\-to\-Market \& Stakeholder Communication** 
* Develop product positioning, messaging frameworks, and internal communication plans for major releases.
* Present product updates, roadmap reviews, and strategic proposals to senior leadership with clarity and confidence.
* Maintain strong relationships with key internal stakeholders — hospital operations, clinical leads, finance, and IT — to ensure product adoption and feedback loops are active.


**Required Skills:** 
* Roadmap Strategy \& Execution: Proven ability to own multi\-product roadmaps, balance competing priorities, and drive end\-to\-end delivery.
* Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills — able to craft compelling narratives for C\-suite, clinical, and engineering audiences alike.
* Analytical \& Data\-Driven Mindset: Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and metrics; experience with analytics or BI tools is a strong advantage.
* User Empathy \& Product Sense: Deep ability to translate user pain points and behavioural insights into impactful product decisions.
* Agile Fluency: Hands\-on experience leading Agile/Scrum ceremonies; familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent.
* Technical Literacy: Solid understanding of APIs, data pipelines, system architecture, and cloud platforms — enough to have credible conversations with engineering teams.
* Training \& Enablement: Demonstrated ability to design and deliver training programmes for diverse user groups in operational environments.
* Issue Identification \& Resolution: Skilled at diagnosing product issues, triaging urgency, and coordinating rapid cross\-functional resolution.
* Healthcare Domain Knowledge (Preferred): Familiarity with HIS/EMR systems, clinical workflows, or hospital operations is a significant advantage.

Lowe's employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers. We leverage new technologies and find innovative methods to ensure that Lowe's has a competitive edge in the market. To know more about Lowe's India, visit Lowes.co.in
 



  





**Job Summary**




 The Senior Manager \- Marketplace CRM and Seller Platform will own the strategy, governance, feature build, implementation, and ongoing optimization of the Lowe’s Marketplace Salesforce ecosystem across the end\-to\-end seller lifecycle. This leader will be responsible for delivering a best\-in\-class Salesforce experience that enables Business Development, Seller Onboarding, Seller Management, Seller Operations, and Seller Support to efficiently acquire, onboard, support, and grow Marketplace sellers.
 



  





 This role owns two critical Salesforce functions, along with the development and roll\-out of any future functionality and system integrations:
 



  





 1\.Marketplace CRM, which manages the seller journey from prospect through long\-term account management
 



  





 2\.Seller Resource Center, which enables sellers to self\-serve through Knowledge Articles and engage directly with Seller Support through case management
 



  





 Working closely with business stakeholders and technology partners, this individual will define the product roadmap, implement enhancements, create ad hoc reporting needs, optimize business processes, improve user adoption, and ensure the Salesforce ecosystem continues to scale alongside the rapid growth of Lowe's Marketplace.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities**




 •Alongside a Marketplace CRM council with representation from each major function of the team, this person will own the strategic vision, governance, feature build, implementation, and roadmap for the Marketplace Salesforce ecosystem.
 



 •Manage the end\-to\-end Salesforce CRM experience supporting the seller lifecycle from business development and pipeline management through onboarding, account management, and ongoing seller growth.
 



 •Partner with Seller Experience teams on the continuous improvement of the Seller Resource Center, including Knowledge Center, case management workflows, self\-service capabilities, and seller experience enhancements.
 



 •Partner with Technology teams to gather requirements and implement any future Salesforce integrations.
 



 •Serve as the primary business and implementation owner for Salesforce enhancements from design to development, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support.
 



 •Drive continuous process improvement by identifying automation opportunities that reduce manual work, improve operational efficiency, and create a seamless seller experience.
 



 •Develop governance processes that ensure platform consistency, data quality, user adoption, security, and long\-term scalability across all Marketplace teams.
 



 •Define and monitor key performance metrics related to CRM adoption, seller productivity, support effectiveness, case resolution, Knowledge Article utilization, and overall platform health.
 



 •Create executive\-level reporting and dashboards that provide actionable insights into seller pipeline health, onboarding progress, support operations, and business performance.
 



 •Lead user acceptance testing (UAT), change management, release planning, training, and communication efforts to ensure successful rollout and adoption of new Salesforce capabilities.
 



 •Stay current on Salesforce capabilities, Sales Cloud innovations, AI functionality, and industry best practices to continuously improve the Marketplace seller experience.
 



 •Mentor and develop direct team members (over time as this will be an IC job to start) while fostering strong cross\-functional partnerships across global Lowe's teams.
 



  





**Minimum Qualifications**




 •Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
 



 •8\+ years of experience managing Salesforce CRM platforms, including ownership of platform strategy, administration, business process optimization, and roadmap planning.
 



 •5\+ years of experience leading cross\-functional initiatives involving multiple business stakeholders and technology partners.
 



 •Experience managing CRM platforms supporting customer, seller, partner, or account lifecycle management in an eCommerce, retail, marketplace, or technology organization.
 



  





**Preferred Skills / Education**




 •MBA or Master's Degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

**Description**
 Digital Lifecycle Strategist at Strategic Product Planning
   

  

 Together with our customers and supply chain partners, governments, societies and other stakeholders, we are moving to develop and introduce transport and infrastructure solutions that drive prosperity socially, environmentally and financially.
   

  

 The shift to software\-defined vehicles (SDV) is fundamentally reshaping the automotive industry. At Company Group, we are not just adopting this transformation \- we are defining how it creates business value at scale. We are now looking for a Digital Lifecycle Strategist to strengthen Strategic Product Planning and play a key role in defining our future product portfolio direction.
   

  

 Why This Role is Different
   

  

 This is not a technology development role, and it is not a role focused on building digital services.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact strategic leadership role where you will define how software\-defined vehicle (SDV) capabilities translate into product portfolio direction, lifecycle value models, and long\-term business impact.
   

  

 You will ensure that SDV capabilities are reflected in the product plan, portfolio priorities, and lifecycle strategies, enabling sustainable value creation beyond the point of sale.
   

  

 What You Will Drive
   

  

**As Digital Lifecycle Strategist, You Will**
* Define the strategic framework connecting product strategy, feature roadmaps, lifecycle value models, and digital monetization
* Identify and prioritize strategic SDV initiatives impacting the product portfolio
* Shape how SDV capabilities influence product evolution and portfolio priorities (incl the ability to decouple functionality from hardware, enable continuous feature evolution, and create lifecycle\-based value streams through software, connectivity, and data)
* Establish principles for lifecycle value creation, including feature packaging and value capture over time
* Influence investment decisions and portfolio trade\-offs by integrating lifecycle thinking into the product plan


 Your future team
   

  

 You will join Strategic Product Planning, a highly strategic function within Trucks Technology. The team plays a central role in setting the direction of the long\-term product portfolio, translating business and customer needs into strategic product priorities, and navigating industry transformation.
   

  

 We work cross\-functionally and globally, with strong collaboration across brands and engineering.
   

  

 Who are you?
   

  

 You are not learning software\-defined vehicles \- you have already operated in this space for long and understand how software, connectivity, and business models reshape the product lifecycle.
   

  

* You bring 10\+ years of experience in strategic roles within automotive OEMs, technology companies, or adjacent industries
* You have direct experience shaping product strategy, lifecycle offerings, or digital monetization at scale
* You have influenced portfolio\-level decisions, not just contributed to individual initiatives
* You understand the intersection of product planning, software platforms, and business models in a software\-defined vehicle context


 You combine strategic thinking with strong business acumen and a holistic, future\-oriented mindset. You are comfortable operating in complex environments where industry standards are still evolving, and you can turn ambiguity into clear direction, focus areas, and priorities that guide long\-term decision\-making.
   

  

 You build trust through collaboration and are recognized for bringing stakeholders together across functions, brands, and levels. At the same time, you are confident challenging assumptions, highlighting difficult trade\-offs, and helping organizations converge on decisions that create long\-term impact.
   

  

 You take a data\-driven approach to strategy, simplifying complexity into actionable insights, and communicate with clarity and impact. Whether through storytelling, visualization, or executive dialogue, you are able to articulate direction in a way that drives alignment and momentum.

**Job Description:**
**Objective / Purpose:**
 Support the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement in applying operational excellence and human\-centered design to evaluate, redesign, and continuously improve the processes underpinning GPT (Global Program Team) ways of working and the broader R\&D Operational Excellence function. This role combines process design expertise with technical acumen to translate business needs into scalable, technology\-enabled solutions — automations, dashboards, and digital products — that improve insight generation, data usability, and operational efficiency. Working closely with Data, Digital \& Technology (DD\&T) and business stakeholders, the role stewards a practical, Lean\-based optimization framework and moves teams beyond static documentation toward integrated, user\-centric, digitally enabled solutions that balance enterprise standards with business flexibility.
   

  

**Accountabilities:**
**1\) Process Design \& Improvement:**
* Evaluate current processes and ways of working for GPTs and R\&D Operational Excellence functions, and partner with the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement and function owners to redesign prioritized processes against strategic needs.
* Identify possible opportunities where AI, automation, or digital tooling can reduce manual effort, accelerate cycle time, or improve quality — recommending what to automate versus keep human\-in\-the\-loop, and the expected value.
* Incorporate automation, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to support self\-service and system\-generated insights that improve decision\-making and operational effectiveness.
* Reimagine static outputs (e.g., fixed dashboards) as flexible solutions that support both standardized reporting and user\-driven data exploration.


**2\) Technology \& Data Enablement:**
* Collaborate with business owners, DD\&T, and data teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions for redesigned processes.
* Embed and optimize data within process implementations for structured, reusable inputs, ensuring alignment with enterprise data standards and governance.
* Identify and evaluate data sources critical to process improvement initiatives, assessing availability, accessibility, and usability.
* Hands\-on development and delivery of technical prototypes and demos to validate process improvements, demonstrate new capabilities, and drive adoption.
* Partner with DD\&T and data quality SMEs to uncover barriers to data access and establish frameworks that balance end\-user flexibility with a single source of truth.
* Maintain accessible, well\-governed process documentation — interconnected with related resources and structured for long\-term version control — so functional leads can apply Process Optimization \& Enablement methods independently.


**3\) Continuous Improvement \& Adoption:**
* Lead follow\-up on prototypes to capture lessons learned and refine solutions before broader rollout, keeping a clear line of sight from design intent to adoption and outcomes.
* Support and ensure post\-implementation assessments are completed to capture value, ROI, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Represent process design work in working groups and governance forums on behalf of the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement.


**4\) Cross\-Functional Enablement \& Relationships:**
* Provide process design support and technical reference guides across R\&D Operational Excellence functions, in alignment with the framework set by the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement.
* Partner with the Operations \& Digital Enablement Lead to train peers and line function teams, building an internal process design capability that isn't dependent on any one individual.
* Define simple leading and lagging indicators (e.g., cycle time, rework, adoption, quality) that support periodic process health reviews, and recommend the next round of improvements.
* Build effective working relationships with GPT Enablement, CAPTIVATE process leads, R\&D line function leaders, transformation program leads, and DD\&T partners to ensure designs reflect real operating constraints and surface upstream/downstream dependencies.


**Education \& Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):**
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred, with 4\-6\+ years of experience in process design, business operations, data/analytics, or digital transformation.
* Strong, hands\-on command of operational excellence and process improvement methodologies (e.g., value\-stream mapping, metric development, root\-cause analysis, RACI design, and Kaizen\-style improvement events).
* Demonstrated experience supporting end\-to\-end process redesign in matrixed organizations — from current\-state diagnosis through future\-state design, pilot, rollout, and sustainment.
* Systems\-thinking orientation, with the ability to see how a process sits inside a wider operating model and design processes that coherently accommodate upstream and downstream impacts.
* Experience with data platforms, analytics tools, or reporting environments (e.g., Power BI, data models), including a working understanding of how AI and automation can be applied to enterprise processes.
* Understanding of data governance, data standards, and data quality principles.
* Strong analytical orientation — comfortable defining simple process KPIs and using data to diagnose issues and quantify improvement.
* Able to operate across functions without direct authority and bring senior stakeholders along.

**Job Description For Sr Hardware Program Manager**
**Title: \- Senior Specialist, Project Management (JPPP4\)**
**Summary:**
 As a Senior Specialist, Project Management, you lead cross\-functional efforts supporting the lifecycle, manufacturability, and delivery of hardware products. You serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Product Management, and external OEM partners to ensure products remain available, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. You oversee hardware lifecycle initiatives, monitor component availability risks, manage product change activities, and drive execution of hardware projects from concept through deployment and sustainment.
   

  

 Your mission is to proactively identify and mitigate product availability risks, coordinate hardware lifecycle activities, and ensure successful execution of hardware programs without disrupting customer commitments. Your impact is measured through successful product delivery, reduced supply chain risk, effective OEM management, and timely execution of hardware refresh and sustainment initiatives.
   

  

* Owns the intersection between:
+ Hardware Engineering
+ Manufacturing
+ Supply Chain
+ OEM partners
+ Product Management

* Their primary mission is to ensure:
+ Products remain buildable
+ Risks are identified early
+ Component lifecycle issues are visible
+ Hardware refresh projects move forward
+ Supply chain actions are completed
+ OEM partners meet commitments


**Responsibilities:**
* Hardware Program Management
+ Lead hardware lifecycle and sustainment projects across the NetBotz product portfolio.
+ Develop and maintain project plans for hardware refreshes, component replacement activities, product updates, and new hardware introductions.
+ Track risks, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables across multiple concurrent hardware programs.
+ Coordinate activities between Engineering, Manufacturing, and Product Management

* Component Lifecycle \& Supply Chain Coordination
+ Monitor component lifecycle status, end\-of\-life notifications, supplier advisories, lead times, and supply chain risks.
+ Ensure identified component risks have documented mitigation plans and clear ownership.
+ Track execution of last\-time\-buy (LTB) activities and related supply chain actions.
+ Work with Supply Chain and Engineering teams to understand demand forecasts and potential supply constraints.
+ Maintain visibility into critical component availability and associated business risks.

* Product Change Management
+ Coordinate Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and related product change activities.
+ Track progress of hardware change projects from identification through implementation and release.
+ Ensure stakeholders understand the schedule, impact, and status of product changes.
+ Facilitate communication between engineering teams and manufacturing partners regarding product updates.

* Risk Management \& Reporting
+ Regularly communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders and leadership.
+ Identify emerging risks and drive corrective actions before they impact customers or production schedules.
+ Monitor partner commitments, deliverables, and action items.
+ Escalate issues proactively to prevent disruptions to manufacturing and product availability.

* Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support project or departmental objectives.


**Required Skills and Experience:**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Management, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience managing technical projects, hardware programs, supply chain initiatives, or product lifecycle activities.
* Experience working with manufactured products and multi\-level Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Understanding of component lifecycle management, end\-of\-life (EOL) processes, and supply chain risk management.
* Experience coordinating Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and other product change processes.
* Ability to interpret engineering documentation including BOMs, datasheets, and product specifications.
* Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with manufacturing organizations, contract manufacturers, or OEM partners.
* Ability to identify risks, drive actions to closure, and lead cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Proficiency with project management tools, spreadsheets, and reporting systems.


**Desired Additional Skills and Experience:**
* Experience supporting electronics, networking, industrial IoT, environmental monitoring, or embedded hardware products.
* Familiarity with component lifecycle databases and product lifecycle management (PLM) systems.
* Understanding of hardware development processes and electronics manufacturing.
* Experience working with global supply chains and international manufacturing partners.
* Familiarity with procurement processes, lead\-time analysis, and demand planning concepts.
* Understanding of regulatory compliance, product certification, and manufacturing qualification processes.
* Experience supporting sustaining engineering and product refresh initiatives.
* Familiarity with terminology and processes including ECO, ECR, AVL, EOL, PCN, LTB, DFM, and NPI.

This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.

* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.

Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.

* Adoption \& Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3\-month forward\-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

* Overall experience of 3\+ yrs with at least 1\+ yrs in product management in a tech\-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.

description:
Scopely is looking for a
 **Lead Product Manager** 
 to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team in Bangalore, India on a hybrid basis.
   

  

 At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
   

  

**Star Trek™ Fleet Command** 
 is a top\-grossing MMO 4X strategy game that has captivated players for over five years. As we continue to expand and evolve the game, we are seeking a highly driven and analytical Lead Product Manager to own the performance and strategic direction of our live content, including monthly events, offers, and player experience.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As Lead Product Manager, you’ll be the key driver for identifying, executing, and optimizing strategies that improve player engagement, retention, and monetization across our live game. You will focus on key LiveOps pillars such as events, feature performance, and live sales; ensuring that everything we launch is performant, data\-informed, and player\-first.
   

  

 You’ll work cross\-functionally with Product Marketing, Product Ops, and Analytics teams to define, prioritize, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet both business and player goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* This position involves taking ownership of LiveOps excellence and driving the success of our LiveOps operations through effective leadership, critical thinking and flawless execution.
* Manage and develop a team of talented Product Managers. Contributing to a culture of product excellence and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Drive the performance strategy for LiveOps systems, recurring events, and monetization features, ensuring they meet player expectations and business KPIs.
* Perform analysis and optimization of live features and events, using data to identify opportunities, perform root\-cause diagnostics, and execute impactful improvements.
* Contribute to building a repeatable, scalable approach to LiveOps performance management and experimentation.
* Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements.
* Develop clear documentation and KPIs for live operations, continuously iterating on performance with a test\-and\-learn mindset


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5\+ years of experience in product management, ideally with significant live operations responsibility in a F2P mobile game.
* Strong leadership skills.
* Demonstrated success managing complex monetization and engagement systems, with strong experience in event design, sales strategy, or player lifecycle management.
* Data\-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision.
* Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice\-of\-player channels.
* Experience driving impact across cross\-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams.


**Work Schedule**
 This role follows a non\-standard working schedule to support close collaboration with a U.S.\-based team. The position requires a regular daily overlap from 9:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST to align with the Los Angeles team (this overlap is a fixed requirement). During the initial ramp\-up period, new hires are also expected to be available for collaboration during daytime hours, approximately between 10:30 AM and 4:30 PM IST, with some flexibility. Candidates should be comfortable working a split schedule during the ramp\-up phase, with at least two hours of guaranteed overlap with the U.S. team.

 Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all\-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others.  Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world\-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet\-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the \#1 mobile games company in the U.S. and \#2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
   

  

 Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.
